#2user.message15 Sept 2026, 19:38

▾{

"type": "user.message",

"userId": "usr\_mu2k5jy6VgdeapbDZzNY",

"text": "The team agreed to implement a workflow that sends automated reminders to candidates who have not completed their document packs.\\n\\nIn the latest 3B Onboarding release, we have the \\"Requested Documents\\" object structure which is created on document pack assignment to contact and it's existance is there to help us identify which doucments are outstanding vs completed. \\n\\nThe problem is that our client Reed cannot upgrade to the latest version of 3B Onboarding due to a planned salesforce upgrade cycle that prevents us to, so we need to find a way to still show count of pending vs completed and % completeness on the document assignment accurately, without relying on the Requested Documents object model. For this, we will need to also re-evaluate the per-document conditionals - although in prod we have only one or two documents with document conditional visibility rules, we still need to support this.\\n\\nFurthermore, we need to design this in such a way that once the 3B Onboarding package is installed with the Required Documents object structure, we can quickly deprecate what we did here and rely on the native mechanisms.\\n\\nThe second component to this requirement is sending email reminders to candidates about outstanding documents. Candidates often forget to provide all requested documents or navigate away from the onboarding portal, so this goal here is to send email reminders daily, once per day for a 10 day duration. The trigger should be a new document assignment (candidates can have multiple at the same time) and the email should summarize what documents are outstanding. \\n\\nThe solution will be configurable, allowing the ops team to adjust the duration and frequency without needing code changes from the developers.\\n\\nOn analysis, there are 144 Document (b3o\_\_Document\_\_c) records and only one with b3o\_\_Conditional\_rendering\_rule\_\_c (which is set to {\\"crossGroupOperator\\":\\"and\\",\\"customCrossGroupOperator\\":null,\\"groups\\":\[{\\"uuid\\":\\"533c2811-8e36-48e0-8357-e98131754f29\\",\\"crossConditionOperator\\":\\"and\\",\\"customCrossConditionOperator\\":null,\\"conditions\\":\[{\\"uuid\\":\\"b2df6caf-83a2-41d9-8263-e849e26221e8\\",\\"targetObject\\":\\"TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\\",\\"conditionItems\\":\[{\\"uuid\\":\\"c9436f2e-6dd0-4105-af40-30be46a764b1\\",\\"targetObject\\":\\"TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\\",\\"targetObjectField\\":\\"E\_W\_Location\_\_c\*BOOLEAN\\",\\"targetObjectFieldValue\\":true,\\"targetValueComparitor\\":\\"equals\\"}\]}\]}\]}) in production.\\n\\nLastly, add support for utilizing different email templates based on the document pack, with a default email template. The team agreed that the offer stage (represented by a different document pack), in particular, may require distinct wording to inform candidates that they cannot be paid or start work until the documents are completed.\\n\\nReed is a high-volume agency, so we expect up to 60k email reminders per day. We have already created a sendgrid integration in order to handle the volume. \\n\\n\\nCheck out the 3B onboarding repo for additional context: 3B-Soft/Onboarding",

"seq": 2,

"sessionId": "ses\_mu2wbhm7vam4v5pzeLzJ",

"at": "2026-09-15T16:38:22.595Z"

}

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* Reed case #00003380.\\n \*\\n \* Replicates the assignment logic of the record-triggered flow\\n \* \\"3B - Document Distribution Process\\" (Production V26) for EXISTING\\n \* Applications, which that flow can never reach because it only fires on\\n \* record CREATE.\\n \*\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* ONE CODEBASE, TWO ORGS\\n \*\\n \* Sandbox TRAIN does not have every field Production has:\\n \* - Job.FOS\_Role\_Type\_\_c Production only\\n \* - Application.b3\_Business\_Process\_\_c Production only\\n \* and its Business process picklist is missing \\"Friends & Family EOI\\",\\n \* \\"Returners\\", \\"Onsite with CV Upload\\", \\"Onsite\\" and \\"Customer Experience\\".\\n \*\\n \* So every org-variable field is read DYNAMICALLY and the SOQL is built from a\\n \* describe. The class therefore compiles and runs unchanged in both orgs; the\\n \* branches Sandbox cannot represent simply never match there.\\n \*\\n \* Document Pack Ids are never in Apex. They are read from the hierarchy custom\\n \* setting X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c, which is exactly where the flow\\n \* reads them, so each org resolves its own packs.\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\\n implements Database.Batchable<SObject>, Database.Stateful {\\n\\n public static Boolean suppressTrigger = false;\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // CONSTANTS - confirmed against Production 03/09/2026\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n public static final Integer RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS = 90;\\n public static final String ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW = 'New';\\n\\n private static final String ACCOUNT\_ANGARD\_CONTAINS = 'Angard';\\n private static final String ACCOUNT\_FOS\_EQUALS = 'Financial Ombudsman Service';\\n\\n /\*\* The pack every application gets before any branching. \*/\\n private static final String SETTING\_FIELD\_BASE\_PACK = 'New\_Application\_Doc\_Pack\_\_c';\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* API name of the checkbox the button ticks. THE ONLY PLACE IT APPEARS.\\n \* Read dynamically, so this class compiles whether or not the field exists\\n \* yet - create the field before running, not before saving the class.\\n \*/\\n public static final String SYNC\_FIELD = 'b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c';\\n\\n /\*\* True when SYNC\_FIELD actually exists on Job in this org. \*/\\n public static Boolean syncFieldExists() {\\n return hasField('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c', SYNC\_FIELD);\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Org-variable fields. Referenced by name, never statically. \*/\\n private static final String F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE = 'FOS\_Role\_Type\_\_c';\\n private static final String F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC = 'b3\_Business\_Process\_\_c';\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Branch + Location -> the fields on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c that\\n \* hold the two packs. Field NAMES are identical in Sandbox and Production\\n \* (verified 03/09/2026), only the Ids they hold differ - so this map is\\n \* org independent and no record Id ever appears in code or metadata.\\n \*\\n \* Per Aron 03/09/2026 only these five business processes are in use.\\n \* Fleet, CACIB, Customer Experience, Friends & Family, Returners,\\n \* Onsite with CV Upload and the FOS branch are deliberately not handled.\\n \*/\\n private static final Map<String, List<String>> PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE =\\n new Map<String, List<String>>{\\n\\n 'BAU|England & Wales' => new List<String>{ 'Clean\_BAU\_E\_W\_Process\_Document\_Collect\_\_c', 'Application\_Form\_Document\_Pack\_\_c' },\\n 'BAU|Northern Ireland' => new List<String>{ '(no subject)' : subject,\\n 'content' => content\\n };\\n if (cfg.Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c) {\\n body.put('mail\_settings', new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'sandbox\_mode' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'enable' => true } });\\n }\\n HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest();\\n req.setEndpoint('callout:SendGrid/v3/mail/send');\\n req.setMethod('POST');\\n req.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');\\n req.setHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer {!$Credential.Password}');\\n req.setTimeout(20000);\\n req.setBody(JSON.serialize(body));\\n return req;\\n }\\n\\n public static SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt settings() {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (cfg == null) {\\n throw new SendGridException('SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n }\\n return cfg;\\n }\\n}"

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* SendGrid Event Webhook receiver.\\n \* Expose via a public Site; configure SendGrid to POST to:\\n \* https://<site-domain>/services/apexrest/sendgrid/events?token=<Webhook\_Secret\_\_c>\\n \* Events carry our custom arg sf\_ref, which matches Task.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\\n \* on the activity logged at send time.\\n \*/\\n@RestResource(urlMapping='/sendgrid/events')\\nglobal without sharing class SendGridWebhook {\\n\\n @TestVisible private static String secretOverride;\\n\\n @HttpPost\\n global static void handleEvents() {\\n RestRequest req = RestContext.request;\\n RestResponse res = RestContext.response;\\n\\n // ponytail: shared-secret query param instead of ECDSA signature verification (unsupported by Apex Crypto)\\n String secret = secretOverride != null ? secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || req.params.get('token') != secret) {\\n res.statusCode = 401;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n List<Object> events;\\n try {\\n events = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(req.requestBody.toString());\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n res.statusCode = 400;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Keep only the newest event per sf\_ref in this batch.\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> latestByRef = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object o : events) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = (Map<String, Object>) o;\\n String ref = (String) ev.get('sf\_ref');\\n if (String.isBlank(ref)) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> current = latestByRef.get(ref);\\n if (current == null || epoch(ev) >= epoch(current)) {\\n latestByRef.put(ref, ev);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!latestByRef.isEmpty()) {\\n List<Task> updates = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task t : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = latestByRef.get(t.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n String reason = (String) ev.get('reason');\\n t.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = ((String) ev.get('event'))?.abbreviate(40);\\n t.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = reason?.abbreviate(255);\\n t.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(ev) \* 1000);\\n updates.add(t);\\n }\\n Database.update(updates, false);\\n }\\n res.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> ev) {\\n Object ts = ev.get('timestamp');\\n return ts == null ? 0 : Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(ts));\\n }\\n}"

},

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Flow/Apex entry point for sending email through SendGrid.\\n \* Mirrors the shape of a native email alert / Send Email action: give it a\\n \* template + Contact, or a raw address + body. It only publishes a platform\\n \* event, so it is safe to call from record-triggered flows, guest users and\\n \* bulk jobs; the actual callout happens async as the Automated Process user.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class SendGridEmailInvocable {\\n\\n public class Request {\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Email Template Name' description='DeveloperName of the Classic Email Template to render (merge fields resolved from Recipient Contact Id + Related Record Id)')\\n public String templateName;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Recipient Contact Id' description='Contact to send to (uses its Email). Also the Name/Who on the activity log.')\\n public Id recipientId;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Related Record Id' description='Record used for template merge fields and as the Related To of the activity log')\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='To Email Address' description='Send to this address instead of (or in addition to resolving) a Contact')\\n public String toAddress;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Subject' description='Subject when no template is used')\\n public String subject;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Plain Text Body' description='Body when no template is used')\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='HTML Body' description='HTML body when no template is used')\\n public String htmlBody;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='From Address' description='Must be a SendGrid verified sender. Defaults to SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.Default')\\n public String fromAddress;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='From Name')\\n public String fromName;\\n }\\n\\n @InvocableMethod(label='Send Email via SendGrid' category='Email'\\n description='Queues an email for delivery through SendGrid and logs a Task on the related record. Delivery status is updated by the SendGrid event webhook.')\\n public static void send(List<Request> requests) {\\n List<SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest> emails = new List<SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest>();\\n for (Request r : requests) {\\n if (String.isBlank(r.templateName) && String.isBlank(r.plainTextBody) && String.isBlank(r.htmlBody)) {\\n throw new SendGridEmailService.SendGridException('Send Email via SendGrid: provide an Email Template Name or a body.');\\n }\\n if (r.recipientId == null && String.isBlank(r.toAddress)) {\\n throw new SendGridEmailService.SendGridException('Send Email via SendGrid: provide a Recipient Contact Id or a To Email Address.');\\n }\\n SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest em = new SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest();\\n em.templateName = r.templateName;\\n em.recipientId = r.recipientId;\\n em.relatedRecordId = r.relatedRecordId;\\n em.toAddress = r.toAddress;\\n em.subject = r.subject;\\n em.plainTextBody = r.plainTextBody;\\n em.htmlBody = r.htmlBody;\\n em.fromAddress = r.fromAddress;\\n em.fromName = r.fromName;\\n emails.add(em);\\n }\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'SendGrid Invocable.');\\n SendGridEmailService.publish(emails);\\n }\\n}"

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update) {\\n\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) {\\n jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}"

},

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update) {\\n\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) {\\n jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}"

},

"title": "Reed SendGrid and document-reminder discovery 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"SendGrid",

"document-reminders",

"read-only",

"Reed"

\],

"content": "## SendGrid integration (unmanaged, verified)\\n- \`SendGridEmailInvocable\` is the Flow action \`Send Email via SendGrid\`; accepts \`templateName\` (classic EmailTemplate \`DeveloperName\`), \`recipientId\` (Contact), \`relatedRecordId\`, \`toAddress\`, \`subject\`, \`plainTextBody\`, \`htmlBody\`, \`fromAddress\`, \`fromName\`. It requires template/body and recipientId/toAddress, then calls \`SendGridEmailService.publish\`.\\n- \`SendGridEmailService\` publishes one \`SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e\` event per message (only \`Payload\_\_c\`, 131072 chars). Trigger \`SendGridEmailRequestTrigger\` invokes \`enqueueFromEvents\`; its \`CHUNK\_SIZE=50\`, creating \`SendJob\` Queueables (\`Database.AllowsCallouts\`). \`doSend\` renders the Salesforce classic email template (Contact + related record) and POSTs one message/callout to \`callout:SendGrid/v3/mail/send\`; custom arg \`sf\_ref\` is a random reference.\\n- Auth/config (no secret values read): Named Credential \`SendGrid\`, endpoint \`https://api.eu.sendgrid.com\`, protocol \`Password\`, principal type \`NamedUser\`, header merge enabled. \`SendGridEmailService\` forms a Bearer header via \`{!$Credential.Password}\`. CMT \`SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt\` record \`Default\` (\`m2PPv000006ZZibMAG\`) has fields \`Default\_From\_Address\_\_c\`, \`Default\_From\_Name\_\_c\`, \`Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c\`, \`Webhook\_Secret\_\_c\`; only nonsecret values read. \`Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c=false\`.\\n- \`SendGridWebhook\` is global public Apex REST \`/sendgrid/events\`, validates a query token against CMT (value not read), updates Task using \`sf\_ref\`; it does not verify SendGrid signed webhooks.\\n- Audit uses Task fields \`SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Status\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c\`; body is logged in Task Description. Recent sends/tasks and Queueables were created by \`Automated Process\` (\`005QH000003KaiLYAS\`) and delivered/bounced/open events were received. E.g. Task \`00TPv00000Ms5CXMAZ\` is \`bounce\` after a document upload message. Status counts: bounce 1, open 4, sent 2, delivered 1.\\n\\n## Important scale/safety gaps for 60k/day\\n- No scheduled SendGrid/reminder job discovered in CronTrigger; integration has no dispatcher, throttle, back-pressure, retry, or dead-letter mechanism.\\n- Every email is separate platform event + one SendGrid API call; 60k/day means 60k events and about 1,200 50-message Queueables, assuming no transaction-enqueue restriction. The current platform-event handler attempts one Queueable per 50 events but does not chain work or defend enqueue limits. Each Queueable can make 50 20-second-timeout callouts; actual platform-event entitlement and SendGrid rate limits are not exposed by \`get\_org\_limits\` and were not verified.\\n- HTTP >=300 or local validation errors are caught and logged as \`Failed\`, but never retried; Queueable/trigger enqueue failures are not recorded per email. No idempotency key is passed to SendGrid and a fresh \`sf\_ref\` is generated at send time, so at-least-once platform events/re-runs can duplicate sends.\\n- No check of \`Contact.HasOptedOutOfEmail\`, \`IsEmailBounced\`, \`EmailBouncedDate\`, Salesforce consent fields, or SendGrid suppression/unsubscribe mechanism. Contact \`003Pv00001MYQxoIAH\` currently has \`IsEmailBounced=true\`, demonstrating such records exist.\\n- Task \`WhatId\` cannot reference \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, so an assignment-level reminder log would lose its WhatId (the service retries Task insertion without it). Use related \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` for Task or add a dedicated reminder/log object.\\n\\n## Existing reminder/document implementation\\n- Active Flow \`Application\_Document\_Upload\_Auto\_Email\_with\_3B\_Form\_Link\` sends initial application document-upload mails through SendGrid on \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` CreateAndUpdate where \`TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c='Application'\`; its actions select hard-coded templates by job/business process, not document pack.\\n- Active \`Manual\_Doc\_Resend\` similarly selects template by Account/\`BH\_Business\_process\_\_c\`; active \`Bulk\_Resend\_DocumentUpload\` loops selected applications and calls SendGrid once per application. It is manual, not scheduled, and has no reminder idempotency/completeness filter. Draft \`Bulk\_Document\_reDocument\_Resend\_Executionsend\` uses native email alerts, not SendGrid.\\n- Existing active assignment flow is \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` version 4 (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`); current version 5 is Draft. It creates \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` on Application creation (base/new assignment and route/location packs). Do not extend version 5 inadvertently.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` is before-save on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` creation; it sets \`Application\_\_c\` from its \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` and \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\` attempt completeness by assembling pack document names and subtracting submissions for the same Contact + Assignment. The \`Are\_the\_any\_submissions\_left\` Yes branch has no connector; its No path only unhides the next assignment. There is no durable completion flag, reminder timestamp, count or cadence field on the document assignment.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` fields applicable for targeting: \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` (New/Submitted/Rejected/Approved), \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\` formula, \`Application\_\_c\`. No reminder fields. \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` keys are \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`.\\n- Existing app templates are hard-coded in SendGrid Flow actions: \`X2025\_BAU\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, \`X2025\_DO\_RMSS\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, \`X2025\_PFW\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, \`X2025\_PFW\_WH\_HUB\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, plus FOS/EOI variants. No default reminder template nor pack-to-template configuration found.\\n"

},

"title": "legacy document assignment algorithm findings",

"content": "Repo snapshot is current 3B Onboarding 11.6.0.NEXT / API 66 (sfdx-project.json:7-10), not v8.0; no v8 tag/history visible, so v8 behavior cannot be version-verified. Legacy source path retained: RemoteMyDocumentsController.getDocumentAssignments/getAssignments (lines 96-161) queries active assignments; getDocuments (70-92) fetches every Document whose pack is in a contact assignment subquery; getDocumentSubmissions (46-68) fetches all submissions for contact, no assignment/pack filter, ASC CreatedDate. userDocuments.getAssignments (applications/.../userDocuments.js:281-414) calls those, evaluates every document then groups by pack; submissions grouped by Document Id and attached to each doc. No JS dedupe: dashUtils.getRequestedDocuments lines 130-135 increments each visible Document row; latest = last submissions array entry (157-163).\\n\\nLegacy applicability: blank Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule => show; otherwise RemoteMyDocumentsController.validateRule lines 178-219 invokes RuleEngine(contactId,json), returns isRuleValid; userDocuments.js:438-475 does Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation true ? valid : !valid; errors false (448-461,491-505). Thus visible docs are all docs in active assignment pack after rule filtering, one per Document row.\\n\\nLegacy completion: dashUtils.getApprovedDocuments (lines 8-21) counts each visible doc if latest submission Status Approved AND Is\_Expired false; no Does\_Not\_Require\_Approval handling (TODO lines 3-6,17). getSubmittedDocuments lines 23-35 counts latest Approved or Pending Review only. getDocumentSubmissionStatus lines 144-155: no submission Waiting; expired overrides status; else status. UI canSubmit lines document.js:297-324 permits first/no submissions; Allow\_Editing\_Submitted\_Form if latest != Approved; Request Update/Rejected; expired/expiring soon. Assignment progress percent uses submitted not approved (dashAssignmentCompleteness.js:18-25). Old UI’s contact-wide getDocumentSubmissions causes cross-assignment reuse by Document Id.\\n\\nEvidence->submission joins/helpers (all active assignments, pack docs, nested prior submissions ordered Document then CreatedDate; source key maps latest, lock/reuse common):\\n- FormResponseHelper.createDocumentSubmissions lines 9-101; doc Form\_\_c -> b3f FormResponse.Form\_\_c, response must Type COMPLETE (105-127), contact or app match assignment (69-75), creates Document\_Submission with Form\_Response\_\_c (88-94). latestSubmissionPerForm keyed Form; skip if prior Status Approved/Pending Review and neither Is\_Expired nor Is\_Expiring\_Soon (77-85); otherwise create, so rejected/request update/expired/expiring permits replacement. Duplicate docs/sources can produce duplicate inserts because loops over each response/document and map not updated after toInsert.\\n- DocumentTraceHelper lines 7-104; Document\_Template\_\_c -> b3d Template, trace Template + contact/app, requires no error, Record\_ID, downloaded OR signed; update triggers downloaded/signed transition or Record\_ID change (107-137); creates Document\_Trace\_\_c pointer (89-95), same locked latest-per-template reuse logic lines 57-86.\\n- SubmitterHelper lines 8-97; Document\_\_c -> b3d agreement, Submitter.b3o\_\_Document\_\_c/contact and Signed\_Timestamp required (100-114); creates Submitter\_\_c pointer (82-88), latest-per-sign-doc lock/reuse lines 52-79.\\n- CandidateScorecardHelper lines 8-96; Question\_Set\_\_c -> Candidate\_Scorecard.Question\_Set\_\_c, active assignment contact only, shouldProcess always true (99-101), no pass/fail criterion, creates Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c pointer (81-87), latest-per-assessment lock/reuse lines 52-79.\\n- SessionInvitationHelper lines 7-97; Session\_\_c -> SessionInvitation.Session\_\_c, contact, process if schedule populated or status changes to Booked (100-114), creates Session\_Invitation\_\_c pointer (82-88), same latest-per-session lock/reuse (53-79).\\n- External\_Link\_\_c has no evidence helper found; no source path proves a submission/completion route.\\n\\nCommon lock/reuse: helpers only inspect nested submissions on same assignment; prior Approved/Pending Review nonexpired/nonexpiring locks source key. Rejected/Request Update or expired/expiring allows new. Completion itself is not evidence-type specific: always latest submission Approved + nonexpired. Document\_Submission fields link Assignment (lookup), Pack (lookup), Document (master-detail), and evidence pointers Form\_Response, Document\_Trace, Submitter, Candidate\_Scorecard, Session\_Invitation (metadata field files).\\n\\nCurrent branch (not legacy): RequestedDocumentsHelper builds assignment x pack-document queue (lines 31-87); RequestedDocsQueueProcessor materializes Requested\_Document records, evaluates same rule with errors hidden (lines 144-169), latest submission scoped (assignment,document) ASC CreatedDate (176-189), applyState completed iff latest Approved/nonexpired (193-211); RequestedDocumentRollups counts only visible required rows and submitted/completed flags (37-49); DocumentAssignmentProgressController reads only Requested\_Document rows, explicitly no rule engine (lines 1-6,34-51). DocumentSubmission.trigger auto-approves DNUA before insert then syncs materialized state (trigger lines 1-22; helper lines 8-32,37-75), unlike legacy getApproved TODO.\\n\\nRule context: RuleEngine is public inherited sharing, not global/callable (RuleEngine.cls:1,56-66,75-110). It loads Contact; child targetObject split object\*lookup (161-195), up to 500 ordered CreatedDate. RuleEngine\_Base walks relationship field paths and null parent fails (22-59). For TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c it queries child Applications where Applicant=Contact; E\_W\_Location\_\_c\*BOOLEAN target true is parsed by SchemaUtils.getValueAsObject/getBoolValue (71-80,115-117,145-147), FieldValueEvaluate BOOLEAN equals (89-112). No dedicated global evaluator; RuleEngine public not subscriber-visible. RemoteMyDocumentsController is global Callable and exposes call action validateRule (1-30,178-219), but it is a session-gated remote wrapper requiring contactId/sessionKey/documentId, not a raw subscriber Apex evaluator. CandidateComplianceEvaluator is global but evaluates legacy compliance profiles, not document conditional rules (lines 1-25,66-100)."

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* Reed case #00003380.\\n \*\\n \* Replicates the assignment logic of the record-triggered flow\\n \* \\"3B - Document Distribution Process\\" (Production V26) for EXISTING\\n \* Applications, which that flow can never reach because it only fires on\\n \* record CREATE.\\n \*\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* ONE CODEBASE, TWO ORGS\\n \*\\n \* Sandbox TRAIN does not have every field Production has:\\n \* - Job.FOS\_Role\_Type\_\_c Production only\\n \* - Application.b3\_Business\_Process\_\_c Production only\\n \* and its Business process picklist is missing \\"Friends & Family EOI\\",\\n \* \\"Returners\\", \\"Onsite with CV Upload\\", \\"Onsite\\" and \\"Customer Experience\\".\\n \*\\n \* So every org-variable field is read DYNAMICALLY and the SOQL is built from a\\n \* describe. }\\n\\n scanned += scope.size();\\n\\n Set<Id> appIds = (new Map<Id, SObject>(scope)).keySet();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (SObject app : scope) {\\n contactIds.add((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> alreadyLinked = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c existing : \[\\n SELECT Application\_\_c FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\\n WHERE Application\_\_c IN :appIds \]) {\\n alreadyLinked.add(existing.Application\_\_c);\\n }\\n\\n // \\"Get Old Application\\"\\n Datetime cutoff = System.now().addDays(-RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS);\\n List<String> priorFields = new List<String>{ 'Id', 'TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c' };\\n if (appHasBusProc) { priorFields.add(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC); }\\n\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact = new Map<Id, List<SObject>>();\\n for (SObject prior : Database.query(\\n 'SELECT ' + String.join(priorFields, ', ')\\n + ' FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c'\\n + ' WHERE TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c IN :contactIds AND CreatedDate >= :cutoff')) {\\n\\n Id contactId = (Id) prior.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c');\\n if (!priorByContact.containsKey(contactId)) {\\n priorByContact.put(contactId, new List<SObject>());\\n }\\n priorByContact.get(contactId).add(prior);\\n }\\n\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> toInsert = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n\\n for (SObject app : scope) {\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n if (alreadyLinked.contains(appId)) { skippedLinked++; continue; }\\n\\n SObject job = jobsById.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c'));\\n if (job == null) { skippedNoBranch++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Account Decision -------------------------------------------\\n String accountRoute = routeByAccount(job);\\n if (accountRoute == null) { skippedAccount++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Which branch ------------------------------------------------\\n if (accountRoute == 'FOS') { skippedFos++; continue; }\\n\\n String branch = routeByBusinessProcess(job);\\n\\n if (branch == null) { skippedNoBranch++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Standard 5 step sub-flow ------------------------------------\\n\\n // 1. New Application Assignment, unconditional\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, basePackId));\\n\\n // 2. Location filter\\n String location = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c'));\\n List<Id> packIds = packIdsByRule.get(ruleKey(branch, location));\\n if (packIds == null || packIds.isEmpty()) {\\n skippedNoPack++;\\n errorLog.add('No pack configured for \\"' + branch + '\\" / \\"' + location\\n + '\\" (Application ' + appId + ')');\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // 3. Previously Applied with us?\\n if (hasPriorApplication(app, job, priorByContact)) { skippedRecent++; continue; }\\n\\n // 4 + 5. Onboarding pack, then the hidden application form pack\\n for (Id packId : packIds) {\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, packId));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (toInsert.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(toInsert, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n assignmentsMade++;\\n } else {\\n failedRows++;\\n if (errorLog.size() < 100) {\\n errorLog.add('Application ' + toInsert\[i\].Application\_\_c + ': '\\n + results\[i\].getErrors()\[0\].getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // ROUTING\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Test-only hook. TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c is a formula reading through to the\\n \* Account, and Reed's Account validation rules make creating one in a test\\n \* impractical, so tests force the outcome here instead. 'NONE' means the\\n \* Default Outcome. Guarded by Test.isRunningTest() so it can never affect\\n \* live behaviour.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible private static String accountRouteOverride;\\n\\n /\*\* Account Decision. 'ANGARD', 'FOS', or null meaning do nothing. \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByAccount(SObject job) {\\n\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && accountRouteOverride != null) {\\n return accountRouteOverride == 'NONE' ? null : accountRouteOverride;\\n }\\n\\n String account = (String) job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c');\\n if (String.isBlank(account)) { return null; }\\n if (account.containsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_ANGARD\_CONTAINS)) { return 'ANGARD'; }\\n if (account.equalsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_FOS\_EQUALS)) { return 'FOS'; }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Business Process decision, in the flow's outcome order.\\n \* Business process and Business Area both live on the JOB.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByBusinessProcess(SObject job) {\\n\\n String bp = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'));\\n String area = String.valueOf(job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c'));\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(bp) || bp == 'null') { return null; }\\n\\n // BAU uses \\"Any Condition Is Met (OR)\\" across three values.\\n if (bp == 'BAU' || bp == 'Aviation' || bp == 'Onsite') { return 'BAU'; }\\n\\n if (bp == 'Delivery') { return 'Delivery'; }\\n if (bp == 'RMSS') { return 'RMSS'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW C&D') { return 'PFW C&D'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW WH HUB') { return 'PFW WH HUB'; }\\n\\n // Fleet, CACIB, Customer Experience, Friends & Family, Returners and\\n // Onsite with CV Upload are out of scope for this sync.\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* \\"Previously Applied with us?\\" - another application for the same applicant,\\n \* created inside the window. Production also requires the same business\\n \* process; where that field does not exist the date match alone is used.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private Boolean hasPriorApplication(SObject app, SObject job,\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact) {\\n\\n List<SObject> priors = priorByContact.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n if (priors == null) { return false; }\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n for (SObject prior : priors) {\\n if ((Id) prior.get('Id') == appId) { continue; }\\n if (!appHasBusProc) { return true; }\\n Object priorBp = prior.get(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC);\\n if (String.valueOf(priorBp) == String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'))) {\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // CONFIGURATION\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private static String ruleKey(String branch, String location) {\\n return branch + '|' + (String.isBlank(location) || location == 'null' ? '' : location);\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean hasField(String objectApi, String fieldApi) {\\n Schema.SObjectType t = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get(objectApi.toLowerCase());\\n return t != null && t.getDescribe().fields.getMap().containsKey(fieldApi.toLowerCase());\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Resolves every configured setting field to a live pack Id in THIS org.\\n \* Returns a reason to abort, or null when the configuration is usable.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String loadAndValidateConfiguration() {\\n\\n if (packIdsByRule != null) { return null; } // injected by a test\\n\\n packIdsByRule = new Map<String, List<Id>>();\\n hiddenPackIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n SObject setting = X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.getOrgDefaults();\\n if (setting == null) {\\n return 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c has no organisation defaults '\\n + 'in this org. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> settingFields =\\n Schema.SObjectType.X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.fields.getMap();\\n\\n List<String> problems = new List<String>();\\n Set<Id> configured = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n basePackId = readPack(setting, settingFields, SETTING\_FIELD\_BASE\_PACK, problems);\\n if (basePackId != null) { configured.add(basePackId); }\\n\\n for (String key : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.keySet()) {\\n List<Id> ids = new List<Id>();\\n for (String fieldName : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.get(key)) {\\n Id packId = readPack(setting, settingFields, fieldName, problems);\\n if (packId == null) { continue; }\\n ids.add(packId);\\n if (HIDDEN\_PACK\_FIELDS.contains(fieldName)) { hiddenPackIds.add(packId); }\\n configured.add(packId);\\n }\\n if (!ids.isEmpty()) { packIdsByRule.put(key, ids); }\\n }\\n\\n if (!problems.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'Document pack configuration is not usable in this org. Nothing was '\\n + 'created.\\\\n - ' + String.join(problems, '\\\\n - ');\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> live = new Map<Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c>(\[\\n SELECT Id FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c WHERE Id IN :configured \]).keySet();\\n\\n Set<Id> missing = new Set<Id>(configured);\\n missing.removeAll(live);\\n\\n if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'These Document Pack Ids are configured on '\\n + 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c but do not exist in this org: '\\n + String.join(new List<Id>(missing), ', ') + '. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n private Id readPack(SObject setting, Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> fields,\\n String fieldName, List<String> problems) {\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(fieldName)) { return null; }\\n\\n if (!fields.containsKey(fieldName.toLowerCase())) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName\\n + ' does not exist on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n Object raw = setting.get(fieldName);\\n String val = (raw == null) ? '' : String.valueOf(raw);\\n if (String.isBlank(val)) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' is empty in this org.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n try {\\n return (Id) val;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' does not hold a valid Id: ' + val);\\n return null;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // FINISH\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) {\\n\\n if (syncFieldExists() && !jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n Schema.SObjectType jobType = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get('tr1\_\_job\_\_c');\\n List<SObject> toReset = new List<SObject>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject j = jobType.newSObject(jobId);\\n j.put(SYNC\_FIELD, false);\\n toReset.add(j);\\n }\\n suppressTrigger = true;\\n try {\\n update toReset;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n errorLog.add('Could not reset Sync checkbox: ' + e.getMessage());\\n } finally {\\n suppressTrigger = false;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (abortReason != null) {\\n String failure = 'Sync Document Assignments - NOT RUN\\\\n\\\\n' + abortReason + '\\\\n';\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, failure);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - configuration error', failure);\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n String body =\\n 'Sync Document Assignments\\\\n\\\\n'\\n + 'Jobs ..................................... ' + jobIds.size() + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Applications scanned ..................... ' + scanned + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Document Assignments created ............. ' + assignmentsMade + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - already had an assignment ...... ' + skippedLinked + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - Account not Angard or FOS ...... ' + skippedAccount + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no matching branch ............. ' + skippedNoBranch + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - FOS account (out of scope) ..... ' + skippedFos + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no pack configured ............. ' + skippedNoPack + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - applied in last '\\n + RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS + ' days ......... ' + skippedRecent + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Failed rows .............................. ' + failedRows + '\\\\n';\\n\\n if (!errorLog.isEmpty()) {\\n body += '\\\\nDetail\\\\n------\\\\n';\\n for (String line : errorLog) { body += line + '\\\\n'; }\\n }\\n\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject job = jobsById.get(jobId);\\n if (job != null) {\\n body += '\\\\nJob: ' + job.get('Name')\\n + '\\\\n Account .......... ' + job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business process . ' + job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business Area .... ' + job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Location ......... ' + job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c');\\n if (jobHasRoleType) {\\n body += '\\\\n FOS Role Type .... ' + job.get(F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE);\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, body);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - '\\n + assignmentsMade + ' created, ' + failedRows + ' failed', body);\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // HELPERS\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c buildAssignment(SObject app, Id packId) {\\n return new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = (Id) app.get('Id'),\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = (Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'),\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = hiddenPackIds != null && hiddenPackIds.contains(packId)\\n );\\n }\\n\\n private void sendSummary(String subject, String body) {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest()) { return; }\\n try {\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage mail = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage();\\n mail.setToAddresses(new List<String>{ UserInfo.getUserEmail() });\\n mail.setSubject(subject);\\n mail.setPlainTextBody(body);\\n mail.setSaveAsActivity(false);\\n Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{ mail });\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, 'Summary email failed: ' + e.getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

#5787assistant.message15 Sept 2026, 19:42

▾{

"type": "assistant.message",

"agentId": "analyst\_mu2wceqn-U6yW1cyjUrw",

"role": "analyst",

"messageId": "am\_mu2wfz1n6RknK6d9ZbBv",

"text": "FINDINGS — An unmanaged SendGrid pipeline already sends and receives delivery events successfully, but it is not safe as-is for 60,000 reminders/day: it has no dispatcher, rate control, retry/dead-letter process, idempotency, or opt-out/bounce gate. Existing document flows provide assignment creation, initial/manual resend, and partial completeness evaluation; there is no scheduled reminder implementation, durable completeness state, default reminder template, or pack-to-template configuration. Core delivery runs as the \*\*Automated Process\*\* user, not the user who invokes the Flow.\\n\\nEVIDENCE —\\n- Unmanaged Apex: \`SendGridEmailInvocable\`, \`SendGridEmailService\`, \`SendGridWebhook\`, \`SendGridEmailRequestTrigger\`, and test \`SendGridTest\`; all are active.\\n- Invocation contract: Flow action \*\*Send Email via SendGrid\*\* / \`SendGridEmailInvocable.send(List<Request>)\`; inputs are \`templateName\`, \`recipientId\`, \`relatedRecordId\`, \`toAddress\`, \`subject\`, \`plainTextBody\`, \`htmlBody\`, \`fromAddress\`, \`fromName\`. It requires either \`templateName\` or a body, and either \`recipientId\` or \`toAddress\`.\\n- \`SendGridEmailService.publish()\` creates one \`SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e\` platform event per email; the event has only \`Payload\_\_c\` (131,072-char text).\\n- \`SendGridEmailRequestTrigger\` calls \`SendGridEmailService.enqueueFromEvents()\`, which groups events with \`CHUNK\_SIZE = 50\` and enqueues \`SendJob\` Queueables; each Queueable makes one SendGrid callout per email.\\n- Authentication is a Named Credential named \`SendGrid\`, enabled at the EU SendGrid API endpoint, with \`protocol=Password\`, \`principalType=NamedUser\`; the service uses the credential password merge field to construct the Bearer header. No secret value was retrieved or reported.\\n- Non-secret configuration is custom metadata \`SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt\`, record \`Default\` (\`m2PPv000006ZZibMAG\`), with fields \`Default\_From\_Address\_\_c\`, \`Default\_From\_Name\_\_c\`, \`Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c\`, and \`Webhook\_Secret\_\_c\`; \`Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c=false\`.\\n- \`SendGridWebhook\` exposes \`/sendgrid/events\`, matches webhook \`sf\_ref\` to \`Task.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\`, and updates \`SendGrid\_Status\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c\`, and \`SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c\`. It authenticates by query-token comparison rather than SendGrid signed-webhook verification.\\n- Delivery audit fields are on \`Task\`: \`SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Status\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c\`, \`SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c\`; rendered content is also stored in \`Task.Description\`.\\n- Recent pipeline evidence: Queueable \`707Pv00001gCyELIA0\` completed without errors; Task \`00TPv00000Ms5CXMAZ\` was created by \`Automated Process\` (\`005QH000003KaiLYAS\`) and updated to \`bounce\`. Current SendGrid Task statuses: 1 \`bounce\`, 4 \`open\`, 2 \`Sent\`, 1 \`delivered\`.\\n- No SendGrid/reminder scheduled Apex job was found in \`CronTrigger\`; no \`PlatformEventSubscriberConfig\` overrides exist. Core tasks and Queueables are created by \`Automated Process\`, confirming the platform-event execution context has the required Contact/template/Task/callout access.\\n- At 60k/day, the current design produces 60,000 platform events and approximately 1,200 50-email Queueables. The event handler has no chaining or enqueue-limit protection; the 50-callout Queueable design also has no throttle/back-pressure and each callout timeout is 20 seconds. Platform-event allocation and SendGrid account rate limits were not exposed by org limits and remain unverified.\\n- A SendGrid HTTP failure is logged as \`Failed\` but never retried; trigger/Queueable enqueue failures have no per-message durable log. A fresh random \`sf\_ref\` is generated at send time and no idempotency key is supplied, so replay/re-run can duplicate sends.\\n- The service queries Contact only for \`Id\`, \`Name\`, and \`Email\`; it does not check \`Contact.HasOptedOutOfEmail\`, \`IsEmailBounced\`, \`EmailBouncedDate\`, consent fields, or SendGrid suppression/unsubscribe state. A currently bounced Contact exists: \`003Pv00001MYQxoIAH\`, \`IsEmailBounced=true\`.\\n- \`Task.WhatId\` cannot reference \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`; passing either causes the service’s fallback insertion to remove \`WhatId\`. It can relate to \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\`.\\n- Active initial email Flow: \`Application\_Document\_Upload\_Auto\_Email\_with\_3B\_Form\_Link\`, on \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` Create/Update where \`TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c='Application'\`; its SendGrid actions select hard-coded templates by account/business process.\\n- Active manual resend Flow: \`Manual\_Doc\_Resend\`; active bulk resend Flow: \`Bulk\_Resend\_DocumentUpload\`. Both call \`SendGridEmailInvocable\` with templates selected by Account/\`BH\_Business\_process\_\_c\`; they are application-level, manual, and do not evaluate document completeness or reminder cadence.\\n- Existing document-email templates include \`X2025\_BAU\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, \`X2025\_DO\_RMSS\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, \`X2025\_PFW\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`, and \`X2025\_PFW\_WH\_HUB\_Candidate\_Document\_Upload\_HTML\`. No default reminder template or per-\`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\` template mapping was found.\\n- Active document-assignment Flow is \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` version 4 (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`); version 5 is Draft. Version 4 creates \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` from a new application and routes packs by job business process/location.\\n- Completion linkage is active Flow \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\`: on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` creation it sets \`Application\_\_c\` from \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`.\\n- Partial completeness logic exists in active Flows \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` and \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\`; both compare \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` records in a pack with \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` records for the same Contact/Assignment. Their \`Are\_the\_any\_submissions\_left\` “Yes” branch has no connector; the “No” path only unhides the next assignment, with no persisted completion result.\\n- Relevant assignment fields: \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` (\`New\`, \`Submitted\`, \`Rejected\`, \`Approved\`), \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, formula \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`, and \`Application\_\_c\`. There are no reminder, last-sent, next-send, attempt-count, or completion fields.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION — Reuse the SendGrid invocable/event pipeline only after adding a purpose-built, scheduled dispatcher with a durable reminder state/log record, unique idempotency key, retry policy and terminal-failure handling; do not use the current bulk Flow loop for the 60k/day workload. Target active, visible assignments and calculate outstanding documents from \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` versus \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\`; persist each sent cadence so re-runs cannot duplicate reminders, and relate Task audit rows to \`Application\_\_c\` while retaining assignment ID on the dedicated log. Add explicit exclusion of \`HasOptedOutOfEmail\`, \`IsEmailBounced\`, and the agreed consent/suppression policy; obtain confirmation of SendGrid rate limits, Salesforce platform-event allocation, and the intended reminder template/default-versus-pack mapping before implementation.",

#11381assistant.message15 Sept 2026, 19:43

▾{

"type": "assistant.message",

"agentId": "researcher\_mu2wceql8CGD0\_l\_MoiG",

"text": "FINDINGS — The retained legacy path determines applicable documents in the candidate UI: it loads active assignments, loads all documents in the contact’s assigned packs, evaluates each document’s conditional rule, and attaches contact-wide submissions by \`Document\_\_c\` Id. A document is completed only when its latest submission is \`Approved\` and \`Is\_Expired\_\_c\` is false; document type affects how a \`Document\_Submission\_\_c\` is created, not the final completion predicate. \`applications/user-documents\` still contains this legacy algorithm, but the repository snapshot is \`11.6.0.NEXT\`, not the org’s stated b3o \`8.0.0.1\`, so the behavior below is source-verified legacy code rather than version-verified 8.0 behavior. \[sfdx-project.json:7-10\]\\n\\nThe current branch additionally materializes \`b3o\_\_Requested\_Document\_\_c\` rows and calculates assignment counts server-side. Its completion rule remains latest submission \`Approved\` and non-expired, but its submission lookup is scoped to \`(Document Assignment, Document)\` rather than the legacy UI’s contact-wide grouping. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:176-211\]\\n\\nKEY FILES —\\n\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:46-92\`\\n - \`getDocumentSubmissions()\` queries all \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` records for the contact, ordered oldest-first, without an assignment or pack filter.\\n - \`getDocuments()\` queries all \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` records whose pack occurs on any assignment for the contact.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:96-161\`\\n - \`getDocumentAssignments()\` and \`getAssignments()\` select active assignments and their Document Pack/application relationships.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:178-219\`\\n - \`validateRule()\` invokes \`RuleEngine\` for one Contact/document rule and returns \`isRuleValid\`.\\n- \`applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:281-414\`\\n - Legacy orchestration: loads assignments, documents and submissions; evaluates every document; groups visible documents by pack; groups submissions by \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`; attaches the resulting submission list to each document row.\\n- \`applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:438-505\`\\n - Legacy conditional-rendering decision and error behavior.\\n- \`applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/dashUtils/dashUtils.js:8-35\`\\n - \`getApprovedDocuments()\` and \`getSubmittedDocuments()\`.\\n- \`applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/dashUtils/dashUtils.js:130-163\`\\n - \`All\_Documents\_Submitted\_\_c\` uses the analogous requested/submitted comparison. \[force-app/main/default/objects/Document\_Assignment\_\_c/fields/All\_Documents\_Submitted\_\_c.field-meta.xml:3-10\]\\n\\nCHAIN —\\n\\n1. \*\*Legacy assignment → pack → documents\*\*\\n\\n \`getAssignments()\` filters to \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c = true\`, the contact, and optionally a specific \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:138-161\] If a requested pack has no assignment, \`getDocumentAssignments()\` creates one and reloads it. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:116-135\]\\n\\n \`getDocuments()\` then fetches all documents whose \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\` is in a contact-based assignment subquery. It does not constrain the query to one assignment or application. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:70-92\]\\n\\n The JavaScript groups those documents by pack, evaluates visibility, and attaches the same pack-level document list to each matching assignment. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:344-377\] \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:388-409\]\\n\\n2. \*\*Legacy conditional rendering\*\*\\n\\n A document with no \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` is visible. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:438-445\]\\n\\n For a populated rule, the UI calls \`validateRule()\`, which constructs \`RuleEngine(contactId, jsonRule)\`, executes it, and returns the Boolean \`isRuleValid\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:193-218\]\\n\\n The final legacy visibility expression is:\\n\\n - \`Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c = true\` → show when \`isRuleValid = true\`.\\n - Otherwise → show when \`isRuleValid = false\`.\\n - A remote error or unsuccessful response hides the document. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:448-475\] \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:491-505\]\\n\\n \`RuleEngine\` always starts from a Contact. A child target such as \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` is split into object \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` and Contact lookup \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\`; related records are loaded with that lookup and ordered by \`CreatedDate\`, up to 500 records. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:56-66\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:161-195\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\]\\n\\n A condition item such as \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\*BOOLEAN\`, comparator \`equals\`, target value \`true\` is parsed as a Boolean and evaluated using Boolean equality. Null Boolean values are converted to \`false\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SchemaUtils.cls:71-80\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/SchemaUtils.cls:110-118\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/SchemaUtils.cls:141-147\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/FieldValueEvaluate.cls:89-112\]\\n\\n Relationship field paths are walked segment by segment; a null parent makes the condition false. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine\_Base.cls:22-59\]\\n\\n3. \*\*Legacy assignment → submissions\*\*\\n\\n \`getDocumentSubmissions()\` queries every submission for the contact, not just submissions whose \`Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` equals the current assignment. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:46-68\]\\n\\n The UI groups those submissions solely by \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` and attaches them to every visible document with that Id. The latest submission is the last element because the query is ordered by \`CreatedDate ASC\`. This allows contact-wide reuse across assignments and means the legacy UI can display a submission created under another assignment. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:313-340\] \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:379-403\] \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/dashUtils/dashUtils.js:157-163\]\\n\\n4. \*\*Completion and rejection behavior\*\*\\n\\n The legacy completed-document count evaluates only the latest submission for each visible document. It is completed when status is \`Approved\` and \`Is\_Expired\_\_c\` is false. A rejected, request-update, pending-review, missing, or expired latest submission is not completed. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/dashUtils/dashUtils.js:8-21\]\\n\\n The document UI treats no submission as \`Waiting Submission\`; expiry overrides the stored status for display. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/dashUtils/dashUtils.js:144-155\]\\n\\n A candidate may submit again when there is no submission, when editing of an unapproved submission is enabled, when the latest status is \`Rejected\` or \`Request Update\`, or when the latest submission is expired or expiring soon. \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/document/document.js:297-324\]\\n\\n5. \*\*Evidence-type joins and creation rules\*\*\\n\\n - \*\*Forms\*\*\\n - \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Form\_\_c\` identifies the form; matching \`b3f\_\_FormResponse\_\_c\` records are grouped by \`b3f\_\_Form\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:9-43\]\\n - A response qualifies only when its type is \`COMPLETE\` and it has a Contact or Application context. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:105-127\]\\n - Contact/application context must match the assignment; the response must reference the same form as the pack document. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:65-75\]\\n - The created \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` points to the assignment, pack, document and \`b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:88-94\]\\n - Prior submissions are keyed by Form Id. A prior \`Approved\` or \`Pending Review\` submission that is neither expired nor expiring soon suppresses creation; rejected, request-update, expired or expiring submissions permit a replacement. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:57-63\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:77-85\]\\n\\n - \*\*Generated documents / templates\*\*\\n - \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Document\_Template\_\_c\` identifies the CLM template; traces are grouped by \`b3d\_\_Template\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/DocumentTraceHelper.cls:7-41\]\\n - A trace qualifies only with a Contact/Application, no error, a nonblank record Id, and either downloaded or signed. Updates are processed for download/sign transitions or record-Id changes. \[force-app/main/default/classes/DocumentTraceHelper.cls:107-137\]\\n - The created submission points to \`b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/DocumentTraceHelper.cls:89-95\]\\n - Reuse/lock behavior is keyed by template and uses the same Approved/Pending Review plus non-expired/non-expiring test. \[force-app/main/default/classes/DocumentTraceHelper.cls:57-86\]\\n\\n - \*\*E-sign agreements\*\*\\n - \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` identifies the CLM agreement; \`b3d\_\_Submitter\_\_c.b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` identifies the same agreement. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SubmitterHelper.cls:19-37\]\\n - A Submitter qualifies only with a Contact and a populated \`b3d\_\_Signed\_Timestamp\_\_c\`; updates qualify when the signed timestamp or Contact changes. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SubmitterHelper.cls:100-114\]\\n - The created submission points to \`b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SubmitterHelper.cls:82-88\]\\n - Reuse/lock behavior is keyed by agreement/document Id and uses the same Approved/Pending Review plus non-expired/non-expiring test. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SubmitterHelper.cls:52-79\]\\n\\n - \*\*Assessments\*\*\\n - \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c\` identifies the assessment; \`b3o\_\_Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c.b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c\` is the match. \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateScorecardHelper.cls:8-40\]\\n - The helper’s \`shouldProcess()\` always returns true; it does not require a pass result. \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateScorecardHelper.cls:99-101\]\\n - The scorecard Contact must equal the assignment Contact, and the created submission points to \`b3o\_\_Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateScorecardHelper.cls:60-87\]\\n - Reuse/lock behavior is keyed by Question Set and uses the same status/expiry test. \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateScorecardHelper.cls:52-79\]\\n\\n - \*\*Sessions\*\*\\n - \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Session\_\_c\` identifies the session; \`b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c.b3o\_\_Session\_\_c\` is the match. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SessionInvitationHelper.cls:29-39\]\\n - An invitation qualifies when it has a schedule, or when an update changes the invitation status to \`Booked\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SessionInvitationHelper.cls:100-114\]\\n - The created submission points to \`b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SessionInvitationHelper.cls:82-88\]\\n - Reuse/lock behavior is keyed by Session Id and uses the same status/expiry test. \[force-app/main/default/classes/SessionInvitationHelper.cls:53-79\]\\n\\n - \*\*External links\*\*\\n - The repository shows only the URL field and no corresponding evidence helper or trigger path that creates a \`Document\_Submission\_\_c\` for it. \[force-app/main/default/objects/Document\_\_c/fields/External\_Link\_\_c.field-meta.xml:3-12\]\\n\\n6. \*\*Duplicate and reuse edge cases\*\*\\n\\n The helpers build a “latest” map once, keyed by the underlying source—not by the pack Document row—and do not update that map after adding records to \`toInsert\`. Consequently, duplicate qualifying source records or duplicate Document rows can produce multiple new \`Document\_Submission\_\_c\` records in one helper execution when no locked prior submission exists. \[force-app/main/default/classes/FormResponseHelper.cls:57-95\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/DocumentTraceHelper.cls:57-97\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/SubmitterHelper.cls:52-89\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateScorecardHelper.cls:52-89\] \[force-app/main/default/classes/SessionInvitationHelper.cls:53-89\]\\n\\n The legacy UI has a separate reuse behavior: it groups all contact submissions by Document Id, without checking assignment, so an existing submission can be reused visually across assignments. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:54-67\] \[applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:379-403\]\\n\\n7. \*\*Current branch versus legacy\*\*\\n\\n The current Requested Documents engine creates one queue item per assignment/pack-document pair. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocumentsHelper.cls:55-87\]\\n\\n It evaluates visibility using the same rule expression and inversion flag, but treats rule errors as hidden. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:144-169\]\\n\\n It selects the latest submission by \`(Document\_Assignment\_\_c, Document\_\_c)\`, then marks completion only when that latest row is \`Approved\` and not expired. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:176-211\]\\n\\n Current rollups count only Requested Document rows whose \`Is\_Required\_From\_Contact\_\_c\` is true. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocumentRollups.cls:37-49\]\\n\\n Current progress reads the materialized rows and explicitly does not invoke the rule engine. QUESTIONS —\\n\\n- The repository does not contain a b3o \`8.0.0.1\` source snapshot, tag, or version-specific directory. Its manifest identifies \`11.6.0.NEXT\` and API 66. \[sfdx-project.json:7-10,31-49\] The exact org-installed 8.0.0.1 implementation would require retrieving that package version’s source or inspecting the installed package metadata/code; the legacy algorithm above is therefore not proof that every 8.0.0.1 patch had identical behavior.\\n- There is no dedicated subscriber-facing global rule-evaluator class. \`RuleEngine\` is \`public\`, not \`global\`, and does not implement \`Callable\`. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:1-2,56-75\]\\n- \`RemoteMyDocumentsController\` is a global \`Callable\` wrapper and its global \`call()\` dispatches a \`validateRule\` action. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:1-30\] However, that route is session-gated and requires \`contactId\`, \`sessionKey\`, and \`documentId\`; \`validateRule()\` itself is private. \[force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:178-219\] It is technically callable as a remote wrapper, but it is not a clean raw evaluator API for subscriber Apex.\\n- \`CandidateComplianceEvaluator\` is global and invocable, but it evaluates legacy Compliance Rule/Profile records, not Document conditional-rendering JSON. \[force-app/main/default/classes/CandidateComplianceEvaluator.cls:1-25,66-100\]\\n- No repository evidence establishes a submission/completion path for \`External\_Link\_\_c\`; confirming that behavior in b3o 8.0.0.1 requires the installed package implementation or org-level runtime inspection.",

#11539tool.call15 Sept 2026, 19:44

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "analyst\_mu2wceqp8TJvehyeYosh",

"role": "analyst",

▾"input": {

"title": "Reed train legacy document completeness investigation",

▾"tags": \[

"reed",

"document-assignment",

"completeness",

"read-only",

"planning"

\],

"content": "## Scope and method\\nRead-only investigation on 2026-09-10. No metadata or records changed. Product-doc search for Document Assignment/Pack/Submission returned no results; findings are org metadata/data only.\\n\\n## Core model (API names)\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\` (51 records): reusable pack configuration. Relevant fields: \`b3o\_\_Disabled\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submit\_in\_Order\_\_c\`; children include \`b3o\_\_Documents\_\_r\` (\`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`), \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignments\_\_r\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\`.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` (191 records): one configured requirement in a pack. Required \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`; \`b3o\_\_Order\_\_c\`; exactly one target enforced by active VRs \`A\_target\_is\_required\` and \`One\_target\_is\_required\`: \`b3o\_\_Form\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Template\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Session\_\_c\`, or \`b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\`. Formula \`b3o\_\_Type\_\_c\` resolves Form / Question Set / External Link / Document Template / Session / Document. Counts: 170 Form, 15 Question Set, 5 Document Template, 1 Document, 0 Session, 0 External Link.\\n- Conditional configuration is \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` (long-text JSON) and inverse checkbox \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` (by default a true evaluation hides the document). Explicit full sample of all 191 Documents returned null for both any conditional value (all rules are null) and \`Show...\` was false for all. Thus production’s reported TR1 Application/\`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` rule is NOT present in this sandbox and must not be assumed here.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` (345 records): per Contact/pack obligation. Required \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`; optional native 3B links \`b3o\_\_X3B\_Application\_\_c\`/\`b3o\_\_X3B\_Placement\_\_c\`, and Reed custom \`Application\_\_c\` -> \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\`. Status values \`New, Submitted, Rejected, Approved\`. All 345 current assignments are \`New\`. Formula \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c = !Hide\_from\_Candidate && Status nonblank && (Due\_Date blank or >= TODAY())\`; it does not use submission/completeness. Other relevant fields: \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Assignment\_Message\_\_c\`. No native total/completed/pending/% field.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` (148 records): evidence record. Required \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` + \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`; optional \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`Application\_\_c\` -> TR1 app, \`b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c\`, Session Invitation. Status values \`Approved, Rejected, Pending Review, Request Update\`; current: 141 Pending Review, 7 Rejected, 0 Approved. \`b3o\_\_Approved\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Rejected\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Requested\_Update\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, Reed verification fields \`b3\_Verified\_Date\_\_c\`/\`b3\_Rejected\_Date\_\_c\`, and expiry formulas \`b3o\_\_Expiring\_In\_Days\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expired\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expiring\_Soon\_\_c\` exist. 130 submissions have assignment populated; 18 do not. 29 lack \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`.\\n\\n## Completeness and evidence\\n- Form evidence: \`b3f\_\_FormResponse\_\_c\` Type values include COMPLETE/DRAFT/AUTOSAVE/FAILED. All 55 distinct Form Responses referenced by a Document Submission are \`COMPLETE\`; current sampled response creators are \`Standard\` / System Administrator, not a candidate context.\\n- Signature/document evidence: \`b3d\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\` has \`b3d\_\_Document\_Signed\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Document\_Downloaded\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Document\_Successfully\_Rendered\_\_c\`, derived Status. Two traces linked by submissions are rendered+downloaded, neither signed. \`b3d\_\_Submission\_Request\_\_c\` has \`b3d\_\_Invited\_Submitters\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Opened\_Submitters\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Signed\_Submitters\_\_c\`, with a formula status Completed/In Progress. \`b3d\_\_Submitter\_\_c\` has Opened/Started/Signed/Rejection timestamps. \\n- \`b3o\_\_Agreement\_\_c\` is commercial (Account, Invoice Configuration/Cycle) and has no Contact/Application/Document Assignment join; the Collection pack’s document named “Agreements” is a \`b3f\_\_Form\_\_c\` target, not that Agreement object.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` does a local \`DocCount\` and \`SubmissionCount\` loop on document/submission creation, matches submissions by same Contact + Assignment and subtracts names from a string; it does not persist a count/status/% and does not evaluate submission status or conditional rendering. It only makes a hidden application-form assignment visible once its string comparison has no outstanding names.\\n\\n## Actual sandbox pack content/configuration\\n- Count distribution: 27 packs have Documents, with 1–11 documents; 24 other packs have zero document children.\\n- Representative pack \`a5ZPv000000R81VMAS\` (“Clean Delivery Process E&W– Document Collection”) has 10 Documents, orders 1–10: one Question Set (\`a5bPv00000053y9IAA\`) and 9 Forms including \`a5bPv000000546EIAQ\` “Pre-Start Agreement – Data Privacy Statement” and \`a5bPv00000054B3IAI\` “Agreements”; no conditions. It has 34 assignments and 105 submissions. Assignment \`a5YPv000000BvFtMAK\` is Active/New and has one pending submission \`a5aPv000001VwP0IAK\` for doc \`a5bPv000000549RIAQ\`.\\n- Example PFW C&D E&W pack \`a5ZPv000000R89ZMAS\` has 11 requirements: Question Set + 10 Forms (including Agreements); no conditions.\\n- Current org-default \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\` record \`a6QQH0000003rUP2AY\` points base/onboarding/application fields to newer \`a5ZPv000001Ju...\` packs: e.g. base \`JuQv\`, BAU E&W \`JuQy\`, Delivery E&W \`JuR1\`, RMSS E&W \`JuRD\`, application \`JuRG\`; none of the seven queried configured pack IDs has any \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` child. Explicitly, \`JuRG\` (“New Application Document Pack”) has 55 assignments and 0 Documents. This is a material data/configuration condition before calculating counts.\\n- Simultaneous/repeated assignments exist: one anonymised Contact ID has 24 assignments across distinct app/pack combinations; highest values were 26,25,24,19,18. 19 assignment IDs have >1 submission (nine have 10 each). Count logic must anchor to assignment, not Contact, and dedupe/document-key submissions if a completed doc means “one per configured Document.”\\n\\n## Active automation (do not change managed components)\\n- Managed Apex triggers present: \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\`, \`b3o\_\_DocumentPackTrigger\`; managed package source not altered/reviewed.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` v4: after-save on \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` create where Job and Applicant populated; creates \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` with \`Application\_\_c=$Record.Id\`, Contact=$Record.Applicant, Status=New. It contains hardcoded pack ids, e.g. \`Onboard\_Document\_Assignment\` points to \`a5ZPv000001JuRGMA0\` (the zero-document New Application pack). Latest v5 is Draft, not active.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Manually\_Triggering\_Document\_Assignment\_Application\` v1: after-save on TR1 Application update when Job/Applicant exist and \`BH\_Document\_Assignment\_resubmitted\_\_c\` is true. Gets/hides prior assignments, routes by Job business process/location and creates onboarding + hidden application assignments using the \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\` settings.\\n- Active screen Flow \`X3B\_Sync\_Document\_Assignment\_from\_Job\` writes \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` (singular) true. Active unmanaged \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` invokes \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\`, but its \`SYNC\_FIELD\` is plural \`b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c\`, which does not exist (SOQL error); trigger returns when \`syncFieldExists()\` false. Do not alter in this scope; reconcile separately before relying on sync.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` (before-save, Document Submission create) reads parent Assignment by Id+Contact and copies its \`Application\_\_c\` to the submission.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Notify\_Candidate\_of\_Rejected\_Document\_Submission\` (after-save Document Submission, Status changed to Rejected) creates portal session key and calls \`SendGridEmailInvocable\`.\\n- Active staff Screen Flow \`X3B\_Document\_Submission\` updates \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` and verification/rejection-by/date fields on submission (Approve/Reject/Revert). Unmanaged FlexiPage \`Document\_Submission\_Record\_Page1\` embeds that flow and a \`Doc\_Sub\_Preview\` VF preview.\\n- Active Application \`Application\_Document\_Upload\_Auto\_Email\_with\_3B\_Form\_Link\` creates a portal session key and sends process-specific document-upload email via SendGrid on \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` when Stage=Application. Active \`Bulk\_Resend\_DocumentUpload\` is invocable/manual and resends process-specific candidate document-upload emails.\\n- Tooling query found no validation rules on Assignment, Pack, or Submission; Document has the two target-selection rules noted above. WorkflowRule query needs a corrected field projection (the attempted \`Active\` field was unsupported), so workflow-rule absence was not established.\\n\\n## UI and permissions\\n- \`list\_metadata Layout\` and Tooling Layout lookup returned no Layout components for these names. Staff UI uses FlexiPages: managed \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_Record\_Page\` has Highlights + \`force:detailPanel\` and a sidebar related list \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\` (10 rows); it has no Dynamic Forms fields. \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_Record\_Page\` is basic detail/related list. Unmanaged \`Document\_Submission\_Record\_Page1\` adds Preview and embeds staff verification flow.\\n- Existing named permission sets with Assignment FLS: \`Angard\` (119 users) and \`Cacib\` (1 user) grant read-only \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c.b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` and \`.b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`; neither grants existing Due Date FLS. \`Query\_All\_Files\` (2 users) grants object read on all four document objects but no existing status/active FLS result. Named set \`Recruiter\` has no object-permission row for these four objects. Profiles carry much of the object/FLS access; their parent names are internal IDs in Tooling, so no named staff persona beyond Angard/Cacib is evidenced.\\n\\n## Context certainty\\n- Assignment creation is metadata-demonstrated in Application-triggered flows and the Job screen/button path above. All sampled assignments/submissions/form responses were CreatedBy a Standard/System Administrator user, which is sandbox fixture/provenance only, not proof of production candidate execution.\\n- Candidate-side Document Submission creation is not demonstrated by accessible unmanaged metadata; the pack's Form/Question Set/Document targets and managed \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` trigger imply package/portal processing, but the exact candidate execution context remains unverified. No PII (names/emails/form contents) collected."

},
