#14923assistant.message15 Sept 2026, 19:44

▾{

"type": "assistant.message",

"agentId": "analyst\_mu2wceqp8TJvehyeYosh",

"role": "analyst",

"messageId": "am\_mu2wiz7cJeeppGUQNOYI",

"text": "FINDINGS — The legacy model is pack-driven: \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\` contains reusable \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` requirement rows, while each \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` is the candidate-specific pack instance and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` is the completion/review evidence. There is no native requested-document child object or native assignment-level total, completed, pending, or percentage field; assignment \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` is not a reliable completion indicator because all 345 sandbox assignments are still \`New\` despite 148 submissions.\\n\\nThe sandbox has no configured document conditional-rendering rules: all 191 \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` rows have null \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` and false \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\`. The reported production TR1 Application \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c = true\` condition is therefore not a sandbox fact and must be independently migrated or recreated before conditional completeness can be verified.\\n\\nEVIDENCE —\\n- Scratchpad: findings and API names recorded in \*\*“Reed train legacy document completeness investigation.”\*\* No org data or metadata was changed.\\n- Product documentation search for “Document Assignment Document Pack Document Submission conditional documents completion” returned no matches; conclusions are based on this org’s describes, data, and metadata.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`: 51 records. Configuration fields are \`b3o\_\_Disabled\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Submit\_in\_Order\_\_c\`; child relationships are \`b3o\_\_Documents\_\_r\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignments\_\_r\`, and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\`.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`: 191 records, with required \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`. Its relevant configuration is \`b3o\_\_Order\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` (JSON), \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Allow\_Editing\_Submitted\_Form\_\_c\`, and expiry-warning setting \`b3o\_\_Expiring\_Soon\_Warning\_Days\_\_c\`.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Type\_\_c\` is a formula based on exactly one target: \`b3o\_\_Form\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Template\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Session\_\_c\`, or \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`. Actual counts: 170 Form, 15 Question Set, 5 Document Template, 1 Document, 0 Session, 0 External Link.\\n- Active validation rules on \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`: \`A\_target\_is\_required\` (“Please provide a Document, Template, Form, Question Set or an External Link to this document”) and \`One\_target\_is\_required\` (“Only one target is allowed”). No validation-rule rows were returned for Assignment, Pack, or Submission.\\n- Full explicit-field query of all 191 Document rows (\`Id\`, \`Name\`, Pack, \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\`) found no non-null condition. The long-text field cannot be filtered by SOQL, so this full scan was necessary.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`: 345 records. Required joins are \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`; optional joins are managed \`b3o\_\_X3B\_Application\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_X3B\_Placement\_\_c\`, and Reed \`Application\_\_c\` to \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\`. \`Application\_\_c\` is populated on 248 assignments; no assignments use \`b3o\_\_X3B\_Application\_\_c\`.\\n- Assignment status values are \`New\`, \`Submitted\`, \`Rejected\`, \`Approved\`; aggregate result: \*\*345 New\*\*. \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\` is only \`NOT(Hide\_from\_Candidate)\`, nonblank status, and no expired due date; it does not inspect submissions.\\n- Assignment fields relevant to reminders/visibility are \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Assignment\_Message\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, and formula \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`. No assignment field stores a total/count/percentage/completeness status.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\`: 148 records. Required joins are \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`; optional joins are \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`Application\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c\`.\\n- Submission statuses are \`Approved\`, \`Rejected\`, \`Pending Review\`, \`Request Update\`; actual distribution is \*\*141 Pending Review, 7 Rejected, 0 Approved\*\*. Candidate submission should therefore be distinguished from staff approval: counting only Approved would produce zero current completions.\\n- Submission review/completeness evidence fields include \`b3o\_\_Approved\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Rejected\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Requested\_Update\_Timestamp\_\_c\`, \`b3\_Verified\_Date\_\_c\`, \`b3\_Rejected\_Date\_\_c\`, \`b3\_Verified\_By\_\_c\`, \`b3\_Rejected\_By\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Valid\_Until\_\_c\`, and formulas \`b3o\_\_Expiring\_In\_Days\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expired\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expiring\_Soon\_\_c\`.\\n- Link quality is mixed: 130 submissions have \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, 18 do not; 29 submissions lack \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`; 18 lack \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`. Assignment-based completeness must not assume every historical submission is linkable.\\n- Completion evidence is normally form-backed: the 55 distinct \`b3f\_\_FormResponse\_\_c\` records referenced by Document Submissions are all \`b3f\_\_Type\_\_c = COMPLETE\`. The sampled sandbox records were CreatedBy a Standard/System Administrator user, so they do not demonstrate live candidate execution context.\\n- Signature/document evidence is also available through \`b3d\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`: fields include \`b3d\_\_Document\_Signed\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Document\_Downloaded\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Document\_Successfully\_Rendered\_\_c\`, and derived \`b3d\_\_Status\_\_c\`. The two submission-linked traces are rendered and downloaded, neither signed.\\n- \`b3d\_\_Submission\_Request\_\_c\` additionally has \`b3d\_\_Invited\_Submitters\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Opened\_Submitters\_\_c\`, \`b3d\_\_Signed\_Submitters\_\_c\`, and a derived Completed/In Progress status; \`b3d\_\_Submitter\_\_c\` has opened, started, signed, and rejected timestamps.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Agreement\_\_c\` is not candidate-document completion evidence: it only relates to Account and invoice configuration/cycle. The collection document named “Agreements” is a Form target, not a \`b3o\_\_Agreement\_\_c\` record.\\n- Representative actual pack: \`a5ZPv000000R81VMAS\`, \*\*Clean Delivery Process E&W– Document Collection\*\*, has 10 configured Documents: 1 Question Set and 9 Forms. Orders 7 and 10 are “Pre-Start Agreement – Data Privacy Statement” (\`a5bPv000000546EIAQ\`) and “Agreements” (\`a5bPv00000054B3IAI\`); all ten have no conditional rule. This pack has 34 assignments and 105 submissions.\\n- Assignment \`a5YPv000000BvFtMAK\` is Active/New against that Delivery pack and has a pending submission \`a5aPv000001VwP0IAK\` for configured document \`a5bPv000000549RIAQ\`, demonstrating the Assignment → Submission join.\\n- Multiple simultaneous/repeated assignments exist. An anonymised Contact has 24 assignments, while other highest counts are 26, 25, 19, and 18. Nineteen assignment records have multiple submissions; nine have 10 each. Any calculation must anchor to Assignment Id, rather than Contact, and de-duplicate to one qualifying result per configured Document Id.\\n- Active Flow \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` has local variables \`DocCount\` and \`SubmissionCount\`, but persists neither. It loads all Documents in the pack and all Submissions for the same Contact + Assignment, compares document names in a text string, and only uses the result to reveal a hidden application-form assignment; it does not evaluate submission status or document conditional rules.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` is a before-save Submission flow. It reads the Assignment by Id and Contact and copies \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c.Application\_\_c\` onto \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c.Application\_\_c\`.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Notify\_Candidate\_of\_Rejected\_Document\_Submission\` is an after-save Submission flow, triggered when Status changes to Rejected. It sets \`b3\_Portal\_Session\_Key\_\_c\` and invokes \`SendGridEmailInvocable\`.\\n- Active staff screen flow \`X3B\_Document\_Submission\`, embedded on \`Document\_Submission\_Record\_Page1\`, permits Verify/Reject/Revert and updates submission \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` plus verified/rejected-by/date fields.\\n- Managed triggers \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` and \`b3o\_\_DocumentPackTrigger\` exist; they were not altered or used as a basis for unsupported assumptions about candidate-side creation.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` v4 runs after \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` creation where Job and Applicant are populated and creates Assignment records with \`Application\_\_c\`, applicant Contact, and \`New\` status. The newer v5 is Draft, not active.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Manually\_Triggering\_Document\_Assignment\_Application\` v1 runs after an Application update where \`BH\_Document\_Assignment\_resubmitted\_\_c = true\`; it hides prior assignments and creates replacement assignments using Job business process/location and \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\`.\\n- Org-default \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\` record \`a6QQH0000003rUP2AY\` points the base, BAU E&W, Delivery E&W, RMSS E&W, and application pack settings to newer \`a5ZPv000001Ju…\` packs. None of the seven queried configured pack IDs has any \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` child; specifically \`a5ZPv000001JuRGMA0\` (“New Application Document Pack”) has 55 assignments and zero Documents.\\n- Active Job screen flow \`X3B\_Sync\_Document\_Assignment\_from\_Job\` sets \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` (singular). Existing \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` calls \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\`, whose \`SYNC\_FIELD\` is plural \`b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c\`; that field does not exist. Its \`syncFieldExists()\` guard therefore prevents the batch path from running. This discrepancy was only observed, not changed.\\n- FlexiPages, rather than Dynamic Forms, provide the record UI. Managed \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_Record\_Page\` has a standard detail panel and a 10-row \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\` sidebar related list. \`list\_metadata Layout\` and Tooling Layout lookup did not return a named Layout for the four objects, so the underlying detail-panel layout could not be identified from accessible metadata.\\n- Named persona permission sets evidenced for potential staff-visible Assignment fields are \`Angard\` (119 assigned users) and \`Cacib\` (1). Both grant read-only FLS to existing \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c.b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\` and \`.b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`; neither grants Due Date FLS. \`Query\_All\_Files\` (2 users) grants read access to all four document objects. The \`Recruiter\` permission set has no ObjectPermissions row for these objects; remaining access is profile-based and profile names were not exposed by the Tooling results.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION —\\n- Treat an assignment-level summary as an independent derived calculation over \*\*that Assignment’s Pack Documents\*\* and \*\*that Assignment’s Submissions\*\*, not as a reuse of \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c.b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`. Decide explicitly whether “completed” means candidate submitted (\`Pending Review\` and/or \`Approved\`) or staff-approved (\`Approved\` only), and document how Rejected/Request Update, duplicates, expired evidence, and future conditional documents affect numerator and denominator.\\n- Resolve the zero-document current-pack configuration before designing or testing counts. A total of zero for the settings-driven \`a5ZPv000001Ju…\` packs is presently expected from sandbox configuration, not evidence that a candidate has completed a pack.\\n- Preserve Assignment as the calculation key to support concurrent packs and multiple applications for the same Contact. Include a unique Document Id rule to prevent repeated submissions inflating completion.\\n- Treat conditional denominator support as a production migration requirement, not a currently testable sandbox feature; validate the production JSON rule syntax and the execution-time application context before adopting it.\\n- Keep the existing managed triggers untouched. Assess the singular/plural sync-field mismatch as a separate defect before relying on the Job sync path, and avoid extending the legacy \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` flow because its current name-based counting is non-persistent and not status- or condition-aware.\\n- For eventual staff visibility, extend the Assignment record page/detail layout path and grant read-only FLS through the existing \`Angard\`/\`Cacib\` persona sets only after confirming the intended staff profiles; new fields would otherwise remain invisible to staff.",

"technical": "## Scope and status\\nRead-only investigation in reed2--train, API62. Installed Onboarding8.0.0.1, Forms6.13.0.1, CLM8.100.1.1, Digital Experiences5.14.0.1. No metadata staged, checkOnly validation or deployment performed. GitHub not configured.\\n## Evidence\\nSandbox has 345 assignments, 191 Document rows, 51 packs,148 submissions (141 Pending Review,7 Rejected). Assignment Status all New; no persisted progress or reminder fields. Native Requested Document object absent. No sandbox document conditional rules; production's reported144 documents/one rule is user-provided, not independently verified. Some settings-selected packs have no documents; 18 submissions lack assignment and29 lack document links. Do not infer completeness from Status or raw submission count.\\n## Product source\\nDocumentation searches yielded no matching documentation. Repo snapshot11.6.0.NEXT is not verified8.0 source. Retained legacy userDocuments.js/dashUtils.js and RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls use contact-wide latest submission per Document; approved non-expired means completed, Approved/Pending Review means submitted. RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls uses Assignment+Document evidence; RequestedDocumentRollups.cls counts required rows. RuleEngine is public not global; global controller Callable is candidate-session gated, not a clean scheduled evaluation API. Conditions use Contact context and object\*lookup child selectors plus a show-on-success inversion setting. Exact installed-version and multiple-child semantics need confirmation.\\n## Existing automation\\nX3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process activev4 creates assignments; v5 Draft must be preserved. Existing progression flows use non-persisted name-based counts, not adequate for this requirement. Existing rejection notifications and initial/manual sends must remain intact.\\n## SendGrid\\nUnmanaged SendGridEmailInvocable, SendGridEmailService, SendGridWebhook and SendGridEmailRequestTrigger use SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e then Queueables in50-email groups; one callout per email. Named Credential SendGrid; no secrets retrieved. SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.Default Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c=false. Delivery runs as Automated Process, with Task-based webhook tracking. Missing durable reminder dispatcher, idempotency, retry/back-pressure and opt-out/bounce checks; platform event and SendGrid capacity unverified. Assignment/Pack unsupported by Task.WhatId; dedicated assignment correlation required. SendGrid webhook uses token comparison rather than signed verification. No real-email testing authorized.\\n## Open decisions\\nCandidate-action progress versus approved progress; concurrent assignment evidence scope; contact-wide conditional parity versus assignment context; per-assignment emails versus candidate digest; first send, timezone, duration/frequency, hidden/expired assignments, rollout backlog; refresh SLA; templates and safe portal links; staff access. Native switch must preserve reminder history and account for semantic differences, not simply uninstall fields.\\n## Follow-up\\nNo production data repairs, changes to existing automation, or job-sync fixes are in scope. Sandbox empty packs and missing evidence links need representative test fixtures/admin preparation. Detailed org API names and evidence are in session scratchpad.",

"endUser": "We inspected the sandbox and the product repository; nothing has been changed or sent. Candidates' submissions awaiting staff review must be distinguished from documents they still need to provide. The existing SendGrid integration can be reused, but needs safeguards before high-volume reminders are enabled. Some sandbox packs are empty, so representative pack configuration is needed for acceptance testing. Next we will agree the progress/reminder rules, then submit a build plan for approval. No manual action is required yet; do not enable live reminder sending during investigation.",

\]

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Core SendGrid email pipeline.\\n \*\\n \* publish() -> one SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e platform event per email (any context, incl. guest users)\\n \* enqueueFromEvents()-> called by the platform event trigger, which runs as the Automated Process user,\\n \* so EmailTemplate access and Contact visibility never depend on the calling user\\n \* SendJob -> renders the template, POSTs to SendGrid, logs a Task on the target record\\n \*\\n \* The webhook (SendGridWebhook) later updates the Task with real delivery status.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class SendGridEmailService {\\n\\n public class SendGridException extends Exception {}\\n\\n public class EmailRequest {\\n public String templateName;\\n public Id recipientId;\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n public String toAddress;\\n public String subject;\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n public String htmlBody;\\n public String fromAddress;\\n public String fromName;\\n public String reference; // correlates the Task with SendGrid webhook events\\n }\\n\\n // ponytail: 50 emails (= 50 callouts) per async transaction; raise toward the 100-callout limit if throughput matters\\n @TestVisible private static Integer CHUNK\_SIZE = 50;\\n\\n /\*\* Queue emails for async delivery. Callable from Apex for bulk sends. \*/\\n public static void publish(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events = new List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n events.add(new SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e(Payload\_\_c = JSON.serialize(em)));\\n }\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Events to process:' + events.size());\\n\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : EventBus.publish(events)) {\\n if (!sr.isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n throw new SendGridException('Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n }else{\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Published Event Successfully');\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Platform event trigger handler: fan events out into queueable send jobs. \*/\\n public static void enqueueFromEvents(List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Queue from platform events');\\n List<EmailRequest> chunk = new List<EmailRequest>();\\n for (SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e ev : events) {\\n chunk.add((EmailRequest) JSON.deserialize(ev.Payload\_\_c, EmailRequest.class));\\n if (chunk.size() == CHUNK\_SIZE) {\\n System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk));\\n chunk = new List<EmailRequest>();\\n }\\n }\\n if (!chunk.isEmpty()) {\\n System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public class SendJob implements Queueable, Database.AllowsCallouts {\\n private List<EmailRequest> emails;\\n public SendJob(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n this.emails = emails;\\n }\\n public void execute(QueueableContext ctx) {\\n doSend(emails);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public static void doSend(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = settings();\\n\\n Set<String> templateNames = new Set<String>();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) {\\n templateNames.add(em.templateName);\\n }\\n if (em.recipientId != null) {\\n contactIds.add(em.recipientId);\\n }\\n }\\n Map<String, Id> templateIdByName = new Map<String, Id>();\\n for (EmailTemplate t : \[SELECT Id, DeveloperName FROM EmailTemplate WHERE DeveloperName IN :templateNames\]) {\\n templateIdByName.put(t.DeveloperName, t.Id);\\n }\\n Map<Id, Contact> contacts = new Map<Id, Contact>(\[SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Id IN :contactIds\]);\\n\\n // All callouts happen before any DML (Task inserts) — required ordering.\\n List<Task> logs = new List<Task>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n em.reference = EncodingUtil.convertToHex(Crypto.generateAesKey(128));\\n Contact who = contacts.get(em.recipientId);\\n String toAddr = String.isNotBlank(em.toAddress) ? em.toAddress : who?.Email;\\n String subject = em.subject;\\n String plainBody = em.plainTextBody;\\n String htmlBody = em.htmlBody;\\n\\n Task log = new Task(\\n Status = 'Completed',\\n TaskSubtype = 'Email',\\n ActivityDate = Date.today(),\\n WhoId = em.recipientId,\\n WhatId = em.relatedRecordId,\\n SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c = em.reference,\\n SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = System.now()\\n );\\n try {\\n if (String.isBlank(toAddr)) {\\n throw new SendGridException('No recipient email address.');\\n }\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) {\\n Id templateId = templateIdByName.get(em.templateName);\\n if (templateId == null) {\\n throw new SendGridException('Email template not found: ' + em.templateName);\\n }\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage rendered =\\n Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(templateId, em.recipientId, em.relatedRecordId);\\n subject = rendered.getSubject();\\n plainBody = rendered.getPlainTextBody();\\n htmlBody = rendered.getHtmlBody();\\n }\\n HttpResponse res = new Http().send(buildRequest(cfg, em, toAddr, who?.Name, subject, plainBody, htmlBody));\\n if (res.getStatusCode() >= 300) {\\n throw new SendGridException('SendGrid returned ' + res.getStatusCode() + ': '\\n + (res.getBody() == null ? '' : res.getBody().abbreviate(200)));\\n }\\n log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Sent';\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Failed';\\n log.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = e.getMessage().abbreviate(255);\\n }\\n log.Subject = 'Email: ' + (String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject.abbreviate(240));\\n log.Description = String.isNotBlank(plainBody) ? plainBody.abbreviate(31000)\\n : (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody) ? htmlBody.stripHtmlTags().abbreviate(31000) : null);\\n logs.add(log);\\n }\\n\\n // Partial insert; if a WhatId isn't activity-enabled retry that log without it so the audit row survives.\\n List<Task> retries = new List<Task>();\\n Database.SaveResult\[\] results = Database.insert(logs, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (!results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n Task t = logs\[i\].clone(false, true);\\n t.WhatId = null;\\n retries.add(t);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!retries.isEmpty()) {\\n Database.insert(retries, false);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n private static HttpRequest buildRequest(SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg, EmailRequest em,\\n String toAddr, String toName, String subject, String plainBody, String htmlBody) {\\n List<Object> content = new List<Object>();\\n if (String.isNotBlank(plainBody)) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => plainBody });\\n }\\n if (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody)) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/html', 'value' => htmlBody });\\n }\\n if (content.isEmpty()) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => ' ' });\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> body = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'personalizations' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'to' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'email' => toAddr,\\n 'name' => String.isBlank(toName) ? toAddr : toName } },\\n 'custom\_args' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'sf\_ref' => em.reference } } },\\n 'from' => new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'email' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromAddress) ? em.fromAddress : cfg.Default\_From\_Address\_\_c,\\n 'name' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromName) ? em.fromName : cfg.Default\_From\_Name\_\_c },\\n 'subject' => String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject,\\n 'content' => content\\n };\\n if (cfg.Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c) {\\n body.put('mail\_settings', new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'sandbox\_mode' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'enable' => true } });\\n }\\n HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest();\\n req.setEndpoint('callout:SendGrid/v3/mail/send');\\n req.setMethod('POST');\\n req.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');\\n req.setHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer {!$Credential.Password}');\\n req.setTimeout(20000);\\n req.setBody(JSON.serialize(body));\\n return req;\\n }\\n\\n public static SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt settings() {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (cfg == null) {\\n throw new SendGridException('SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n }\\n return cfg;\\n }\\n}"

"text": "FINDINGS\\n\\nFor \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` with \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\*BOOLEAN equals true\`, RuleEngine evaluates all Applications whose \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` equals the supplied Contact Id, ordered oldest-first by \`CreatedDate\` and truncated to the first 500 records. With omitted/default \`matchMode\`, the condition passes when at least one loaded Application has \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c = true\`; \`all\`, \`none\`, \`first\`, \`last\`, and \`at-least\` change that reduction as described below. \[RuleEngine.cls:122-149\] \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\]\\n\\nThe root context is always a Contact; the evaluator does not receive or use the current Document Assignment or its Application. Consequently, the example condition is Contact-wide: an Application belonging to another assignment or application for the same Contact can satisfy it. \[RuleEngine.cls:56-65\] \[RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:149-159\]\\n\\nA faithful subscriber-side evaluator must reproduce the child match modes, three levels of AND/OR/custom boolean composition, all supported field comparators and type coercions, the 500-record oldest-first limit, and fail-closed handling for evaluation errors. \[RuleCondition.cls:1-40\] \[BooleanEvaluate.cls:11-179\] \[.docs/onboarding/articles/user-documents.md:161-179\]\\n\\nKEY FILES\\n\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:56-110\` — JSON deserialization, Contact root loading, condition/group/root evaluation.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:122-149\` — \`any\`, \`all\`, \`none\`, \`first\`, \`last\`, and \`at-least\` reduction.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine.cls:161-225\` — target-object parsing, field-path collection, caching, and child-record loading.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine\_Base.cls:22-59\` — relationship-path traversal and null-parent behavior.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\` — \`ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC LIMIT 500\` and permission-bypassing query mode.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleCondition.cls:1-40\` — condition-item operators, match-mode fields, and defaults.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RuleGroup.cls:1-39\` — group-level condition composition.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/Rule.cls:1-36\` — cross-group composition.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/BooleanEvaluate.cls:11-179\` — custom-expression grammar and validation.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/FieldValueEvaluate.cls:20-211\` — comparator dispatch and field-type handling.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/SchemaUtils.cls:71-179\` — target-value conversion and primitive/null conversion.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/CustomValueEvaluate.cls:21-69\` — \`count\`, \`sum\`, \`min\`, and \`max\`.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:178-222\` — session-gated legacy wrapper and error response behavior.\\n- \`force-app/main/default/classes/RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:144-168\` — scheduler-compatible materialisation path and fail-closed handling.\\n- \`applications/user-documents/src/modules/docs/userDocuments/userDocuments.js:438-505\` — frontend rendering and error behavior.\\n- \`.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:30-43\` — documented match modes.\\n- \`.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:52-63\` — documented comparators.\\n- \`.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:112-167\` — JSON shape, functions, relative dates, and performance notes.\\n\\nCONFIG ARTIFACTS\\n\\n- The relevant condition shape is:\\n - \`targetObject\`: \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\`\\n - \`targetObjectField\`: \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\*BOOLEAN\`\\n - \`targetValueComparitor\`: \`equals\`\\n - \`targetObjectFieldValue\`: Boolean true/raw value accepted by the Boolean conversion\\n - \`matchMode\`: omitted or \`any\` for “at least one Application”\\n \\n The documented JSON keys and \`\*\` conventions are defined at \`.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:112-163\`; \`RuleConditionItem.targetValueComparitor\` is intentionally spelled with the source typo \`Comparitor\`. \[RuleConditionItem.cls:1-12\]\\n\\n- Child-record match modes are:\\n - \`any\` or omitted: at least one record matches; an empty child set fails.\\n - \`all\`: every loaded record matches; an empty child set fails.\\n - \`none\`: no loaded record matches; an empty child set passes.\\n - \`first\`: only the oldest loaded record is tested; an empty child set fails.\\n - \`last\`: only the newest loaded record is tested; with more than 500 records this means the newest of the first 500 oldest records, not the true newest Application.\\n - \`at-least\`: at least \`matchCount\` records match; omitted \`matchCount\` defaults to 1 in the evaluator. The code does not reject zero or negative counts, so a supplied zero can pass an empty set. \[RuleEngine.cls:122-149\]\\n\\n- Records are queried with \`ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC LIMIT 500\`. There is no secondary \`Id\` ordering, so records sharing the same \`CreatedDate\` do not have a documented deterministic tie-break. \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\]\\n\\n- The three boolean-composition levels all support \`and\`, \`or\`, and \`custom\`:\\n - Condition items: \`crossConditionItemOperator\` plus \`customCrossConditionItemOperator\`.\\n - Conditions inside a group: \`crossConditionOperator\` plus \`customCrossConditionOperator\`.\\n - Groups in the rule: \`crossGroupOperator\` plus \`customCrossGroupOperator\`.\\n \\n Blank item-level composition defaults to AND when there are multiple items. A single item, condition, or group is represented internally as \`1 and 1\`. Missing operators are rejected when more than one element exists. \[RuleCondition.cls:20-40\] \[RuleGroup.cls:8-37\] \[Rule.cls:7-36\] \[RuleEngine.cls:247-319\]\\n\\n- Custom expressions use one-based element positions, for example \`1 AND ( 2 OR 3 )\`. The parser:\\n - lowercases expressions;\\n - accepts \`AND\`/\`OR\`, case-insensitively;\\n - rewrites \`&&\` to AND and \`||\` to OR;\\n - accepts parentheses;\\n - requires balanced parentheses;\\n - requires every supplied position to be referenced;\\n - rejects unknown indices, unknown tokens, a blank expression, an expression with no boolean operator, or an expression containing no numeric position.\\n \\n There is no NOT or XOR operator. Because tokenisation splits on spaces, parentheses should be whitespace-separated in a faithful implementation; the tests use \`( 1 AND 2 )\`, while the documentation’s compact \`(1 AND 2)\` example is not accepted reliably by the parser. \[BooleanEvaluate.cls:11-23\] \[BooleanEvaluate.cls:81-127\] \[BooleanEvaluate.cls:129-179\] \[BooleanEvaluate\_test.cls:50-76\]\\n\\n- Supported \`targetValueComparitor\` values are:\\n - \`equals\`, \`not-equals\`\\n - \`contains\`, \`not-contains\`\\n - \`starts-with\`, \`ends-with\`\\n - \`more-than\`, \`less-than\`\\n - \`more-or-equal\`, \`less-or-equal\`\\n - \`is-blank\`, \`is-not-blank\`\\n - \`in-list\`, \`not-in-list\`\\n - \`includes\`, \`excludes\`\\n \\n These names are listed in \`.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:52-63\` and the dispatch is implemented in \`FieldValueEvaluate.cls:68-211\`.\\n\\n- Type support:\\n - Text-like, picklist, lookup/reference, email, phone, URL, textarea, ID, and similar fields support the string operators. String values are lowercased for comparison. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:89-105\] \[SchemaUtils.cls:110-114\]\\n - Boolean fields support only \`equals\` and \`not-equals\`. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:106-112\]\\n - Date, datetime, and time fields support equality and the four relational operators. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:113-163\]\\n - Currency, double, percent, integer, and long fields support equality and the four relational operators. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:164-208\]\\n - \`in-list\` and \`not-in-list\` use comma-separated, lowercased scalar values. \`includes\` and \`excludes\` use semicolon-separated multiselect values. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:74-87\]\\n - \`is-blank\` and \`is-not-blank\` are implemented generically by the code, including for checkbox fields, although the documentation says they exclude checkboxes. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:68-73\] \[.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:61-63\]\\n\\n- Null behavior:\\n - Blank strings and empty string targets normalize to null. \[SchemaUtils.cls:110-114\] \[SchemaUtils.cls:141-147\]\\n - A null Boolean is converted to \`false\`; therefore null Boolean \`equals true\` is false, while null Boolean \`not-equals true\` is true. \[SchemaUtils.cls:115-117\] \[SchemaUtils.cls:145-147\]\\n - String null equals null; string null does not-equal null is false. \[EvaluationUtils.cls:5-6\] \[EvaluationUtils.cls:33-34\]\\n - \`contains\`, \`not-contains\`, \`starts-with\`, and \`ends-with\` all return false when the source is null; \`not-contains\` is not a null-safe logical complement. \[EvaluationUtils.cls:61-76\]\\n - Null scalar values are not found by \`in-list\`; therefore \`not-in-list\` returns true. Empty multiselect values make \`includes\` false and \`excludes\` true. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:74-87\]\\n - A null parent encountered while walking a relationship path makes that item false. \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:40-59\]\\n - Invalid type conversion or malformed function configuration can throw rather than evaluate to false. \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:20-45\] \[CustomValueEvaluate.cls:29-35\]\\n\\n- Supported full-record functions are \`custom\_count\`, \`custom\_sum:<field>\`, \`custom\_min:<field>\`, and \`custom\_max:<field>\`. They operate over the full queried child-record set regardless of \`any\`, \`all\`, \`first\`, \`last\`, or \`at-least\`; null field values are skipped and an aggregate with no values fails. \[CustomValueEvaluate.cls:38-69\] \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:26-37\]\\n\\n- Rendering configuration is separate from rule validity:\\n \`shouldShow = b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c ? rulePassed : !rulePassed\`. A blank rule is always shown. \[\`.docs/onboarding/articles/user-documents.md:154-179\`\]\\n\\nCHAIN\\n\\n1. The engine deserializes the JSON into \`Rule\`, \`RuleGroup\`, \`RuleCondition\`, and \`RuleConditionItem\` objects, then loads the supplied Id as a Contact. \[RuleEngine.cls:56-65\]\\n\\n2. For the example child target, \`cacheData()\` splits the target at \`\*\`, treats \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` as the child-to-Contact merge field, gathers any relationship-path fields needed by the items, and loads the Applications through \`RuleEngine\_Base.loadRecords()\`. \[RuleEngine.cls:161-195\] \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\]\\n\\n3. The query returns at most 500 Applications in ascending \`CreatedDate\` order. Multiple conditions using the same exact target-object string share the cached record set. \[RuleEngine.cls:174-195\]\\n\\n4. For each loaded Application, the engine evaluates the condition items. For the supplied single item, it reads \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\`, converts both source and target to Boolean, and compares them with \`equals\`. \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:9-15\] \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:106-112\] \[SchemaUtils.cls:77-80\]\\n\\n5. The condition’s match mode reduces those per-record booleans. With default \`any\`, the first true Application makes the condition valid; with \`all\`, a false Application fails the condition; with \`none\`, a true Application fails it; \`first\` and \`last\` reduce the one selected record; \`at-least\` counts matches. \[RuleEngine.cls:122-149\]\\n\\n6. Condition results are combined inside each group, then group results are combined at the rule level. Custom expressions are validated before execution and evaluated by the shared BooleanEvaluate parser. \[RuleEngine.cls:80-109\] \[RuleEngine.cls:267-319\]\\n\\n7. The legacy portal path is not a scheduler-safe raw evaluator: \`RemoteMyDocumentsController.validateRule()\` requires a valid portal session and a document Id before invoking RuleEngine. It catches exceptions and returns an error response. \[RemoteMyDocumentsController.cls:178-222\]\\n\\n8. The materialised Requested Documents path invokes RuleEngine directly with \`assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, not an Application Id. It applies the Show-on-success inversion for successful evaluations and returns false directly on exceptions, so errors are hidden/fail closed. \[RequestedDocsQueueProcessor.cls:144-168\]\\n\\n9. The frontend follows the same Contact-based logic. A rule error or unsuccessful response returns \`shouldRender: false\`; a successful response applies the Show-on-success flag. \[userDocuments.js:448-475\] \[userDocuments.js:491-505\]\\n\\nOPEN QUESTIONS\\n\\n- The repository-wide search found no literal production rule containing \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` or \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\`; the test fixture uses the generic packaged \`b3o\_\_Application\_\_c\` target instead. The code should be treated as authoritative for subscriber-side behavior. \[.docs/onboarding/articles/rule-builder.md:165-167\] \[RuleEngine.cls:174-195\]\\n\\n- Same-\`CreatedDate\` ordering has no explicit tie-breaker, so exact \`first\`/\`last\` results for timestamp ties are not guaranteed by the source. \[RuleEngine\_Base.cls:92-101\]\\n\\n- RuleEngine itself throws on malformed JSON, invalid target/field definitions, invalid custom expressions, and some conversion errors; a subscriber-side scheduler must wrap those errors and preserve an explicit error state so an error is not confused with a valid false result. \[RuleEngine.cls:234-319\] \[FieldValueEvaluate.cls:20-45\] \[RuleBuilderComponent.cls:22-37\]",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* Reed case #00003380.\\n \*\\n \* Replicates the assignment logic of the record-triggered flow\\n \* \\"3B - Document Distribution Process\\" (Production V26) for EXISTING\\n \* Applications, which that flow can never reach because it only fires on\\n \* record CREATE.\\n \*\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* ONE CODEBASE, TWO ORGS\\n \*\\n \* Sandbox TRAIN does not have every field Production has:\\n \* - Job.FOS\_Role\_Type\_\_c Production only\\n \* - Application.b3\_Business\_Process\_\_c Production only\\n \* and its Business process picklist is missing \\"Friends & Family EOI\\",\\n \* \\"Returners\\", \\"Onsite with CV Upload\\", \\"Onsite\\" and \\"Customer Experience\\".\\n \*\\n \* So every org-variable field is read DYNAMICALLY and the SOQL is built from a\\n \* describe. Referenced by name, never statically. \*/\\n private static final String F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE = 'FOS\_Role\_Type\_\_c';\\n private static final String F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC = 'b3\_Business\_Process\_\_c';\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Branch + Location -> the fields on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c that\\n \* hold the two packs. }\\n\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact = new Map<Id, List<SObject>>();\\n for (SObject prior : Database.query(\\n 'SELECT ' + String.join(priorFields, ', ')\\n + ' FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c'\\n + ' WHERE TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c IN :contactIds AND CreatedDate >= :cutoff')) {\\n\\n Id contactId = (Id) prior.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c');\\n if (!priorByContact.containsKey(contactId)) {\\n priorByContact.put(contactId, new List<SObject>());\\n }\\n priorByContact.get(contactId).add(prior);\\n }\\n\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> toInsert = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n\\n for (SObject app : scope) {\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n if (alreadyLinked.contains(appId)) { skippedLinked++; New Application Assignment, unconditional\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, basePackId));\\n\\n // 2. Location filter\\n String location = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c'));\\n List<Id> packIds = packIdsByRule.get(ruleKey(branch, location));\\n if (packIds == null || packIds.isEmpty()) {\\n skippedNoPack++;\\n errorLog.add('No pack configured for \\"' + branch + '\\" / \\"' + location\\n + '\\" (Application ' + appId + ')');\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // 3. Previously Applied with us?\\n if (hasPriorApplication(app, job, priorByContact)) { skippedRecent++; continue; }\\n\\n // 4 + 5. Onboarding pack, then the hidden application form pack\\n for (Id packId : packIds) {\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, packId));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (toInsert.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(toInsert, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n assignmentsMade++;\\n } else {\\n failedRows++;\\n if (errorLog.size() < 100) {\\n errorLog.add('Application ' + toInsert\[i\].Application\_\_c + ': '\\n + results\[i\].getErrors()\[0\].getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // ROUTING\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Test-only hook. TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c is a formula reading through to the\\n \* Account, and Reed's Account validation rules make creating one in a test\\n \* impractical, so tests force the outcome here instead. 'NONE' means the\\n \* Default Outcome. Guarded by Test.isRunningTest() so it can never affect\\n \* live behaviour.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible private static String accountRouteOverride;\\n\\n /\*\* Account Decision. 'ANGARD', 'FOS', or null meaning do nothing. \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByAccount(SObject job) {\\n\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && accountRouteOverride != null) {\\n return accountRouteOverride == 'NONE' ? null : accountRouteOverride;\\n }\\n\\n String account = (String) job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c');\\n if (String.isBlank(account)) { return null; }\\n if (account.containsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_ANGARD\_CONTAINS)) { return 'ANGARD'; }\\n if (account.equalsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_FOS\_EQUALS)) { return 'FOS'; }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Business Process decision, in the flow's outcome order.\\n \* Business process and Business Area both live on the JOB.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByBusinessProcess(SObject job) {\\n\\n String bp = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'));\\n String area = String.valueOf(job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c'));\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(bp) || bp == 'null') { return null; }\\n\\n // BAU uses \\"Any Condition Is Met (OR)\\" across three values.\\n if (bp == 'BAU' || bp == 'Aviation' || bp == 'Onsite') { return 'BAU'; }\\n\\n if (bp == 'Delivery') { return 'Delivery'; }\\n if (bp == 'RMSS') { return 'RMSS'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW C&D') { return 'PFW C&D'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW WH HUB') { return 'PFW WH HUB'; }\\n\\n // Fleet, CACIB, Customer Experience, Friends & Family, Returners and\\n // Onsite with CV Upload are out of scope for this sync.\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* \\"Previously Applied with us?\\" - another application for the same applicant,\\n \* created inside the window. Production also requires the same business\\n \* process; where that field does not exist the date match alone is used.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private Boolean hasPriorApplication(SObject app, SObject job,\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact) {\\n\\n List<SObject> priors = priorByContact.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n if (priors == null) { return false; }\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n for (SObject prior : priors) {\\n if ((Id) prior.get('Id') == appId) { continue; }\\n if (!appHasBusProc) { return true; }\\n Object priorBp = prior.get(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC);\\n if (String.valueOf(priorBp) == String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'))) {\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // CONFIGURATION\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private static String ruleKey(String branch, String location) {\\n return branch + '|' + (String.isBlank(location) || location == 'null' ? '' : location);\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean hasField(String objectApi, String fieldApi) {\\n Schema.SObjectType t = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get(objectApi.toLowerCase());\\n return t != null && t.getDescribe().fields.getMap().containsKey(fieldApi.toLowerCase());\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Resolves every configured setting field to a live pack Id in THIS org.\\n \* Returns a reason to abort, or null when the configuration is usable.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String loadAndValidateConfiguration() {\\n\\n if (packIdsByRule != null) { return null; } // injected by a test\\n\\n packIdsByRule = new Map<String, List<Id>>();\\n hiddenPackIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n SObject setting = X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.getOrgDefaults();\\n if (setting == null) {\\n return 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c has no organisation defaults '\\n + 'in this org. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> settingFields =\\n Schema.SObjectType.X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.fields.getMap();\\n\\n List<String> problems = new List<String>();\\n Set<Id> configured = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n basePackId = readPack(setting, settingFields, SETTING\_FIELD\_BASE\_PACK, problems);\\n if (basePackId != null) { configured.add(basePackId); }\\n\\n for (String key : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.keySet()) {\\n List<Id> ids = new List<Id>();\\n for (String fieldName : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.get(key)) {\\n Id packId = readPack(setting, settingFields, fieldName, problems);\\n if (packId == null) { continue; }\\n ids.add(packId);\\n if (HIDDEN\_PACK\_FIELDS.contains(fieldName)) { hiddenPackIds.add(packId); }\\n configured.add(packId);\\n }\\n if (!ids.isEmpty()) { packIdsByRule.put(key, ids); }\\n }\\n\\n if (!problems.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'Document pack configuration is not usable in this org. Nothing was '\\n + 'created.\\\\n - ' + String.join(problems, '\\\\n - ');\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> live = new Map<Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c>(\[\\n SELECT Id FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c WHERE Id IN :configured \]).keySet();\\n\\n Set<Id> missing = new Set<Id>(configured);\\n missing.removeAll(live);\\n\\n if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'These Document Pack Ids are configured on '\\n + 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c but do not exist in this org: '\\n + String.join(new List<Id>(missing), ', ') + '. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n private Id readPack(SObject setting, Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> fields,\\n String fieldName, List<String> problems) {\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(fieldName)) { return null; }\\n\\n if (!fields.containsKey(fieldName.toLowerCase())) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName\\n + ' does not exist on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n Object raw = setting.get(fieldName);\\n String val = (raw == null) ? '' : String.valueOf(raw);\\n if (String.isBlank(val)) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' is empty in this org.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n try {\\n return (Id) val;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' does not hold a valid Id: ' + val);\\n return null;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // FINISH\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) {\\n\\n if (syncFieldExists() && !jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n Schema.SObjectType jobType = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get('tr1\_\_job\_\_c');\\n List<SObject> toReset = new List<SObject>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject j = jobType.newSObject(jobId);\\n j.put(SYNC\_FIELD, false);\\n toReset.add(j);\\n }\\n suppressTrigger = true;\\n try {\\n update toReset;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n errorLog.add('Could not reset Sync checkbox: ' + e.getMessage());\\n } finally {\\n suppressTrigger = false;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (abortReason != null) {\\n String failure = 'Sync Document Assignments - NOT RUN\\\\n\\\\n' + abortReason + '\\\\n';\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, failure);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - configuration error', failure);\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n String body =\\n 'Sync Document Assignments\\\\n\\\\n'\\n + 'Jobs ..................................... ' + jobIds.size() + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Applications scanned ..................... ' + scanned + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Document Assignments created ............. ' + assignmentsMade + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - already had an assignment ...... ' + skippedLinked + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - Account not Angard or FOS ...... ' + skippedAccount + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no matching branch ............. ' + skippedNoBranch + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - FOS account (out of scope) ..... ' + skippedFos + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no pack configured ............. ' + skippedNoPack + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - applied in last '\\n + RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS + ' days ......... ' + skippedRecent + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Failed rows .............................. ' + failedRows + '\\\\n';\\n\\n if (!errorLog.isEmpty()) {\\n body += '\\\\nDetail\\\\n------\\\\n';\\n for (String line : errorLog) { body += line + '\\\\n'; }\\n }\\n\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject job = jobsById.get(jobId);\\n if (job != null) {\\n body += '\\\\nJob: ' + job.get('Name')\\n + '\\\\n Account .......... ' + job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business process . ' + job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business Area .... ' + job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Location ......... ' + job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c');\\n if (jobHasRoleType) {\\n body += '\\\\n FOS Role Type .... ' + job.get(F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE);\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, body);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - '\\n + assignmentsMade + ' created, ' + failedRows + ' failed', body);\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // HELPERS\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c buildAssignment(SObject app, Id packId) {\\n return new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = (Id) app.get('Id'),\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = (Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'),\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = hiddenPackIds != null && hiddenPackIds.contains(packId)\\n );\\n }\\n\\n private void sendSummary(String subject, String body) {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest()) { return; }\\n try {\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage mail = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage();\\n mail.setToAddresses(new List<String>{ UserInfo.getUserEmail() });\\n mail.setSubject(subject);\\n mail.setPlainTextBody(body);\\n mail.setSaveAsActivity(false);\\n Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{ mail });\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, 'Summary email failed: ' + e.getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

"fullName": "JobFillRollupHandler",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Recalculates Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c —\\n \* count of related TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c records at the filled stage,\\n \* split by Agency\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* FAILURE ISOLATION: this runs from an Application trigger, so an\\n \* unhandled error here would roll back the Application insert or update\\n \* that caused it. Recruiters would be unable to create applications\\n \* because of a problem updating a Job. Two safeguards prevent that:\\n \*\\n \* 1. Database.update(..., false) — a Job that cannot be saved is\\n \* skipped and logged rather than throwing.\\n \* 2. A surrounding try/catch — any unexpected failure is swallowed\\n \* and logged.\\n \*\\n \* Fill counts are reporting figures, not transactional data. A stale\\n \* count is a far smaller problem than a blocked application, and the\\n \* next relevant change to that Job's applications will correct it.\\n \*\\n \* Known related risk: the org's \\"Job: After Create - Create Job Unique\\n \* URL Slug\\" flow calls PQ\_PrepareJobUrlName, which is not bulk safe —\\n \* it processes only the first record of any batch. If that flow is ever\\n \* configured to run on update as well as create, the bulk Job update\\n \* below would trigger it. The partial-success DML means that would\\n \* degrade fill counts rather than break application creation.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class JobFillRollupHandler {\\n\\n private static final String FILLED\_STAGE = 'New Hire';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_ANGARD = 'Angard';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_PERTEMPS = 'Pertemps';\\n\\n /\*\\n \* Works out which Jobs need their counts recalculated.\\n \*\\n \* Pass oldMap only for updates. When it is null the operation is an\\n \* insert, delete or undelete and every referenced Job is affected.\\n \* When it is populated, only Applications where Stage, Agency or the\\n \* Job lookup actually changed are relevant — recalculating on every\\n \* Application update would put needless DML on the Job object, and at\\n \* Peak volumes that is both wasted work and extra opportunity for\\n \* unrelated Job automation to fail.\\n \*\\n \* Separated from the trigger so it can be unit tested with in-memory\\n \* records rather than DML.\\n \*/\\n public static Set<Id> collectAffectedJobIds(\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> records,\\n Map<Id, TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> oldMap\\n ) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n if (records == null) {\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app : records) {\\n if (oldMap == null) {\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c priorVersion = oldMap.get(app.Id);\\n if (priorVersion == null) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n Boolean stageChanged = app.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c;\\n Boolean agencyChanged = app.Agency\_\_c != priorVersion.Agency\_\_c;\\n Boolean jobChanged = app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c;\\n\\n if (!stageChanged && !agencyChanged && !jobChanged) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // Reparenting affects the counts on both Jobs.\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n if (priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n public static void recalculate(Set<Id> jobIds) {\\n if (jobIds == null || jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n try {\\n Map<Id, Integer> angardCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n Map<Id, Integer> pertempsCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n\\n // Default every job to zero first, so jobs that no longer\\n // have matching Applications get reset rather than left stale.\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n angardCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n pertempsCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n }\\n\\n for (AggregateResult ar : \[\\n SELECT TR1\_\_Job\_\_c jobId, Agency\_\_c agency, COUNT(Id) cnt\\n FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\\n WHERE TR1\_\_Job\_\_c IN :jobIds\\n AND TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c = :FILLED\_STAGE\\n GROUP BY TR1\_\_Job\_\_c, Agency\_\_c\\n \]) {\\n Id jobId = (Id) ar.get('jobId');\\n String agency = (String) ar.get('agency');\\n Integer cnt = (Integer) ar.get('cnt');\\n\\n if (agency == AGENCY\_ANGARD) {\\n angardCounts.put(jobId, cnt);\\n } else if (agency == AGENCY\_PERTEMPS) {\\n pertempsCounts.put(jobId, cnt);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> jobsToUpdate = new List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n jobsToUpdate.add(new TR1\_\_Job\_\_c(\\n Id = jobId,\\n Angard\_Filled\_\_c = angardCounts.get(jobId),\\n Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c = pertempsCounts.get(jobId)\\n ));\\n }\\n\\n // Partial success: one unsaveable Job must not roll back the\\n // Application DML that triggered this.\\n Database.SaveResult\[\] results = Database.update(jobsToUpdate, false);\\n\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (!results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR,\\n 'JobFillRollupHandler: could not update fill counts on Job '\\n + jobsToUpdate\[i\].Id + ' — ' + results\[i\].getErrors());\\n }\\n }\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n // Never propagate. A failure to update reporting figures must\\n // not prevent an application being created or progressed.\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR,\\n 'JobFillRollupHandler: recalculation failed for Jobs ' + jobIds\\n + ' — ' + e.getMessage() + '\\\\n' + e.getStackTraceString());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

},

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "analyst\_mu2x5dhwV7YPi5nW4K4a",

▾"input": {

"title": "2026-09-15 immediate document-progress refresh feasibility",

▾"tags": \[

"document-packs",

"reminders",

"progress",

"read-only",

"design"

\],

"content": "## Scope\\nRead-only feasibility investigation for immediate assignment-progress refreshes. No metadata or records changed.\\n\\n## Confirmed current extension points\\n- Active managed triggers: \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` (\`01qQH000002kKaZYAU\`) on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_DocumentPackTrigger\` (\`01qQH000002kKabYAE\`) on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`. Do not modify.\\n- There is \*\*no Apex trigger\*\* on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` (Tooling query, 2026-09-15). There is therefore no unmanaged trigger/framework to extend on the two direct progress sources.\\n- Application has three active triggers: unmanaged \`ApplicationJobRollupTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007B4gzIAC\`, job filled-counts only) and \`PQ\_ApplicationTrigger\` (\`01qPv000005xl3FIAQ\`, insert-only), plus managed \`TR1\_\_ApplicationTrigger\_V2\`. Neither unmanaged trigger is a document-progress framework and neither should be extended.\\n- Contact triggers are all managed (\`TR1\_\_ContactTrigger\`, \`tubl\_\_AllContactTriggers\`), so none can be extended.\\n- Existing unmanaged \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch\`/\`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` are a job-checkbox/backfill mechanism, currently inert in train because code expects missing \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c\`; not a progress-refresh seam.\\n\\n## Existing active flows that create/update dependent records\\n- \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` v4 (\`301QH00001sDD7OYAW\`) is a \*\*before-save create-only\*\* Submission flow. It looks up Assignment with \`Id=$Record.b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` and same \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, then sets submission \`Application\_\_c\`. Cannot refresh Assignment (before-save can only set triggering record).\\n- \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001rwWTWYA2\`) is \*\*after-save create-only\*\* Submission. It checks pack Documents and submissions by \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\` + \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`; its \`Make\_Application\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` update writes Assignment \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=false\`.\\n- \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001sD95zYAC\`) is likewise after-save/create-only and writes \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=false\` in \`Make\_Screening\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\`.\\n- \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` \*\*active v4\*\* (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`) is Application after-save \*\*Create\*\*. It creates Assignments with \`Application\_\_c=$Record.Id\`, Contact \`$Record.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\`, Pack, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c='New'\`; some application-pack creates set \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=true\`. The current v5 (\`301Pv000019pDAXIA2\`) is Draft: do not extend it.\\n- \`X3B\_Manually\_Triggering\_Document\_Assignment\_Application\` v1 (\`301QH00001u9mmEYAQ\`) is Application after-save Update only when \`BH\_Document\_Assignment\_resubmitted\_\_c=true\`; it uses \`Hide\_Old\_Doc\_Assingment\` to hide old assignments, then creates replacements.\\n\\n## Minimum reliable refresh hooks (recommend new unmanaged record-triggered flows + one shared bulk service)\\n1. \*\*Submission after-save C/U/D\*\*: call a shared refresh action for the Assignment(s) in old/new \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`; on update watch \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Valid\_Until\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`, assignment and Contact. This covers candidate submission, staff review/revert, validity-date corrections and deletion. \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expired\_\_c\` is formula \`Valid\_Until < TODAY()\`, so daily scheduled processing is still required at the date boundary.\\n2. \*\*Assignment after-save C/U\*\*: refresh the assignment and set a new immutable unmanaged \`Available\_At\_\_c\` only the first time it is actually eligible. Watch/create \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`; existing Active formula is \`!Hide && status nonblank && (due blank or due >= TODAY())\`. This captures all existing Distribution/Manual/visibility flow writes without modifying them. Contact and Pack master-details are not reparentable.\\n3. \*\*Document after-save C/U/D\*\*: refresh all assignments in its fixed \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\` when document count/visibility configuration changes. Direct count/visibility configuration is \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` (JSON), \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` (inverse), plus creation/deletion. Document-to-Pack is non-reparentable MD.\\n4. \*\*Application after-save C/U/D\*\* needed only for current/future child-Application condition fields, starting with the production E&W rule. Refresh all candidate assignments for \*\*both old and new\*\* \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\`, because semantics are contact-wide ANY application, not Assignment.Application. If E\_W is a formula, add a source-parent hook instead of relying on Application update.\\n5. \*\*Contact after-save\*\* only if approved document rules directly reference Contact fields. The provided Application-only example needs no Contact field hook beyond Applicant reparenting.\\n6. \*\*Pack\*\*: fields are only \`b3o\_\_Disabled\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Public\_Description\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submit\_in\_Order\_\_c\`. \`b3o\_\_Disabled\_\_c\`/\`Submit\_in\_Order\` are not inputs to Assignment \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\` and no v8 product documentation was found proving they alter portal visibility. No Pack refresh hook is justified yet; Document lifecycle already covers pack composition.\\n\\nWhy code/service rather than pure Flow calculation: Flow cannot safely reproduce the JSON conditional-rule evaluator and latest-valid-per-document aggregate for all assignments in a pack. The direct hooks can be low-code flows, but their single action should enqueue/bulkify a shared post-commit evaluator. This is an immediate-after-commit refresh (not an hourly job); scheduled daily processing remains necessary for formula date rollovers.\\n\\n## Data model facts for evaluator\\n- Assignment: Contact MD \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, Pack MD \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, optional \`Application\_\_c\` lookup to TR1 Application; status New/Submitted/Rejected/Approved; hide, due date, and formula Active above. There are only 19 fields; no existing availability/progress/reminder field.\\n- Submission: direct keys are \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`; use assignment+document scoping and latest CreatedDate, and only Pending Review/Approved, non-expired, per agreed semantics.\\n- Document: Pack MD; condition JSON/inverse as above. \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` defaults false and help text says true evaluation is hidden unless checkbox true. Current train 191-row document read surfaced null JSON/false inverse on the sampled returned output; platform does not permit a non-null filter on this LongText field. Previous full analysis recorded all 191 were null/false.\\n- The \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` field is a normal nullable \`Lookup(Contact)\` (DurableId \`01IQH000001iOxM.00NQH00000DrpqF\`) and not formula.\\n\\n## Production E&W rule blocker\\n- \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` does not exist on train \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\`: FieldDefinition query scoped to EntityDefinition \`01IQH000001iOxM\` returned only \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\`, no E\_W row; direct CustomField retrieval returned no files. Its type, formula/parent dependencies, history and value cannot be verified here.\\n- Therefore production must supply/review the field describe and the actual Document condition JSON + \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` value before an \\"immediate\\" hook can be guaranteed. If stored checkbox, Application C/U/D hook is sufficient; if formula through Job/other parent, that parent must publish the refresh too.\\n\\n## Historical availability / rollout cutoff\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` metadata explicitly has \`<enableHistory>false</enableHistory>\` and no Assignment History child/sObject. None of its fields are history-tracked. There is no reliable historical \\"became visible\\" timestamp.\\n- Only two current assignments were Created in last 10 days, both visible/Active and untouched: \`a5YPv000000hh1hMAA\` created \`2026-09-14T12:59:12Z\`, and \`a5YPv000000hI05MAE\` created \`2026-09-09T09:15:37Z\`; \`LastModifiedDate=CreatedDate\`, \`Hide=false\`, Status New. This does \*\*not\*\* prove first availability where child conditional applicability could have changed, so CreatedDate cannot meet the agreed reliable-availability standard.\\n- No existing reminder/cutoff metadata exists: \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\` (unmanaged hierarchy setting) contains pack IDs only; \`SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt\` contains sender/sandbox/webhook fields only. Existing CMT inventory has no reminder type. Do not overload either unrelated configuration. New dedicated unmanaged reminder settings metadata with explicit \`Launch\_At\_\_c\` is required if an unambiguous cutoff is wanted; new \`Available\_At\_\_c\` can only be reliable from deployment onward.\\n\\n## Staff UI/FLS\\n- \`list\_metadata Layout\` returned no Layout components. The only Assignment record page is managed \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_Record\_Page\` (namespace b3o): header highlights, main \`force:detailPanel\`, sidebar \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\` related list. It has no Dynamic Forms field section and is not editable. No unmanaged Assignment page/layout exists to extend.\\n- Exact safe UI route: create and activate a new unmanaged Assignment record page (retain highlights + submission related-list; add a read-only \\"Reminder progress\\" Dynamic Forms field section). It is a new page, not an edit/extension of the b3o page/layout.\\n- Existing unmanaged \`Angard\` permission set exposes Assignment fields read-only (e.g. \`Application\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`). New progress fields should be read=true/edit=false there; Assignment record access still derives from the master Contact/sharing and existing profile/set configuration.\\n"

},

"text": "FINDINGS — The smallest safe immediate-refresh design is a shared unmanaged post-commit progress evaluator invoked by new narrow record-triggered flows on Document Submission, Document Assignment, and Document; no managed trigger or existing application trigger is a suitable extension point. The supplied contact-wide “any Application where \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c=true\`” condition cannot be fully verified in train because \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` is absent there, so its storage/formula dependencies and therefore required parent hooks remain a production verification blocker. There is no reliable historic “became available” date: Assignment history is disabled, so only a new immutable availability timestamp populated from deployment onward can meet the agreed migration rule.\\n\\nEVIDENCE —\\n- No changes were made; this was read-only investigation.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` managed triggers: \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` (\`01qQH000002kKaZYAU\`) and \`b3o\_\_DocumentPackTrigger\` (\`01qQH000002kKabYAE\`) must not be modified.\\n- Tooling query returned no Apex triggers on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`; neither has an existing unmanaged handler to extend.\\n- Application triggers are unmanaged \`ApplicationJobRollupTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007B4gzIAC\`, only Job filled-count rollups) and \`PQ\_ApplicationTrigger\` (\`01qPv000005xl3FIAQ\`, insert-only), plus managed \`TR1\_\_ApplicationTrigger\_V2\`; neither is a progress framework.\\n- Contact triggers are managed: \`TR1\_\_ContactTrigger\` and \`tubl\_\_AllContactTriggers\`; no editable Contact trigger exists.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` v4 (\`301QH00001sDD7OYAW\`) is before-save/create-only; it sets \`$Record.Application\_\_c\` from Assignment and cannot update progress.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001rwWTWYA2\`) is after-save/create-only; its \`Make\_Application\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` writes \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=false\`.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001sD95zYAC\`) is after-save/create-only; its \`Make\_Screening\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` also writes \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=false\`.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` is v4 (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`), Application after-save/Create. It creates assignments with \`Application\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c='New'\`, and sometimes \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=true\`; v5 (\`301Pv000019pDAXIA2\`) is Draft and must not be extended.\\n- Active \`X3B\_Manually\_Triggering\_Document\_Assignment\_Application\` v1 (\`301QH00001u9mmEYAQ\`) runs on Application update when \`BH\_Document\_Assignment\_resubmitted\_\_c=true\`; element \`Hide\_Old\_Doc\_Assingment\` hides prior assignments.\\n- Assignment availability inputs are \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`; formula \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\` is \`!Hide && status nonblank && (Due Date blank or >= TODAY())\`.\\n- Assignment structural keys are non-reparentable master-details \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\`; \`Application\_\_c\` is an optional lookup to \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\`.\\n- Submission refresh inputs are \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Valid\_Until\_\_c\`. \`b3o\_\_Is\_Expired\_\_c\` is a formula based on \`Valid\_Until < TODAY()\`, requiring daily scheduled processing even with immediate save hooks.\\n- Document configuration that changes applicable count is \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` plus inverse checkbox \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\`; its help text confirms a successful rule hides the document unless that checkbox is true. Document-to-Pack is also non-reparentable master-detail.\\n- Pack fields are only \`b3o\_\_Disabled\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Public\_Description\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Submit\_in\_Order\_\_c\`; neither relevant boolean is part of Assignment \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`, and no product documentation verifies that Disabled changes portal visibility. A Pack refresh hook is not currently justified.\\n- \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` is a nullable stored \`Lookup(Contact)\`, DurableId \`01IQH000001iOxM.00NQH00000DrpqF\`; an Application condition change must refresh assignments for both old and new Applicants to preserve contact-wide ANY semantics.\\n- Scoped FieldDefinition lookup found no \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` on train Application EntityDefinition \`01IQH000001iOxM\`; direct metadata retrieval also returned no field. Its formula and parent dependencies cannot be established in this sandbox.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` metadata has \`<enableHistory>false</enableHistory>\` and no History child object; no field history can establish first visibility.\\n- The two assignments created in the last 10 days, \`a5YPv000000hh1hMAA\` (\`2026-09-14T12:59:12Z\`) and \`a5YPv000000hI05MAE\` (\`2026-09-09T09:15:37Z\`), are currently visible/New/Active and have \`LastModifiedDate=CreatedDate\`; that does not prove first availability if child-condition applicability changed later.\\n- No existing reminder cutoff configuration exists: unmanaged hierarchy setting \`X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c\` contains pack IDs only; \`SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt\` contains sender/sandbox/webhook settings only.\\n- \`list\_metadata Layout\` returned no layouts. The only Assignment Lightning page is managed \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_Record\_Page\`, containing \`force:detailPanel\` and sidebar related list \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\`; there is no editable unmanaged Assignment page/layout.\\n- The unmanaged \`Angard\` permission set already grants read-only Assignment fields including \`Application\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Active\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`; it is the appropriate FLS extension for new read-only progress fields.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION — Implement new unmanaged after-save flows rather than modifying managed components: (1) Submission C/U/D for Assignment/Document/Status/Valid Until changes, (2) Assignment C/U for Hide/Status/Due Date and first availability capture, and (3) Document C/U/D for condition JSON/inverse and pack-composition changes. These flows should invoke one bulkified asynchronous evaluator because Flow alone cannot safely calculate latest valid per-document submissions and reproduce conditional JSON semantics; retain the daily dispatcher for due-date/expiry formula transitions.\\n\\nBefore approval, obtain a production describe of \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` and the exact Document conditional-rule JSON plus \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` value. If E&W is stored on Application, an Application C/U/D hook is sufficient; if it is a formula, add a hook to every referenced parent/source object. Create a dedicated unmanaged reminder settings metadata type with explicit \`Launch\_At\_\_c\`, create an immutable Assignment \`Available\_At\_\_c\` for future eligibility, and do not enrol pre-deployment assignments based on \`CreatedDate\`.\\n\\nFor staff visibility, create a new unmanaged Assignment Lightning Record Page retaining the managed page’s highlights and submission related list, but add a read-only “Reminder progress” Dynamic Forms section; grant those fields read-only through \`Angard\`.",

▾{

"type": "tool.call",
