"title": "2026-09-15 immediate event wiring plan check",

▾"tags": \[

"document-reminders",

"event-wiring",

"read-only",

"production-formula"

\],

"content": "## Scope\\nFocused read-only check for immediate document-reminder/progress refresh wiring. No staging, metadata deployment, Apex execution, or data changes.\\n\\n## Current trigger seams (Tooling API, 2026-09-15)\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\`: \*\*no Apex trigger\*\*.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\`: \*\*no Apex trigger\*\*.\\n- \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`: managed only: \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` (Tooling name \`DocumentAssignment\`, Id \`01qQH000002kKaZYAU\`, API 51). Must not modify.\\n- \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\`: unmanaged active \`ApplicationJobRollupTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007B4gzIAC\`, API60) and \`PQ\_ApplicationTrigger\` (\`01qPv000005xl3FIAQ\`, API65); managed \`TR1\_\_ApplicationTrigger\_V2\` (Tooling name \`ApplicationTrigger\_V2\`, \`01qQH000001hir2YAA\`, API50). Earlier trace identifies the two unmanaged triggers as job filled-count / insert-only, not document-progress seams; do not extend them.\\n- \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\`: unmanaged active \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007QkKvIAK\`, API68), \`JobTrigger\_FB\` (\`01qPv0000054NWEIA2\`, API62), \`TR1Job\_Anguard\` (\`01qPv000005AOivIAG\`, API64); managed \`TR1\_\_JobOrderTrigger\` (Tooling name \`JobOrderTrigger\`, \`01qQH000001hir9YAA\`, API60). Do not use \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\`: established separate defect has plural/nonexistent \`b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c\` while screen Flow writes singular; current train code returns inert. Other Job triggers are unrelated/unreviewed.\\n\\n## Exact dependencies verified\\n- Application → Job API is \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\`, a \*\*MasterDetail(Job)\*\* field (metadata fullName \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\`, \`reparentableMasterDetail=false\`). Application → candidate is nullable lookup \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` to Contact. Applicant reparent changes must use old+new Contact; Job relationship cannot be reparented.\\n- Job Location API is \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.BH\_Location\_\_c\`, a restricted dependent Picklist (\`BH\_Location\`). Its configured value is exactly \`England & Wales\` (XML escaped \`England &amp; Wales\`) for BAU, Delivery, RMSS, PFW C&D, PFW WH HUB, Fleet and Aviation.\\n- Production field statement supplied by user: \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` is Formula(Checkbox) \`TEXT(TR1\_\_Job\_\_r.BH\_Location\_\_c) = \\"England & Wales\\"\`. It is absent in train (FieldDefinition result only contains Job and Applicant), so formula itself is production-supplied rather than train-verified.\\n- Document conditional inputs are \`b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` (LongText JSON) and \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` (Checkbox false by default); help text confirms a true rule is \*\*hidden\*\* unless Show is checked. User reports production rule has Show true, so an E&W match means show.\\n- Submission assignment key \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` is a nullable Lookup and can therefore be reparented. Submission Document and Document Pack relationships are nonreparentable Master Detail. Document → Pack is also nonreparentable Master Detail.\\n\\n## Existing flows and safe ordering position\\n- Active \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` v4 (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`) is Application after-save/Create and creates assignments. v5 (\`301Pv000019pDAXIA2\`) is Draft and must remain untouched.\\n- Active Submission after-save/Create flows \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001rwWTWYA2\`) and \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001sD95zYAC\`) can unhide assignments. The former's \`Make\_Application\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` and latter's \`Make\_Screening\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` write \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c=false\`. They are not safe general C/U/D/undelete refresh hooks. \`X3B\_Link\_Application\_with\_Document\_Submission\` v4 is before-save/Create-only and only copies Application to submission.\\n\\n## Recommended minimal wiring contract (for later approved build)\\nCreate five small unmanaged \*\*after\*\* triggers, each only publishing \`Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_e\` events; do not modify existing flows/triggers. A Platform Event subscriber batches/deduplicates scopes then enqueues the evaluator after commit. This avoids trigger order dependencies and a Queueable-per-record/transaction fanout under volume; it is low latency after commit, not synchronous (normally seconds, can delay under PE/async backlog).\\n1. Submission trigger \`after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\`: publish \`Assignment\` scopes for old and new \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` (deduped). Watch all updates or minimum assignment/document/status/valid-until/contact keys; all updates is safer because latest-valid completion depends on them. Covers lookup reparenting and delete/undelete.\\n2. Assignment trigger \`after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\`: publish Assignment scope for extant assignment; on delete publish old Contact scope. It must react to \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, Contact/Pack and lifecycle so availability is set/recomputed after distribution/manual visibility writes.\\n3. Document trigger \`after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\`: publish old/new Pack scopes. Recompute every assignment in those packs because composition, JSON rule or inversion checkbox can change applicability. Pack reparent is impossible but old/new keeps contract robust.\\n4. Application trigger \`after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\`: publish both old/new Applicant Contact scopes. On update filter to changes in \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` or \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\`; source formula cannot be directly edited. Contact-wide ANY semantics mean evaluator refreshes every candidate assignment, not only an Assignment.Application record.\\n5. Job trigger \`after update\` only when \`BH\_Location\_\_c\` changes: publish Job scopes. Subscriber queries Applications by \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\` and refreshes their Applicants' assignment scopes. Insert/delete/undelete job needs no independent hook: Application events cover child create/delete/undelete; Job master detail cannot reparent.\\n\\nThe subscriber must evaluate against committed data and handle scopes in bulk: Job→Applications→Contacts; Contact→all active/current candidate assignments; Pack→all assignments for pack; Assignment→that assignment. It must evaluate Document JSON and \`Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\`, and latest nonexpired Pending Review/Approved evidence per Assignment+Document according to approved business semantics. Scheduled daily processing remains necessary for TODAY()-based expiry with no DML.\\n\\n## Justification\\nNew thin triggers are justified despite existing after-save flows: Flow does not offer one safe general C/U/D/undelete seam, existing active flows contain business-specific visibility/email behavior, and unmanaged/managed existing triggers are not a documented reminder framework. Publishing events after all DML removes reliance on Apex/Flow execution order; modifying any listed flow/trigger could change current distribution, visibility or job-sync behaviour. Do not treat this as a fix for the known sync-field typo."

},

"type": "assistant.message",

"text": "FINDINGS — No existing unmanaged trigger is a safe document-progress extension point. The minimal reliable design is five new, thin unmanaged \*\*after\*\* triggers that publish an after-commit refresh event; a bulk subscriber evaluates committed state. This preserves the active distribution/visibility flows, covers submission and application lifecycle/reparenting, and adds the necessary Job hook because the supplied \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` formula does not itself cause an Application update when \`BH\_Location\_\_c\` changes.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\` and \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` have no Apex triggers. \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` has managed-only \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` / Tooling \`DocumentAssignment\` (\`01qQH000002kKaZYAU\`).\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\` unmanaged active triggers are \`ApplicationJobRollupTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007B4gzIAC\`) and \`PQ\_ApplicationTrigger\` (\`01qPv000005xl3FIAQ\`); its other trigger is managed \`TR1\_\_ApplicationTrigger\_V2\` / Tooling \`ApplicationTrigger\_V2\` (\`01qQH000001hir2YAA\`). The unmanaged triggers are established job-rollup/insert-only behavior, not a document-refresh framework.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\` unmanaged active triggers are \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` (\`01qPv000007QkKvIAK\`), \`JobTrigger\_FB\` (\`01qPv0000054NWEIA2\`), and \`TR1Job\_Anguard\` (\`01qPv000005AOivIAG\`); it also has managed \`TR1\_\_JobOrderTrigger\` / Tooling \`JobOrderTrigger\` (\`01qQH000001hir9YAA\`). The known plural \`b3\_Sync\_Document\_Assignments\_\_c\` typo makes \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` inert in this sandbox and remains out of scope.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — The Document Pack has managed-only \`b3o\_\_DocumentPackTrigger\` (\`01qQH000002kKabYAE\`). No Pack hook is needed for the stated requirement: pack composition and conditional applicability are changed through child \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` records.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\` is the Job API field, a non-reparentable Master-Detail relationship; \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` is a nullable Contact lookup, so Applicant reparenting requires both old and new Contact IDs.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.BH\_Location\_\_c\` is the restricted dependent \`BH\_Location\` picklist. Its configured value is exactly \`England & Wales\`, available for BAU, Delivery, RMSS, PFW C&D, PFW WH HUB, Fleet, and Aviation.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — Production formula supplied by the user is \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.E\_W\_Location\_\_c = TEXT(TR1\_\_Job\_\_r.BH\_Location\_\_c) = \\"England & Wales\\"\`. The field is absent from train’s FieldDefinition results, so its formula is production-supplied rather than independently verified in the sandbox.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c.b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c\` is the JSON rule field; \`b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` defaults false and its help text confirms that a successful rule is hidden unless the checkbox is true. The user supplied production value is true, therefore a successful E&W match shows the Document.\\n\\nEVIDENCE — Active create-only Submission flows must remain unchanged: \`X3B\_Document\_Upload\_Submitted\_Make\_AF\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001rwWTWYA2\`) and \`X3B\_Application\_Form\_Submitted\_Make\_Screening\_Q\_Visible\` v3 (\`301QH00001sD95zYAC\`) unhide assignments through \`Make\_Application\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\` and \`Make\_Screening\_Doc\_Pack\_Visible\`. \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` v4 (\`301Pv000011fFwYIAU\`) creates assignments; v5 (\`301Pv000019pDAXIA2\`) remains Draft and untouched.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION — Do not extend any existing trigger or Flow. Add these five narrowly-scoped unmanaged triggers, all publishing \`Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_e\` configured with \*\*Publish After Commit\*\*:\\n1. \`DocumentReminderSubmissionRefreshTrigger\` — \`after insert, update, delete, undelete\`; publish old and new \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` scopes. This covers submission review/status/expiry updates, deletion/restore, and Assignment lookup reparenting.\\n2. \`DocumentReminderAssignmentRefreshTrigger\` — \`after insert, update, delete, undelete\`; publish the extant Assignment scope, or old Contact scope on delete. React to lifecycle plus \`b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Status\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\`, Contact, and Pack changes.\\n3. \`DocumentReminderDocumentRefreshTrigger\` — \`after insert, update, delete, undelete\`; publish the old/new Pack scope. The subscriber must fan out to all assignments for the pack because a Document addition/removal, JSON condition, or \`Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c\` change alters required-document composition.\\n4. \`DocumentReminderApplicationRefreshTrigger\` — \`after insert, update, delete, undelete\`; publish both old/new Applicant Contact scopes. For updates, limit publication to \`TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\` or \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\` changes. The evaluator must refresh all candidate assignments because conditional-rule semantics are Contact-wide ANY Application, not limited to \`Assignment.Application\_\_c\`.\\n5. \`DocumentReminderJobRefreshTrigger\` — \`after update\` only where \`BH\_Location\_\_c\` changes; publish Job scopes. The subscriber queries Applications by \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\`, then refreshes their Applicants’ assignments. No independent Job insert/delete/undelete hook is needed because Application lifecycle events cover the relevant child state and the Job master-detail cannot be reparented.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION — The platform-event subscriber should deduplicate scopes per event batch, query committed data, and enqueue the evaluator in bulk. This deliberately avoids relying on undefined Apex-trigger/Flow execution order and avoids a Queueable fanout per source save. It is low-latency post-commit processing, not synchronous processing; async backlog can introduce delay and platform-event capacity must be validated against expected source-change volume before approval.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATION — Keep the daily dispatcher for formula date rollover: \`TODAY()\`-based submission/assignment expiry changes without DML and cannot be made immediate by any trigger. No change to \`X3B\_Document\_Distribution\_Process\` v5 or the known Job sync-field typo is justified by this work.",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Maintains Job.Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Job.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* Deliberately thin. Trigger.old : Trigger.new,\\n Trigger.isUpdate ? Trigger.oldMap : null\\n );\\n\\n JobFillRollupHandler.recalculate(jobIds);\\n}"

"text": "That resolves the missing dependency: changing \*\*Job → Location\*\* can change the document’s visibility for every candidate linked to that job. I’ll include that change path, along with application changes and document submissions.\\n\\nThe proposed design will keep the temporary calculation separate from reminder scheduling and SendGrid delivery. That allows us to replace the calculator after the package upgrade without restarting reminder windows or losing send history.\\n\\nProgress updates will run immediately after the save completes in background processing—not wait for the daily reminder job. Salesforce queue delays can still affect when refreshed figures appear.",

"seq": 26265,

"sessionId": "ses\_mu2wbhm7vam4v5pzeLzJ",

#26270tool.call15 Sept 2026, 20:15

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "orchestrator",

"role": "orchestrator",

"toolCallId": "call\_IWkbGzUAz7pLEJ8qWPpcWSQk",

"label": "Submit plan for approval",

▾"input": {

"summary": "Build a removable assignment-progress calculator and a configurable, candidate-level reminder service using Reed’s SendGrid integration. Deploy with reminder sending disabled until sandbox acceptance, capacity checks and template setup are complete.",

"markdown": "## Progress and visibility\\n- Add applicable, completed and outstanding counts, completion %, calculation status and last-calculated time to Document Assignment.\\n- Count each applicable document once, using its latest submission for that assignment; valid Pending Review or Approved means complete.\\n- Exclude hidden conditional documents; preserve the rule’s Contact-wide matching and show-on-success setting.\\n- Treat invalid rules, missing evidence links and empty packs as explicit exceptions—not proof of completion; suppress affected reminders.\\n- Recreate the supplied E&W Application formula in train; monitor its Job Location dependency.\\n- Recalculate after committed submission, assignment, document, application and relevant source-field changes; reconcile expiry/date changes separately.\\n- Register dependencies for newly configured rule targets before use; unsupported dependencies raise an exception rather than silently stale counts.\\n- Extend existing ApplicationJobRollupTrigger and JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger with independent refresh calls; preserve their existing behaviour and unrelated defects.\\n- Add thin refresh hooks where no unmanaged hook exists; use bulk background processing, not per-record email jobs.\\n- Extend Angard read-only field permissions; create an unmanaged Assignment record page preserving details and submissions.\\n## Reminder behaviour\\n- Send one combined reminder per Contact per UK calendar day, listing outstanding documents grouped by eligible pack.\\n- Each assignment starts its own window when first available; first reminder after 24 hours; default cutoff after 10 days.\\n- Process daily from 9am Europe/London, including weekends; admins configure frequency, duration, timing and enablement.\\n- Include recent existing assignments only with verified availability dates; never infer first visibility from creation alone.\\n- Add pack template selection and priority, a default reminder template and an offer-stage template; highest-priority eligible pack selects the wording.\\n- Keep initial emails, rejection notifications, manual resends and existing assignment flows unchanged.\\n## Delivery, context and safeguards\\n- Candidate/staff saves request refresh only; background automation calculates progress and a dedicated authorised scheduling user dispatches reminders.\\n- Reuse the SendGrid Named Credential and transport; extend its delivery contract for reminder results without routing bulk reminders through current event fan-out.\\n- Add a durable candidate/day send log with assignment associations, duplicate-send guards, bounded batches and controlled retries.\\n- Distinguish accepted, delivered, failed and uncertain sends; never blindly retry an uncertain acceptance.\\n- Recheck outstanding documents, visibility, recipient address, opt-out and bounce/suppression eligibility before sending.\\n- Verify the scheduling user’s record access and credential permission; existing Automated Process access alone is insufficient evidence.\\n## Alternatives considered\\n- Formula/roll-up alone: cannot evaluate conditional rules or select the latest submission across these relationships.\\n- Flow-only reminders: unsuitable for conditional evaluation, combined candidate emails and reliable 60,000/day delivery.\\n- Clone Requested Documents: unnecessary temporary per-document records; isolate the calculator instead.\\n## Validation and release\\n- Independent review, bulk/negative/security tests, mocked SendGrid failures and at least 75% Apex coverage, targeting 85%+.\\n- Test E&W Job changes, concurrent/repeated assignments, review/rejection/expiry, duplicates, daylight saving, priorities and restart safety.\\n- Require a clean Salesforce check-only deployment and separate deployment confirmation; no candidate emails during tests.\\n- Deploy sending disabled and jobs unscheduled; admins activate the new page, configure templates/links, grant runner access and approve test recipients.\\n- Before launch, verify installed-version portal parity, representative nonempty packs, SendGrid limits and Salesforce processing/event capacity.\\n## Upgrade and risks\\n- Keep the calculator separate from campaign/send history; after upgrade compare native required/submitted evidence, including expiry, before switching.\\n- Retire legacy calculation hooks only after reconciliation and explicit approval; do not substitute native approved-only completion.\\n- Background queues can delay visible updates; 9am is processing start, not guaranteed delivery time. Existing packs without verified dates stay unenrolled.",

"impact": "Changes apply only to reed2--train initially: assignment progress visible to the 119 users currently assigned Angard, configuration managed by Salesforce admins, and new background processing under a specifically authorised runner. The sandbox currently has 345 assignments, 191 documents and 148 submissions; historical records are not automatically repaired or enrolled. Existing SendGrid callers, managed package components and the draft assignment-distribution flow remain functionally unchanged. Sending remains disabled; production rollout and the 60,000-reminders/day capacity acceptance require separate approval and operational setup."

},

"seq": 26270,

"sessionId": "ses\_mu2wbhm7vam4v5pzeLzJ",

"at": "2026-09-15T17:15:57.233Z"

}

"content": "/\*\\n \* Recalculates Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c —\\n \* count of related TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c records at the filled stage,\\n \* split by Agency\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* FAILURE ISOLATION: this runs from an Application trigger, so an\\n \* unhandled error here would roll back the Application insert or update\\n \* that caused it. Recruiters would be unable to create applications\\n \* because of a problem updating a Job. Two safeguards prevent that:\\n \*\\n \* 1. Database.update(..., false) — a Job that cannot be saved is\\n \* skipped and logged rather than throwing.\\n \* 2. A surrounding try/catch — any unexpected failure is swallowed\\n \* and logged.\\n \*\\n \* Fill counts are reporting figures, not transactional data. A stale\\n \* count is a far smaller problem than a blocked application, and the\\n \* next relevant change to that Job's applications will correct it.\\n \*\\n \* Known related risk: the org's \\"Job: After Create - Create Job Unique\\n \* URL Slug\\" flow calls PQ\_PrepareJobUrlName, which is not bulk safe —\\n \* it processes only the first record of any batch. If that flow is ever\\n \* configured to run on update as well as create, the bulk Job update\\n \* below would trigger it. The partial-success DML means that would\\n \* degrade fill counts rather than break application creation.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class JobFillRollupHandler {\\n\\n private static final String FILLED\_STAGE = 'New Hire';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_ANGARD = 'Angard';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_PERTEMPS = 'Pertemps';\\n\\n /\*\\n \* Works out which Jobs need their counts recalculated.\\n \*\\n \* Pass oldMap only for updates. When it is null the operation is an\\n \* insert, delete or undelete and every referenced Job is affected.\\n \* When it is populated, only Applications where Stage, Agency or the\\n \* Job lookup actually changed are relevant — recalculating on every\\n \* Application update would put needless DML on the Job object, and at\\n \* Peak volumes that is both wasted work and extra opportunity for\\n \* unrelated Job automation to fail.\\n \*\\n \* Separated from the trigger so it can be unit tested with in-memory\\n \* records rather than DML.\\n \*/\\n public static Set<Id> collectAffectedJobIds(\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> records,\\n Map<Id, TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> oldMap\\n ) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n if (records == null) {\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app : records) {\\n if (oldMap == null) {\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c priorVersion = oldMap.get(app.Id);\\n if (priorVersion == null) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n Boolean stageChanged = app.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c;\\n Boolean agencyChanged = app.Agency\_\_c != priorVersion.Agency\_\_c;\\n Boolean jobChanged = app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c;\\n\\n if (!stageChanged && !agencyChanged && !jobChanged) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // Reparenting affects the counts on both Jobs.\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n if (priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n public static void recalculate(Set<Id> jobIds) {\\n if (jobIds == null || jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n try {\\n Map<Id, Integer> angardCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n Map<Id, Integer> pertempsCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n\\n // Default every job to zero first, so jobs that no longer\\n // have matching Applications get reset rather than left stale.\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n angardCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n pertempsCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n 'ANGARD', 'FOS', or null meaning do nothing. \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByAccount(SObject job) {\\n\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && accountRouteOverride != null) {\\n return accountRouteOverride == 'NONE' ? null : accountRouteOverride;\\n }\\n\\n String account = (String) job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c');\\n if (String.isBlank(account)) { return null; }\\n if (account.containsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_ANGARD\_CONTAINS)) { return 'ANGARD'; }\\n if (account.equalsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_FOS\_EQUALS)) { return 'FOS'; }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Business Process decision, in the flow's outcome order.\\n \* Business process and Business Area both live on the JOB.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByBusinessProcess(SObject job) {\\n\\n String bp = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'));\\n String area = String.valueOf(job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c'));\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(bp) || bp == 'null') { return null; }\\n\\n // BAU uses \\"Any Condition Is Met (OR)\\" across three values.\\n if (bp == 'BAU' || bp == 'Aviation' || bp == 'Onsite') { return 'BAU'; }\\n\\n if (bp == 'Delivery') { return 'Delivery'; }\\n if (bp == 'RMSS') { return 'RMSS'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW C&D') { return 'PFW C&D'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW WH HUB') { return 'PFW WH HUB'; }\\n\\n // Fleet, CACIB, Customer Experience, Friends & Family, Returners and\\n // Onsite with CV Upload are out of scope for this sync.\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* \\"Previously Applied with us?\\" - another application for the same applicant,\\n \* created inside the window. Production also requires the same business\\n \* process; where that field does not exist the date match alone is used.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private Boolean hasPriorApplication(SObject app, SObject job,\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact) {\\n\\n List<SObject> priors = priorByContact.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n if (priors == null) { return false; }\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n for (SObject prior : priors) {\\n if ((Id) prior.get('Id') == appId) { continue; }\\n if (!appHasBusProc) { return true; }\\n Object priorBp = prior.get(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC);\\n if (String.valueOf(priorBp) == String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'))) {\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // CONFIGURATION\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private static String ruleKey(String branch, String location) {\\n return branch + '|' + (String.isBlank(location) || location == 'null' ? '' : location);\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean hasField(String objectApi, String fieldApi) {\\n Schema.SObjectType t = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get(objectApi.toLowerCase());\\n return t != null && t.getDescribe().fields.getMap().containsKey(fieldApi.toLowerCase());\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Resolves every configured setting field to a live pack Id in THIS org.\\n \* Returns a reason to abort, or null when the configuration is usable.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String loadAndValidateConfiguration() {\\n\\n if (packIdsByRule != null) { return null; } // injected by a test\\n\\n packIdsByRule = new Map<String, List<Id>>();\\n hiddenPackIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n SObject setting = X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.getOrgDefaults();\\n if (setting == null) {\\n return 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c has no organisation defaults '\\n + 'in this org. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> settingFields =\\n Schema.SObjectType.X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.fields.getMap();\\n\\n List<String> problems = new List<String>();\\n Set<Id> configured = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n basePackId = readPack(setting, settingFields, SETTING\_FIELD\_BASE\_PACK, problems);\\n if (basePackId != null) { configured.add(basePackId); }\\n\\n for (String key : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.keySet()) {\\n List<Id> ids = new List<Id>();\\n for (String fieldName : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.get(key)) {\\n Id packId = readPack(setting, settingFields, fieldName, problems);\\n if (packId == null) { continue; }\\n ids.add(packId);\\n if (HIDDEN\_PACK\_FIELDS.contains(fieldName)) { hiddenPackIds.add(packId); }\\n configured.add(packId);\\n }\\n if (!ids.isEmpty()) { packIdsByRule.put(key, ids); }\\n }\\n\\n if (!problems.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'Document pack configuration is not usable in this org. Nothing was '\\n + 'created.\\\\n - ' + String.join(problems, '\\\\n - ');\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> live = new Map<Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c>(\[\\n SELECT Id FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c WHERE Id IN :configured \]).keySet();\\n\\n Set<Id> missing = new Set<Id>(configured);\\n missing.removeAll(live);\\n\\n if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'These Document Pack Ids are configured on '\\n + 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c but do not exist in this org: '\\n + String.join(new List<Id>(missing), ', ') + '. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n private Id readPack(SObject setting, Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> fields,\\n String fieldName, List<String> problems) {\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(fieldName)) { return null; }\\n\\n if (!fields.containsKey(fieldName.toLowerCase())) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName\\n + ' does not exist on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n Object raw = setting.get(fieldName);\\n String val = (raw == null) ? '' : String.valueOf(raw);\\n if (String.isBlank(val)) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' is empty in this org.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n try {\\n return (Id) val;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' does not hold a valid Id: ' + val);\\n return null;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // FINISH\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) {\\n\\n if (syncFieldExists() && !jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n Schema.SObjectType jobType = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get('tr1\_\_job\_\_c');\\n List<SObject> toReset = new List<SObject>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject j = jobType.newSObject(jobId);\\n j.put(SYNC\_FIELD, false);\\n toReset.add(j);\\n }\\n suppressTrigger = true;\\n try {\\n update toReset;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n errorLog.add('Could not reset Sync checkbox: ' + e.getMessage());\\n } finally {\\n suppressTrigger = false;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (abortReason != null) {\\n String failure = 'Sync Document Assignments - NOT RUN\\\\n\\\\n' + abortReason + '\\\\n';\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, failure);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - configuration error', failure);\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n String body =\\n 'Sync Document Assignments\\\\n\\\\n'\\n + 'Jobs ..................................... ' + jobIds.size() + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Applications scanned ..................... ' + scanned + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Document Assignments created ............. ' + assignmentsMade + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - already had an assignment ...... ' + skippedLinked + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - Account not Angard or FOS ...... ' + skippedAccount + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no matching branch ............. ' + skippedNoBranch + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - FOS account (out of scope) ..... ' + skippedFos + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no pack configured ............. ' + skippedNoPack + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - applied in last '\\n + RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS + ' days ......... ' + skippedRecent + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Failed rows .............................. ' + failedRows + '\\\\n';\\n\\n if (!errorLog.isEmpty()) {\\n body += '\\\\nDetail\\\\n------\\\\n';\\n for (String line : errorLog) { body += line + '\\\\n'; }\\n }\\n\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject job = jobsById.get(jobId);\\n if (job != null) {\\n body += '\\\\nJob: ' + job.get('Name')\\n + '\\\\n Account .......... ' + job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business process . ' + job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business Area .... ' + job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Location ......... ' + job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c');\\n if (jobHasRoleType) {\\n body += '\\\\n FOS Role Type .... ' + job.get(F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE);\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, body);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - '\\n + assignmentsMade + ' created, ' + failedRows + ' failed', body);\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // HELPERS\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c buildAssignment(SObject app, Id packId) {\\n return new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = (Id) app.get('Id'),\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = (Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'),\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = hiddenPackIds != null && hiddenPackIds.contains(packId)\\n );\\n }\\n\\n private void sendSummary(String subject, String body) {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest()) { return; }\\n try {\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage mail = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage();\\n mail.setToAddresses(new List<String>{ UserInfo.getUserEmail() });\\n mail.setSubject(subject);\\n mail.setPlainTextBody(body);\\n mail.setSaveAsActivity(false);\\n Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{ mail });\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, 'Summary email failed: ' + e.getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Flow/Apex entry point for sending email through SendGrid.\\n \* Mirrors the shape of a native email alert / Send Email action: give it a\\n \* template + Contact, or a raw address + body. It only publishes a platform\\n \* event, so it is safe to call from record-triggered flows, guest users and\\n \* bulk jobs; the actual callout happens async as the Automated Process user.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class SendGridEmailInvocable {\\n\\n public class Request {\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Email Template Name' description='DeveloperName of the Classic Email Template to render (merge fields resolved from Recipient Contact Id + Related Record Id)')\\n public String templateName;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Recipient Contact Id' description='Contact to send to (uses its Email). Also the Name/Who on the activity log.')\\n public Id recipientId;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Related Record Id' description='Record used for template merge fields and as the Related To of the activity log')\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='To Email Address' description='Send to this address instead of (or in addition to resolving) a Contact')\\n public String toAddress;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Subject' description='Subject when no template is used')\\n public String subject;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='Plain Text Body' description='Body when no template is used')\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='HTML Body' description='HTML body when no template is used')\\n public String htmlBody;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='From Address' description='Must be a SendGrid verified sender. Defaults to SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.Default')\\n public String fromAddress;\\n\\n @InvocableVariable(label='From Name')\\n public String fromName;\\n }\\n\\n @InvocableMethod(label='Send Email via SendGrid' category='Email'\\n description='Queues an email for delivery through SendGrid and logs a Task on the related record. Delivery status is updated by the SendGrid event webhook.')\\n public static void send(List<Request> requests) {\\n List<SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest> emails = new List<SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest>();\\n for (Request r : requests) {\\n if (String.isBlank(r.templateName) && String.isBlank(r.plainTextBody) && String.isBlank(r.htmlBody)) {\\n throw new SendGridEmailService.SendGridException('Send Email via SendGrid: provide an Email Template Name or a body.');\\n }\\n if (r.recipientId == null && String.isBlank(r.toAddress)) {\\n throw new SendGridEmailService.SendGridException('Send Email via SendGrid: provide a Recipient Contact Id or a To Email Address.');\\n }\\n SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest em = new SendGridEmailService.EmailRequest();\\n em.templateName = r.templateName;\\n em.recipientId = r.recipientId;\\n em.relatedRecordId = r.relatedRecordId;\\n em.toAddress = r.toAddress;\\n em.subject = r.subject;\\n em.plainTextBody = r.plainTextBody;\\n em.htmlBody = r.htmlBody;\\n em.fromAddress = r.fromAddress;\\n em.fromName = r.fromName;\\n emails.add(em);\\n }\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'SendGrid Invocable.');\\n SendGridEmailService.publish(emails);\\n }\\n}"

"fullName": "SendGridWebhook",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* SendGrid Event Webhook receiver.\\n \* Expose via a public Site; configure SendGrid to POST to:\\n \* https://<site-domain>/services/apexrest/sendgrid/events?token=<Webhook\_Secret\_\_c>\\n \* Events carry our custom arg sf\_ref, which matches Task.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\\n \* on the activity logged at send time.\\n \*/\\n@RestResource(urlMapping='/sendgrid/events')\\nglobal without sharing class SendGridWebhook {\\n\\n @TestVisible private static String secretOverride;\\n\\n @HttpPost\\n global static void handleEvents() {\\n RestRequest req = RestContext.request;\\n RestResponse res = RestContext.response;\\n\\n // ponytail: shared-secret query param instead of ECDSA signature verification (unsupported by Apex Crypto)\\n String secret = secretOverride != null ? secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || req.params.get('token') != secret) {\\n res.statusCode = 401;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n List<Object> events;\\n try {\\n events = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(req.requestBody.toString());\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n res.statusCode = 400;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Keep only the newest event per sf\_ref in this batch.\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> latestByRef = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object o : events) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = (Map<String, Object>) o;\\n String ref = (String) ev.get('sf\_ref');\\n if (String.isBlank(ref)) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> current = latestByRef.get(ref);\\n if (current == null || epoch(ev) >= epoch(current)) {\\n latestByRef.put(ref, ev);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!latestByRef.isEmpty()) {\\n List<Task> updates = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task t : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = latestByRef.get(t.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n String reason = (String) ev.get('reason');\\n t.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = ((String) ev.get('event'))?.abbreviate(40);\\n t.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = reason?.abbreviate(255);\\n t.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(ev) \* 1000);\\n updates.add(t);\\n }\\n Database.update(updates, false);\\n }\\n res.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> ev) {\\n Object ts = ev.get('timestamp');\\n return ts == null ? 0 : Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(ts));\\n }\\n}"

▾{

"path": "triggers/ApplicationJobRollupTrigger.trigger",

"metadataType": "ApexTrigger",

"fullName": "ApplicationJobRollupTrigger",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Maintains Job.Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Job.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* Deliberately thin. All decision logic lives in JobFillRollupHandler\\n \* so it can be unit tested directly — Applications cannot be updated\\n \* via DML in this org (field-level security blocks it, and\\n \* TR1\_\_Job\_\_c is not writeable after insert), so the update path is\\n \* unreachable from a test that relies on real DML.\\n \*/\\ntrigger ApplicationJobRollupTrigger on TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c (\\n after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\\n) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(\\n Trigger.isDelete ? Trigger.old : Trigger.new,\\n Trigger.isUpdate ? Trigger.oldMap : null\\n );\\n\\n JobFillRollupHandler.recalculate(jobIds);\\n}"

},

}

▾"output": \[

▾{

"path": "triggers/JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger.trigger",

"size": 844,

"metadataType": "ApexTrigger",

"fullName": "JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger",

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update) {\\n\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) {\\n jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}"

},

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* DocumentAssignmentSyncBatchTest\\n \* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n \* Reed case #00003380.\\n \*\\n \* DESIGN NOTE - why this class looks the way it does.\\n \*\\n \* Reed's org fires a lot of automation on Job, Contact and Application V2.\\n \* Every failure this test class has produced so far has been Reed automation\\n \* rejecting the test's data, never the class under test. If any of these fail the fault is in the test's data,\\n // not in the class - and the message says which link is broken.\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c check = \[\\n SELECT BH\_Business\_process\_\_c, BH\_Location\_\_c\\n FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\];\\n System.assertEquals(BUSINESS\_PROCESS, check.BH\_Business\_process\_\_c,\\n 'PRECONDITION: Job.BH\_Business\_process\_\_c did not save.');\\n System.assertEquals(LOCATION, check.BH\_Location\_\_c,\\n 'PRECONDITION: Job.BH\_Location\_\_c did not save.');\\n\\n System.assertEquals(apps.size(), \[\\n SELECT COUNT() FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\\n WHERE TR1\_\_Job\_\_c = :job.Id\\n AND TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c != null\\n AND BH\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c = null\],\\n 'PRECONDITION: the batch targeting query cannot see the test applications. cleared so the Job can be synced again.');\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // Account gate - Production creates nothing outside Angard / Anything else in\\n \* Reed's org may create assignments too; those are none of our business.\\n \*/\\n private static List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> ours(List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> apps) {\\n Set<Id> packIds = new Set<Id>{ basePackId, branchPackId, formPackId };\\n return \[\\n SELECT Id, Application\_\_c, b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c, b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\\n FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\\n WHERE Application\_\_c IN :apps\\n AND b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c IN :packIds\\n \];\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* The class resolves real Document Pack Ids from a hierarchy custom setting,\\n \* which holds no data in a test context. }\\n rtResolved = true;\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.RecordTypeInfo> jobRts =\\n Schema.SObjectType.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName();\\n Map<String, Schema.RecordTypeInfo> appRts =\\n Schema.SObjectType.TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName();\\n\\n // Preferred names first, then any other name common to both objects.\\n List<String> order = new List<String>{ 'Angard', 'Angard\_BAU', 'Application' };\\n for (String dn : jobRts.keySet()) {\\n if (!order.contains(dn)) { order.add(dn); }\\n }\\n\\n for (String dn : order) {\\n if (usable(jobRts.get(dn)) && usable(appRts.get(dn))) {\\n jobRecordTypeId = jobRts.get(dn).getRecordTypeId();\\n appRecordTypeId = appRts.get(dn).getRecordTypeId();\\n return;\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean usable(Schema.RecordTypeInfo info) {\\n return info != null && info.isAvailable() && info.isActive() && !info.isMaster();\\n }\\n\\n private static TR1\_\_Job\_\_c buildJob(String businessProcess, String location) {\\n resolveRecordTypes();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = new TR1\_\_Job\_\_c();\\n // A distinct, non-blank Name matters: Reed's \\"Job: After Create - Create\\n // Job Unique URL Slug\\" flow builds the slug from it and fails on null.\\n setIfWriteable(job, 'Name', 'ZZ Apex Test Job ' + uniqueSuffix());\\n setIfWriteable(job, 'BH\_Business\_process\_\_c', businessProcess);\\n setIfWriteable(job, 'BH\_Location\_\_c', location);\\n setIfWriteable(job, 'TR1\_\_Account\_\_c', rpoAccount());\\n if (jobRecordTypeId != null) { job.RecordTypeId = jobRecordTypeId; 'NULL - the injection was lost'\\n : String.valueOf(DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.packIdsByRule.keySet())) + '\\\\n';\\n\\n // 5. Did something already link these applications, making them skip?\\n r += 'assignments already on apps : '\\n + \[SELECT COUNT() FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c WHERE Application\_\_c IN :apps\] + '\\\\n';\\n\\n // 6. Does the FULL shape the batch inserts survive, not just one row?\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> rows = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < apps.size(); i++) {\\n for (Id packId : new List<Id>{ basePackId, branchPackId, formPackId }) {\\n rows.add(new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = apps\[i\].Id,\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = candidates\[i\].Id,\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = (packId == formPackId)));\\n }\\n }\\n Integer ok = 0;\\n String firstError = 'none';\\n try {\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : Database.insert(rows, false)) {\\n if (sr.isSuccess()) {\\n ok++;\\n } else if (firstError == 'none') {\\n firstError = sr.getErrors()\[0\].getStatusCode() + ' - '\\n + sr.getErrors()\[0\].getMessage() + ' '\\n + sr.getErrors()\[0\].getFields();\\n }\\n }\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n firstError = e.getTypeName() + ': ' + e.getMessage();\\n }\\n r += 'bulk probe ' + rows.size() + ' rows : ' + ok\\n + ' succeeded, first error: ' + firstError + '\\\\n';\\n\\n System.assert(false, r);\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Runs the batch synchronously, inside this transaction.\\n \*\\n \* WHY NOT Database.executeBatch. ' +\\n 'This bypass depends on at least one such record existing in the org.'\\n );\\n }\\n return existing\[0\];\\n }\\n\\n private static TR1\_\_Job\_\_c createTestJob(Id accountId, String jobName) {\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = new TR1\_\_Job\_\_c(\\n Name = jobName,\\n TR1\_\_Account\_\_c = accountId,\\n TR1\_\_Contact\_\_c = getHiringManagerContact().Id,\\n RecordTypeId = getRecordTypeId('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c', JOB\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME),\\n // Unique\_Job\_URL\_\_c's formula returns '' when this is blank,\\n // which the \\"Create Job Unique URL Slug\\" Flow rejects as an\\n // invalid slug. 'Angard' is the CASE branch that produces a\\n // real URL.\\n PQ\_Client\_Program\_\_c = 'Angard',\\n // The Flow's actual slug-generation Apex (PQ\_PrepareJobUrlName)\\n // builds the slug from THIS field, not PQ\_Client\_Program\_\_c —\\n // null here produces a null slug regardless of the above.\\n TR1\_\_Job\_Title\_\_c = jobName\\n );\\n insert job;\\n return job;\\n }\\n\\n private static TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c buildApplication(Id jobId, Id contactId, String stage, String agency) {\\n return new TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c(\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c = jobId,\\n TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c = contactId,\\n RecordTypeId = getRecordTypeId('TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c', APPLICATION\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME),\\n TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c = stage,\\n Agency\_\_c = agency\\n );\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCountsOnInsert() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = createTestJob(acc.Id, 'Test Job - Insert');\\n\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> apps = new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>();\\n\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Angard', 'Candidate ' + i);\\n apps.add(buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard'));\\n }\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < 2; i++) {\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Pertemps', 'Candidate ' + i);\\n apps.add(buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Pertemps'));\\n }\\n // Not at the filled stage — should NOT be counted.\\n Contact notFilled = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'NotFilled', 'Candidate');\\n apps.add(buildApplication(job.Id, notFilled.Id, NOT\_FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard'));\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n insert apps;\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c updatedJob = \[\\n SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c, Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c\\n FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\\n WHERE Id = :job.Id\\n \];\\n System.assertEquals(3, updatedJob.Angard\_Filled\_\_c, 'Angard filled count should be 3');\\n System.assertEquals(2, updatedJob.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c, 'Pertemps filled count should be 2');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCountsUpdateOnStageChange() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = createTestJob(acc.Id, 'Test Job - Stage Change');\\n\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Angard', 'Candidate');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app = buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, NOT\_FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n insert app;\\n\\n System.assertEquals(0,\\n \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\].Angard\_Filled\_\_c,\\n 'Should not be counted before reaching the filled stage');\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n // A fresh, narrow record — NOT the one built and inserted above.\\n // Fields assigned during construction stay dirty through the\\n // insert and are re-sent on update. TR1\_\_Job\_\_c is among them and\\n // is not updateable, so the package's own Application trigger\\n // strips it and rejects the operation. Sending only Id and the\\n // field being changed avoids that entirely.\\n update new TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c(Id = app.Id, TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c = FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE);\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n System.assertEquals(1,\\n \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\].Angard\_Filled\_\_c,\\n 'Should be counted once moved to the filled stage');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCountsUpdateOnAgencyChange() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = createTestJob(acc.Id, 'Test Job - Agency Change');\\n\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Agency', 'Candidate');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app = buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n insert app;\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n update new TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c(Id = app.Id, Agency\_\_c = 'Pertemps');\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c updated = \[\\n SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c, Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\\n \];\\n System.assertEquals(0, updated.Angard\_Filled\_\_c, 'Angard count should drop after the agency change');\\n System.assertEquals(1, updated.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c, 'Pertemps count should pick it up');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCountsDecrementOnDelete() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = createTestJob(acc.Id, 'Test Job - Delete');\\n\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Angard', 'Candidate');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app = buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n insert app;\\n\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c jobAfterInsert = \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\];\\n System.assertEquals(1, jobAfterInsert.Angard\_Filled\_\_c);\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n delete app;\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c jobAfterDelete = \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\];\\n System.assertEquals(0, jobAfterDelete.Angard\_Filled\_\_c, 'Count should drop back to 0 after delete');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testBulkInsertAcrossMultipleJobs() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n Id hiringManagerId = getHiringManagerContact().Id;\\n\\n // Inserted one at a time deliberately — PQ\_PrepareJobUrlName (the\\n // org's URL-slug Flow action) only reads requestList\[0\] and isn't\\n // bulk-safe, so a single bulk insert of multiple Jobs produces a\\n // null slug for every Job after the first. That's a pre-existing\\n // bug in that Apex, not ours to fix here — this just avoids\\n // triggering it. The Application insert below is still fully\\n // bulk, which is what this test actually needs to prove.\\n List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> jobs = new List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = new TR1\_\_Job\_\_c(\\n Name = 'Bulk Test Job ' + i,\\n TR1\_\_Account\_\_c = acc.Id,\\n TR1\_\_Contact\_\_c = hiringManagerId,\\n RecordTypeId = getRecordTypeId('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c', JOB\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME),\\n PQ\_Client\_Program\_\_c = 'Angard',\\n TR1\_\_Job\_Title\_\_c = 'Bulk Test Job ' + i\\n );\\n insert job;\\n jobs.add(job);\\n }\\n\\n // Bulk-insert all 200 candidate Contacts in one DML statement\\n // rather than one insert per Contact — 200 individual inserts\\n // would blow the 150-DML-statement-per-transaction governor limit.\\n List<Contact> candidates = new List<Contact>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < 200; i++) {\\n candidates.add(new Contact(\\n FirstName = 'Bulk',\\n LastName = 'Candidate ' + i,\\n AccountId = acc.Id\\n ));\\n }\\n insert candidates;\\n\\n Id appRecordTypeId = getRecordTypeId('TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c', APPLICATION\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME);\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> apps = new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>();\\n Integer candidateIndex = 0;\\n for (TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job : jobs) {\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < 40; i++) {\\n apps.add(new TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c(\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c = job.Id,\\n TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c = candidates\[candidateIndex\].Id,\\n RecordTypeId = appRecordTypeId,\\n TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c = FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE,\\n Agency\_\_c = Math.mod(i, 2) == 0 ? 'Angard' : 'Pertemps'\\n ));\\n candidateIndex++;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n insert apps; // 200 Applications across 5 Jobs — bulk / governor-limit safety check\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> updatedJobs = \[\\n SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c, Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c\\n FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c\\n WHERE Id IN :jobs\\n \];\\n for (TR1\_\_Job\_\_c j : updatedJobs) {\\n System.assertEquals(20, j.Angard\_Filled\_\_c, 'Each job should have 20 Angard-filled apps');\\n System.assertEquals(20, j.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c, 'Each job should have 20 Pertemps-filled apps');\\n }\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCountsOnUndelete() {\\n Account acc = createTestAccount();\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job = createTestJob(acc.Id, 'Undelete');\\n\\n Contact candidate = createTestContact(acc.Id, 'Undelete', 'Candidate');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app = buildApplication(job.Id, candidate.Id, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n insert app;\\n delete app;\\n\\n System.assertEquals(0,\\n \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\].Angard\_Filled\_\_c,\\n 'Count should be 0 while deleted');\\n\\n Test.startTest();\\n undelete app;\\n Test.stopTest();\\n\\n System.assertEquals(1,\\n \[SELECT Angard\_Filled\_\_c FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :job.Id\].Angard\_Filled\_\_c,\\n 'Count should return after undelete');\\n }\\n\\n // ---- In-memory coverage of the change-detection logic ----\\n //\\n // Applications cannot be updated via DML in this org: field-level\\n // security blocks the operation and TR1\_\_Job\_\_c is not writeable\\n // after insert. The update path is therefore unreachable from a\\n // DML-based test. collectAffectedJobIds is tested directly instead,\\n // with records built by JSON deserialisation so that Ids and\\n // read-only fields can be populated in memory.\\n\\n private static Integer fakeIdCounter = 1;\\n\\n private static Id fakeId(Schema.SObjectType sobjectType) {\\n return sobjectType.getDescribe().getKeyPrefix()\\n + String.valueOf(fakeIdCounter++).leftPad(12, '0');\\n }\\n\\n private static TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c inMemoryApp(Id appId, Id jobId, String stage, String agency) {\\n Map<String, Object> fields = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'Id' => appId,\\n 'TR1\_\_Job\_\_c' => jobId,\\n 'TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c' => stage,\\n 'Agency\_\_c' => agency\\n };\\n return (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c) JSON.deserialize(\\n JSON.serialize(fields), TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.class\\n );\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCollectOnInsertOrDelete() {\\n Id jobId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n Id appId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> records = new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>{\\n inMemoryApp(appId, jobId, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard')\\n };\\n\\n Set<Id> result = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(records, null);\\n\\n System.assertEquals(1, result.size(), 'Should return the one referenced Job');\\n System.assert(result.contains(jobId));\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCollectIgnoresNullJobLookup() {\\n Id appId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> records = new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>{\\n inMemoryApp(appId, null, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard')\\n };\\n\\n System.assertEquals(0,\\n JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(records, null).size(),\\n 'An Application with no Job should contribute nothing');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCollectOnStageChange() {\\n Id jobId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n Id appId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c priorVersion = inMemoryApp(appId, jobId, NOT\_FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c updated = inMemoryApp(appId, jobId, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Angard');\\n\\n Set<Id> result = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(\\n new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>{ updated },\\n new Map<Id, TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>{ appId => priorVersion }\\n );\\n\\n System.assertEquals(1, 'Angard');\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c updated = inMemoryApp(appId, jobId, FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE, 'Pertemps');\\n\\n Set<Id> result = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(\\n new static void testCollectSkipsIrrelevantChange() {\\n Id jobId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n Id appId = fakeId(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.SObjectType);\\n\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c ).size(),\\n 'No relevant field changed, so no Job should be recalculated');\\n }\\n\\n @isTest\\n static void testCollectHandlesNullInput() {\\n System.assertEquals(0,\\n "content": "/\*\*\\n \* Centralised reminder configuration. Metadata is deliberately fail-closed:\\n \* missing, invalid, or disabled settings never permit a reminder send.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class DocumentReminderSettings {\\n public class ConfigurationException extends Exception {}\\n\\n public class Values {\\n public Boolean processorEnabled;\\n public Boolean sendingEnabled;\\n public Boolean dryRun;\\n public Boolean suppressionVerificationReady;\\n public Boolean securityVerified;\\n public Integer startHour;\\n public String timeZoneId;\\n public Integer frequencyDays;\\n public Integer durationDays;\\n public String portalEntryUrl;\\n public String defaultTemplateDeveloperName;\\n public Set<String> recipientAllowlist;\\n public Integer refreshBatchSize;\\n public Integer sendBatchSize;\\n public Integer leaseMinutes;\\n public Integer retryBackoffMinutes;\\n public Integer retentionDays;\\n }\\n\\n @TestVisible private static Values overrideValues;\\n\\n public static Values get() {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && overrideValues != null) {\\n return overrideValues;\\n }\\n Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt row = Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (row == null) {\\n throw new ConfigurationException('Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n }\\n Values v = new Values();\\n v.processorEnabled = row.Processor\_Enabled\_\_c;\\n v.sendingEnabled = row.Sending\_Enabled\_\_c;\\n v.dryRun = row.Dry\_Run\_\_c;\\n v.suppressionVerificationReady = row.Suppression\_Verification\_Ready\_\_c;\\n v.securityVerified = row.Security\_Verified\_\_c;\\n v.startHour = bounded(row.Start\_Hour\_\_c, 9, 0, 23, 'Start Hour');\\n v.timeZoneId = String.isBlank(row.Time\_Zone\_\_c) ? 'Europe/London' : row.Time\_Zone\_\_c.trim();\\n try { TimeZone.getTimeZone(v.timeZoneId); } catch (Exception e) {\\n throw new ConfigurationException('Invalid reminder Time Zone: ' + v.timeZoneId);\\n }\\n v.frequencyDays = bounded(row.Frequency\_Days\_\_c, 1, 1, 365, 'Frequency Days');\\n v.durationDays = bounded(row.Duration\_Days\_\_c, 10, 1, 365, 'Duration Days');\\n v.portalEntryUrl = row.Portal\_Entry\_Url\_\_c;\\n v.defaultTemplateDeveloperName = row.Default\_Template\_Developer\_Name\_\_c;\\n v.refreshBatchSize = bounded(row.Refresh\_Batch\_Size\_\_c, 100, 1, 200, 'Refresh Batch Size');\\n v.sendBatchSize = bounded(row.Send\_Batch\_Size\_\_c, 20, 1, 50, 'Send Batch Size');\\n v.leaseMinutes = bounded(row.Lease\_Minutes\_\_c, 15, 1, 120, 'Lease Minutes');\\n v.retryBackoffMinutes = bounded(row.Retry\_Backoff\_Minutes\_\_c, 30, 1, 1440, 'Retry Backoff Minutes');\\n v.retentionDays = bounded(row.Retention\_Days\_\_c, 180, 30, 3650, 'Retention Days');\\n v.recipientAllowlist = parseAllowlist(row.Recipient\_Allowlist\_\_c);\\n return v;\\n }\\n\\n public static Date ukDate(Datetime when, String zone) {\\n return Date.valueOf(when.format('yyyy-MM-dd', zone));\\n }\\n\\n public static Boolean allowlisted(String email, Values settings) {\\n return String.isNotBlank(email) && settings.recipientAllowlist.contains(email.trim().toLowerCase());\\n }\\n\\n private static Integer bounded(Decimal source, Integer fallback, Integer min, Integer max, String label) {\\n Integer val = source == null ? fallback : Integer.valueOf(source);\\n if (val < min || val > max) {\\n throw new ConfigurationException(label + ' must be between ' + min + ' and ' + max + '.');\\n }\\n return val;\\n }\\n\\n private static Set<String> parseAllowlist(String source) {\\n Set<String> values = new Set<String>();\\n if (String.isBlank(source)) { return values; }\\n for (String value : source.split('\[;\\\\\\\\n,\]')) {\\n if (String.isNotBlank(value)) { values.add(value.trim().toLowerCase()); }\\n }\\n return values;\\n }\\n}",

unregistered target/dependency shapes\\n \* are explicit errors rather than silently stale progress.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator {\\n public class RuleException extends Exception {}\\n public class Evaluation {\\n public Boolean matched;\\n public String error;\\n }\\n private class Dependency {\\n String targetObject;\\n String targetField;\\n Integer childLimit;\\n }\\n\\n public static Evaluation evaluate(String json, Id contactId,\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications) {\\n Evaluation result = new Evaluation();\\n if (String.isBlank(json)) { result.matched = true; }\\n return combine(values, 'AND');\\n }\\n if (!(raw instanceof Map<String, Object>)) {\\n throw new RuleException('Rule node is not an object.');\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> node = (Map<String, Object>) raw;\\n if (isCondition(node)) { return evaluateCondition(node, applications, dependencies); }\\n List<Object> children = childNodes(node);\\n if (children.isEmpty()) { throw new RuleException('Rule group contains no conditions.'); }\\n List<Boolean> values = new List<Boolean>();\\n for (Object child : children) { values.add(evaluateNode(child, applications, dependencies)); }\\n String expression = first(node, new List<String>{'customExpression', 'customLogic', 'expression'});\\n if (String.isNotBlank(expression)) { return evaluateExpression(expression, values); }\\n return combine(values, logic(node));\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean isCondition(Map<String, Object> node) {\\n return String.isNotBlank(first(node, new List<String>{'targetObject','target','object','objectApiName'}))\\n || (String.isNotBlank(first(node, new List<String>{'field','fieldName','targetField'}))\\n && String.isNotBlank(first(node, new List<String>{'operator','comparison'})));\\n }\\n\\n private static List<Object> childNodes(Map<String, Object> node) {\\n for (String name : new List<String>{'conditionGroups','groups','conditions','rules','items','children'}) {\\n Object value = getIgnoreCase(node, name);\\n if (value instanceof List<Object>) { return (List<Object>) value; }\\n }\\n return new List<Object>();\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean evaluateCondition(Map<String, Object> node,\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications, Map<String, Dependency> dependencies) {\\n String target = first(node, new List<String>{'targetObject','target','object','objectApiName'});\\n String field = first(node, new List<String>{'targetField','fieldName','field','apiName'});\\n if (String.isBlank(target) && String.isNotBlank(field) && field.contains('\*')) {\\n List<String> parts = field.split('\\\\\\\\\*');\\n if (parts.size() >= 3) {\\n target = parts\[0\] + '\*' + parts\[1\];\\n field = parts\[2\];\\n }\\n }\\n if (String.isBlank(target) || String.isBlank(field)) {\\n throw new RuleException('Condition has no target object and field.');\\n }\\n target = target.trim(); Register a supported dependency and refresh hook before use.');\\n }\\n if (target != 'TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c' || field != 'E\_W\_Location\_\_c') {\\n throw new RuleException('Registered dependency has no evaluator implementation: ' + target + '.' + field);\\n }\\n String reduction = first(node, new List<String>{'childMatch','recordMatch','matchType','reduction'});\\n if (String.isNotBlank(reduction) && reduction.toUpperCase() != 'ANY') {\\n throw new RuleException('Unsupported child reduction ' + reduction + '; only product ANY is registered.');\\n }\\n String op = first(node, new List<String>{'comparison','operator','comparisonOperator'});\\n String expected = first(node, new List<String>{'value','comparisonValue','targetValue'});\\n if (String.isBlank(op)) { throw new RuleException('Condition has no comparison operator.'); }\\n Integer read = 0;\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app : applications) {\\n if (read++ >= dependency.childLimit) { break; }\\n if (matchesBoolean(app.E\_W\_Location\_\_c, op, expected)) { return true; }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean matchesBoolean(Boolean actual, String operation, String rawExpected) {\\n String op = operation.replace('\_', '').replace(' ', '').toUpperCase();\\n if (op == 'ISNULL') { return actual == null; }\\n if (op == 'ISNOTNULL' || op == 'NOTNULL') { return actual != null; }\\n if (op != 'EQUALS' && op != 'EQUAL' && op != 'NOTEQUALS' && op != 'NOTEQUAL') {\\n throw new RuleException('Unsupported Boolean comparison ' + operation + '.');\\n }\\n Boolean expected;\\n if (String.valueOf(rawExpected).toLowerCase() == 'true') { expected = true; }\\n else if (String.valueOf(rawExpected).toLowerCase() == 'false') { expected = false; }\\n else { throw new RuleException('Boolean comparison value must be true or false.'); }\\n Boolean equal = actual != null && actual == expected;\\n return op.startsWith('NOT') ? !equal : equal;\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean combine(List<Boolean> values, String operation) {\\n String op = String.isBlank(operation) ? 'AND' : operation.toUpperCase();\\n if (op != 'AND' && op != 'OR' && op != 'ANY' && op != 'ALL') {\\n throw new RuleException('Unsupported rule logic ' + operation + '.');\\n }\\n Boolean wantAll = op == 'AND' || op == 'ALL';\\n for (Boolean value : values) {\\n if (wantAll && !value) { return false; }\\n if (!wantAll && value) { return true; }\\n }\\n return wantAll;\\n }\\n\\n // Positional expressions from the product format, e.g. \\"1 AND (2 OR 3)\\".\\n private static Boolean evaluateExpression(String expression, List<Boolean> values) {\\n String rendered = expression;\\n for (Integer i = values.size(); i >= 1; i--) {\\n rendered = rendered.replaceAll('(?i)\\\\\\\\b' + i + '\\\\\\\\b', values\[i - 1\] ? 'true' : 'false');\\n }\\n if (rendered.replaceAll('(?i)true|false|and|or|not|\[()\\\\\\\\s\]', '').length() > 0) {\\n throw new RuleException('Unsupported custom rule expression.');\\n }\\n while (rendered.contains('(')) {\\n Integer closeAt = rendered.indexOf(')');\\n Integer openAt = rendered.lastIndexOf('(', closeAt);\\n if (openAt < 0) { throw new RuleException('Unbalanced custom rule expression.'); }\\n rendered = rendered.substring(0, openAt) + evalFlat(rendered.substring(openAt + 1, closeAt))\\n + rendered.substring(closeAt + 1);\\n }\\n return evalFlat(rendered) == 'true';\\n }\\n\\n private static String evalFlat(String source) {\\n List<String> orParts = source.trim().split('(?i)\\\\\\\\s+OR\\\\\\\\s+');\\n for (String orPart : orParts) {\\n Boolean all = true;\\n for (String andPart : orPart.trim().split('(?i)\\\\\\\\s+AND\\\\\\\\s+')) {\\n String token = andPart.trim().toLowerCase();\\n Boolean negated = token.startsWith('not ');\\n if (negated) { token = token.substring(4).trim(); }\\n if (token != 'true' && token != 'false') { throw new RuleException('Unsupported custom rule expression.'); }\\n Boolean val = token == 'true';\\n all = all && (negated ? !val : val);\\n }\\n if (all) { return 'true'; }\\n }\\n return 'false';\\n }\\n\\n private static String logic(Map<String, Object> node) {\\n String answer = first(node, new List<String>{'conditionLogic','logic','logicalOperator','operator'});\\n return String.isBlank(answer) || answer.toUpperCase() == 'DEFAULT' ? 'AND' : answer;\\n }\\n private static String first(Map<String, Object> source, List<String> names) {\\n for (String name : names) {\\n Object value = getIgnoreCase(source, name);\\n if (value != null && String.isNotBlank(String.valueOf(value))) { return String.valueOf(value); }\\n }\\n return null;\\n }\\n private static Object getIgnoreCase(Map<String, Object> source, String name) {\\n for (String actual : source.keySet()) { if (actual.toLowerCase() == name.toLowerCase()) { return source.get(actual); } }\\n return null;\\n }\\n private static String stripType(String field) { return field.contains('\*') ? field.substring(0, field.indexOf('\*')).trim() : field.trim(); }\\n private static String key(String objectName, String fieldName) { return objectName.toLowerCase() + '|' + fieldName.toLowerCase(); }\\n}",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Dedicated legacy document-pack calculator. It is intentionally separate from\\n \* campaign/outbox history so a future native Requested Document adapter can be\\n \* compared before any switch. This non-UI system processor runs without sharing\\n \* solely to calculate records requested by managed-object triggers; it exposes\\n \* no Aura/REST entry point and never returns candidate data to a caller.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class DocumentReminderProgressService {\\n public class ProgressException extends Exception {}\\n @TestVisible private static Boolean processorUpdating = false;\\n private static final Integer QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND = 10000;\\n\\n public static Boolean isProcessorUpdating() { return processorUpdating; }\\n\\n public static Set<Id> recalculate(Set<Id> assignmentIds) {\\n Set<Id> current = new Set<Id>();\\n if (assignmentIds == null || assignmentIds.isEmpty()) { return current; }\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> assignments = \[\\n SELECT Id, b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c, b3o\_\_Active\_\_c,\\n Applicable\_Document\_Count\_\_c, Completed\_Document\_Count\_\_c,\\n Outstanding\_Document\_Count\_\_c, Calculation\_Status\_\_c,\\n Calculation\_Error\_\_c, Last\_Calculated\_At\_\_c,\\n First\_Available\_At\_\_c, Verified\_Available\_At\_\_c\\n FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c WHERE Id IN :assignmentIds\\n \];\\n if (assignments.isEmpty()) { return current; }\\n try {\\n Set<Id> packIds = new Set<Id>();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : assignments) {\\n packIds.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c);\\n contactIds.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n }\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_\_c> documents = \[\\n SELECT Id, Name, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c, b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Show\_on\_Successful\_Rule\_Evaluation\_\_c, b3o\_\_Form\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Template\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_\_c, b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Session\_\_c, b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\\n FROM b3o\_\_Document\_\_c WHERE b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c IN :packIds\\n ORDER BY Id LIMIT :QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND + 1\\n \];\\n if (documents.size() > QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND) {\\n return markAllError(assignments, 'Configured document volume exceeds the safe refresh bound.');\\n }\\n Map<Id, List<b3o\_\_Document\_\_c>> documentsByPack = new Map<Id, List<b3o\_\_Document\_\_c>>();\\n Set<Id> documentIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_\_c document : documents) {\\n documentIds.add(document.Id);\\n if (!documentsByPack.containsKey(document.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c)) {\\n documentsByPack.put(document.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c, new List<b3o\_\_Document\_\_c>());\\n }\\n documentsByPack.get(document.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c).add(document);\\n }\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications = \[\\n SELECT Id, TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c, E\_W\_Location\_\_c, CreatedDate\\n FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c WHERE TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c IN :contactIds\\n ORDER BY TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c, CreatedDate, Id LIMIT :QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND + 1\\n \];\\n if (applications.size() > QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND) {\\n return markAllError(assignments, 'Application conditional-rule volume exceeds the safe refresh bound.');\\n }\\n Map<Id, List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>> applicationsByContact = new Map<Id, List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>>();\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c application : applications) {\\n if (!applicationsByContact.containsKey(application.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c)) {\\n applicationsByContact.put(application.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c, new List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c>());\\n }\\n applicationsByContact.get(application.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c).add(application);\\n }\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c> submissions = \[\\n SELECT Id, CreatedDate, b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c, b3o\_\_Status\_\_c, b3o\_\_Valid\_Until\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c, b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c,\\n b3o\_\_Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c, b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c\\n FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\\n WHERE b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c IN :assignmentIds\\n AND b3o\_\_Document\_\_c IN :documentIds\\n ORDER BY b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c, b3o\_\_Document\_\_c, CreatedDate DESC, Id DESC\\n LIMIT :QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND + 1\\n \];\\n if (submissions.size() > QUERY\_ROW\_BOUND) {\\n return markAllError(assignments, 'Submission volume exceeds the safe refresh bound.');\\n }\\n Map<Id, Id> contactByAssignment = new Map<Id, Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : assignments) { contactByAssignment.put(assignment.Id, assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c); }\\n Map<String, b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c> latestByAssignmentDocument = new Map<String, b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c submission : submissions) {\\n if (submission.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != contactByAssignment.get(submission.b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c)) { continue; }\\n String submissionKey = key(submission.b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c, submission.b3o\_\_Document\_\_c);\\n if (!latestByAssignmentDocument.containsKey(submissionKey)) {\\n latestByAssignmentDocument.put(submissionKey, submission);\\n }\\n }\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> changes = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n Datetime calculatedAt = System.now();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : assignments) {\\n try {\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_\_c> inPack = documentsByPack.get(assignment.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c);\\n if (inPack == null || inPack.isEmpty()) {\\n throw new ProgressException('Configured document pack is structurally empty.');\\n }\\n Integer applicable = 0;\\n Integer completed = 0;\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_\_c document : inPack) {\\n DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.Evaluation rule = DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.evaluate(\\n document.b3o\_\_Conditional\_Rendering\_Rule\_\_c, assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c,\\n applicationsByContact.get(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c));\\n if (String.isNotBlank(rule.error)) { throw new rule.matched : !rule.matched);\\n if (!visible) { continue; }\\n applicable++;\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c latest = latestByAssignmentDocument.get(key(assignment.Id, document.Id));\\n if private static Boolean jobQueued = false;\\n @TestVisible private static Boolean workerRunning = false;\\n private static final Integer MAX\_REQUESTS\_PER\_RUN = 5;\\n\\n public static void requestAssignments(Set<Id> ids) { request('Assignment', ids); }\\n public static void requestContacts(Set<Id> ids) { request('Contact', ids); }\\n public static void requestPacks(Set<Id> ids) { request('Pack', ids); }\\n public static void requestJobs(Set<Id> ids) { request('Job', ids); }\\n\\n private static void request(String scopeType, Set<Id> ids) {\\n if (ids == null || ids.isEmpty()
