idValue : ids) {\\n if (idValue == null) continue;\\n rows.add(new Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c(\\n Scope\_Key\_\_c = scopeType + '|' + idValue,\\n Scope\_Type\_\_c = scopeType,\\n Scope\_Record\_Id\_\_c = String.valueOf(idValue),\\n State\_\_c = 'Pending', Cursor\_\_c = null, Error\_\_c = null\\n ));\\n }\\n if (!rows.isEmpty()) Database.upsert(rows, Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c.Fields.Scope\_Key\_\_c, false);\\n if (!workerRunning) queueWorker();\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, 'Document reminder refresh request failed: ' + e.getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public static Set<Id> applicationContacts(List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> rows,\\n Map<Id, TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> oldMap) {\\n Set<Id> contacts = new Set<Id>();\\n if (rows == null) return contacts;\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c row : rows) {\\n if (row.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c != null) contacts.add(row.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c);\\n if (oldMap != null && oldMap.containsKey(row.Id) && oldMap.get(row.Id).TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c != null) {\\n contacts.add(oldMap.get(row.Id).TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n return contacts;\\n }\\n\\n public static Set<Id> locationChangedJobs(List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> rows, Map<Id, TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> oldMap) {\\n Set<Id> jobs = new Set<Id>();\\n if (rows == null) return jobs;\\n for (TR1\_\_Job\_\_c row : rows) {\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c prior = oldMap == null ? null : oldMap.get(row.Id);\\n if (prior == null || row.BH\_Location\_\_c != prior.BH\_Location\_\_c) jobs.add(row.Id);\\n }\\n return jobs;\\n }\\n\\n private static void queueWorker() {\\n if (jobQueued || Test.isRunningTest() && workerRunning) e.getMessage()); }\\n }\\n\\n public class RefreshJob implements Queueable {\\n public void execute(QueueableContext context) {\\n workerRunning = true;\\n try {\\n DocumentReminderSettings.Values settings = DocumentReminderSettings.get();\\n if (!settings.processorEnabled) return;\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c> requests = \[\\n SELECT Id, Scope\_Type\_\_c, Scope\_Record\_Id\_\_c, State\_\_c, Cursor\_\_c, Attempt\_Count\_\_c\\n FROM Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c WHERE State\_\_c = 'Pending'\\n ORDER BY LastModifiedDate LIMIT :MAX\_REQUESTS\_PER\_RUN FOR UPDATE\\n \];\\n if (requests.isEmpty()) return;\\n for (Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c request : requests) {\\n request.State\_\_c = 'Processing';\\n request.Attempt\_Count\_\_c = (request.Attempt\_Count\_\_c == null ? 0 : request.Attempt\_Count\_\_c) + 1;\\n }\\n update requests;\\n Set<Id> assignmentIds = new Set<Id>();\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c> generated = new List<Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c>();\\n for (Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c request : requests) {\\n try { "content": "trigger DocumentReminderAssignmentTrigger on b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c (before update, after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete) {\\n if (Trigger.isBefore) {\\n DocumentReminderProgressService.protectDerivedFields(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap, false);\\n return;\\n }\\n if (DocumentReminderProgressService.isProcessorUpdating()) return;\\n if (Trigger.isDelete) {\\n Set<Id> contacts = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : Trigger.old) contacts.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestContacts(contacts);\\n } else {\\n Set<Id> assignmentIds = new Map<Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>(Trigger.new).keySet();\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestAssignments(assignmentIds);\\n if (Trigger.isUpdate) {\\n Set<Id> contacts = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : Trigger.new) {\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c prior = Trigger.oldMap.get(assignment.Id);\\n if (assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c) {\\n contacts.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c); contacts.add(prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestContacts(contacts);\\n }\\n }\\n}",

"path": "triggers/JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger.trigger",

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update) {\\n // Deliberately before legacy guards: E\_W\_Location\_\_c is a formula dependency\\n // and must request post-commit recalculation even while the legacy sync field\\n // is absent/inert. The existing sync behaviour below is otherwise unchanged.\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestJobs(\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.locationChangedJobs(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap)\\n );\\n\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}",

"metadataType": "ApexTrigger",

"fullName": "JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger"

},

"seq": 29624,

"sessionId": "ses\_mu2wbhm7vam4v5pzeLzJ",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Core SendGrid email pipeline.\\n \* publish()/doSend() preserve the existing platform-event/Task behaviour.\\n \* sendReminderDirect() is a bounded direct transport for the durable reminder\\n \* outbox: it honours its preallocated reference and returns an outcome without\\n \* creating a Task or retaining rendered candidate content.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class SendGridEmailService {\\n public class SendGridException extends Exception {}\\n public class EmailRequest {\\n public String templateName;\\n public Id recipientId;\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n public String toAddress;\\n public String subject;\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n public String htmlBody;\\n public String fromAddress;\\n public String fromName;\\n public String reference;\\n }\\n public class ReminderDeliveryResult {\\n public String reference;\\n public String outcome; // ACCEPTED, RETRYABLE\_REJECTION, REJECTED, UNCERTAIN\\n public Integer statusCode;\\n public String error;\\n }\\n\\n @TestVisible private static Integer CHUNK\_SIZE = 50;\\n\\n /\*\* Existing caller contract: publish one platform event per email. \*/\\n public static void publish(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events = new List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) events.add(new SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e(Payload\_\_c = JSON.serialize(em)));\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Events to process:' + events.size());\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : EventBus.publish(events)) {\\n if (!sr.isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n throw new SendGridException('Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n } else System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Published Event Successfully');\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public static void enqueueFromEvents(List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Queue from platform events');\\n List<EmailRequest> chunk = new List<EmailRequest>();\\n for (SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e ev : events) {\\n chunk.add((EmailRequest) JSON.deserialize(ev.Payload\_\_c, EmailRequest.class));\\n if (chunk.size() == CHUNK\_SIZE) { System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk)); chunk = new List<EmailRequest>(); }\\n }\\n if (!chunk.isEmpty()) System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk));\\n }\\n\\n public class SendJob implements Queueable, Database.AllowsCallouts {\\n private List<EmailRequest> emails;\\n public SendJob(List<EmailRequest> emails) { this.emails = emails; }\\n public void execute(QueueableContext ctx) { doSend(emails); }\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Existing direct sender, deliberately unchanged in outcomes and Task audit. \*/\\n public static void doSend(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = settings();\\n Set<String> templateNames = new Set<String>();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) templateNames.add(em.templateName);\\n if (em.recipientId != null) contactIds.add(em.recipientId);\\n }\\n Map<String, Id> templateIdByName = new Map<String, Id>();\\n for (EmailTemplate t : \[SELECT Id, DeveloperName FROM EmailTemplate WHERE DeveloperName IN :templateNames\]) templateIdByName.put(t.DeveloperName, t.Id);\\n Map<Id, Contact> contacts = new Map<Id, Contact>(\[SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Id IN :contactIds\]);\\n List<Task> logs = new List<Task>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n em.reference = EncodingUtil.convertToHex(Crypto.generateAesKey(128)); // preserve existing random-reference behaviour\\n Contact who = contacts.get(em.recipientId);\\n String toAddr = String.isNotBlank(em.toAddress) ? em.toAddress : who?.Email;\\n String subject = em.subject, plainBody = em.plainTextBody, htmlBody = em.htmlBody;\\n Task log = new Task(Status = 'Completed', TaskSubtype = 'Email', ActivityDate = Date.today(), WhoId = em.recipientId,\\n WhatId = em.relatedRecordId, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c = em.reference, SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = System.now());\\n try {\\n if (String.isBlank(toAddr)) throw new SendGridException('No recipient email address.');\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) {\\n Id templateId = templateIdByName.get(em.templateName);\\n if (templateId == null) throw new SendGridException('Email template not found: ' + em.templateName);\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage rendered = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(templateId, em.recipientId, em.relatedRecordId);\\n subject = rendered.getSubject(); plainBody = rendered.getPlainTextBody(); htmlBody = rendered.getHtmlBody();\\n }\\n HttpResponse res = new Http().send(buildRequest(cfg, em, toAddr, who?.Name, subject, plainBody, htmlBody));\\n if (res.getStatusCode() >= 300) throw new SendGridException('SendGrid returned ' + res.getStatusCode() + ': ' + (res.getBody() == null ? '' : res.getBody().abbreviate(200)));\\n log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Sent';\\n } catch (Exception e) { log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Failed'; log.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = e.getMessage().abbreviate(255); }\\n log.Subject = 'Email: ' + (String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject.abbreviate(240));\\n log.Description = String.isNotBlank(plainBody) ? plainBody.abbreviate(31000) : (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody) ? htmlBody.stripHtmlTags().abbreviate(31000) : null);\\n logs.add(log);\\n }\\n List<Task> retries = new List<Task>();\\n Database.SaveResult\[\] results = Database.insert(logs, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) if (!results\[i\].isSuccess()) { Task retry = logs\[i\].clone(false, true); retry.WhatId = null; retries.add(retry); }\\n if (!retries.isEmpty()) Database.insert(retries, false);\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Reminder-only transport. Never publish a platform event or create Tasks.\\n \* A response of 202 is accepted, not delivered. Only an explicit 429 gets\\n \* a retryable outcome; timeout/network/5xx responses are uncertain.\\n \*/\\n public static List<ReminderDeliveryResult> sendReminderDirect(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = settings();\\n Set<Id> ids = new Set<Id>();\\n for (EmailRequest request : emails) if (request.recipientId != null) ids.add(request.recipientId);\\n Map<Id, Contact> contacts = new Map<Id, Contact>(\[SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Id IN :ids\]);\\n List<ReminderDeliveryResult> results = new List<ReminderDeliveryResult>();\\n for (EmailRequest request : emails) {\\n ReminderDeliveryResult result = new ReminderDeliveryResult(); result.reference = request.reference;\\n try {\\n if (String.isBlank(request.reference)) throw new SendGridException('Reminder transport requires a stable reference.');\\n Contact contact = contacts.get(request.recipientId);\\n String address = String.isNotBlank(request.toAddress) ? request.toAddress : contact?.Email;\\n if (String.isBlank(address)) throw new SendGridException('No recipient email address.');\\n if (String.isBlank(request.subject) || (String.isBlank(request.plainTextBody) && String.isBlank(request.htmlBody))) {\\n throw new SendGridException('Reminder transport requires a rendered subject and body.');\\n }\\n HttpResponse response = new Http().send(buildRequest(cfg, request, address, contact?.Name,\\n request.subject, request.plainTextBody, request.htmlBody));\\n result.statusCode = response.getStatusCode();\\n if (result.statusCode == 202) result.outcome = 'ACCEPTED';\\n else if (result.statusCode == 429) { result.outcome = 'RETRYABLE\_REJECTION'; result.error = 'SendGrid returned 429.'; }\\n else if (result.statusCode >= 400 && result.statusCode < 500) { result.outcome = 'REJECTED'; result.error = ('SendGrid returned ' + result.statusCode + '.').abbreviate(255); }\\n else { result.outcome = 'UNCERTAIN'; result.error = ('SendGrid returned ' + result.statusCode + '.').abbreviate(255); }\\n } catch (Exception e) { result.outcome = 'UNCERTAIN'; result.error = e.getMessage().abbreviate(255); }\\n results.add(result);\\n }\\n return results;\\n }\\n\\n private static HttpRequest buildRequest(SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg, EmailRequest em, String toAddr, String toName, String subject, String plainBody, String htmlBody) {\\n List<Object> content = new List<Object>();\\n if (String.isNotBlank(plainBody)) content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => plainBody });\\n if (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody)) content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/html', 'value' => htmlBody });\\n if (content.isEmpty()) content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => ' ' });\\n Map<String, Object> body = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'personalizations' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{ 'to' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{'email' => toAddr, 'name' => String.isBlank(toName) ? toAddr : toName}}, 'custom\_args' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'sf\_ref' => em.reference } }},\\n 'from' => new Map<String, Object>{'email' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromAddress) ? em.fromAddress : cfg.Default\_From\_Address\_\_c, 'name' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromName) ? em.fromName : cfg.Default\_From\_Name\_\_c},\\n 'subject' => String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject, 'content' => content };\\n if (cfg.Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c) body.put('mail\_settings', new Map<String, Object>{'sandbox\_mode' => new Map<String, Object>{'enable' => true}});\\n HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('callout:SendGrid/v3/mail/send'); req.setMethod('POST'); req.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); req.setHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer {!$Credential.Password}'); req.setTimeout(20000); req.setBody(JSON.serialize(body)); return req;\\n }\\n public static SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt settings() {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (cfg == null) throw new SendGridException('SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n return cfg;\\n }\\n}",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Optional retention cleanup. Never self-schedules; an administrator must\\n \* separately approve and schedule it after confirming audit retention policy.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class DocumentReminderRetentionBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject> {\\n public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext context) {\\n Integer days = DocumentReminderSettings.get().retentionDays;\\n return Database.getQueryLocator(\[SELECT Id FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c WHERE CreatedDate < :Date.today().addDays(-days)\]);\\n }\\n public void execute(Database.BatchableContext context, List<SObject> scope) {\\n Set<Id> sendIds = new Map<Id, SObject>(scope).keySet();\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c> links = \[SELECT Id FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c WHERE Send\_\_c IN :sendIds\];\\n if (!links.isEmpty()) Database.delete(links, false);\\n Database.delete(scope, false);\\n }\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext context) { }\\n}",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* SendGrid Event Webhook receiver. Existing Task correlation remains intact;\\n \* reminder outbox rows are additionally updated by their stable sf\_ref.\\n \* Authentication remains the deployed shared-secret contract.\\n \*/\\n@RestResource(urlMapping='/sendgrid/events')\\nglobal without sharing class SendGridWebhook {\\n @TestVisible private static String secretOverride;\\n @HttpPost global static void handleEvents() {\\n RestRequest req = RestContext.request; RestResponse res = RestContext.response;\\n String secret = secretOverride != null ? secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || req.params.get('token') != secret) { res.statusCode = 401; return; }\\n List<Object> events;\\n try { events = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(req.requestBody.toString()); }\\n catch (Exception e) { res.statusCode = 400; return; }\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> latestByRef = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object raw : events) {\\n Map<String, Object> eventData = (Map<String, Object>) raw; String reference = (String) eventData.get('sf\_ref');\\n if (String.isBlank(reference)) continue;\\n Map<String, Object> current = latestByRef.get(reference);\\n if (current == null || epoch(eventData) >= epoch(current)) latestByRef.put(reference, eventData);\\n }\\n if (!latestByRef.isEmpty()) {\\n List<Task> taskUpdates = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task task : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> eventData = latestByRef.get(task.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n task.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = ((String) eventData.get('event'))?.abbreviate(40);\\n task.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = ((String) eventData.get('reason'))?.abbreviate(255);\\n task.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(eventData) \* 1000); taskUpdates.add(task);\\n }\\n if (!taskUpdates.isEmpty()) Database.update(taskUpdates, false);\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c> sendUpdates = new List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c>();\\n for (Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c send : \[SELECT Id, Reference\_\_c, Status\_\_c FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c WHERE Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> eventData = latestByRef.get(send.Reference\_\_c); String eventName = String.valueOf(eventData.get('event')).toLowerCase();\\n if (eventName == 'delivered') sendUpdates.add(new Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c(Id = send.Id, Status\_\_c = 'Delivered', Delivered\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(eventData) \* 1000), Error\_\_c = null));\\n else if (eventName == 'bounce' || eventName == 'dropped' || eventName == 'spamreport' || eventName == 'unsubscribe') sendUpdates.add(new Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c(Id = send.Id, Status\_\_c = 'Failed', Error\_\_c = ('SendGrid ' + eventName + ': ' + String.valueOf(eventData.get('reason'))).abbreviate(1000)));\\n }\\n if (!sendUpdates.isEmpty()) Database.update(sendUpdates, false);\\n }\\n res.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> eventData) { Object timestamp = eventData.get('timestamp'); return timestamp == null ? 0 : Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(timestamp)); }\\n}",

▾"input": {

"title": "Backend first pass gaps and build ownership",

"content": "Approved plan build first pass incomplete. No deployment or clean validation. Backend builder hit tool limit after4failed checkOnly attempts; last10component failures0tests (tests not run). Missing DispatchService.cls-meta; RuleEvaluator evaluate uses undefined json variable. Rule evaluator fundamentally wrong guessed JSON keys (does NOT parse supplied conditionItems/targetObjectField/targetValueComparitor) and only E&W ANY; must implement exact provided3B format Boolean ANDORcustom/match modes for registered deps, unsupported other deps explicit error as approved. Dispatch currently counts only pack names not document names; duplicate changes list sends same Id twice; retry count reset1, retry resumption gaps, stale day/window not rechecked, template priority not reselected if eligibility changes. Progress currently sets First\_AvailableAt on first calculation of ANY historical assignment -> violates recent-only proven dates; fix timestamp at actual new insert/visibility transition after enabled/cutoff, historical first calc never new window. Refresh requests writes/enqueues even processor disabled -> fix no-op until enabled; partial SaveResults ignored and processing failure can strand requests. ▾{

"path": "triggers/ApplicationJobRollupTrigger.trigger",

"metadataType": "ApexTrigger",

"fullName": "ApplicationJobRollupTrigger",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Maintains Job.Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Job.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* Deliberately thin. All decision logic lives in JobFillRollupHandler\\n \* so it can be unit tested directly — Applications cannot be updated\\n \* via DML in this org (field-level security blocks it, and\\n \* TR1\_\_Job\_\_c is not writeable after insert), so the update path is\\n \* unreachable from a test that relies on real DML.\\n \*/\\ntrigger ApplicationJobRollupTrigger on TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c (\\n after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\\n) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(\\n Trigger.isDelete ? Trigger.old : Trigger.new,\\n Trigger.isUpdate ? Trigger.oldMap : null\\n );\\n\\n JobFillRollupHandler.recalculate(jobIds);\\n}"

},

▾{

"path": "triggers/JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger.trigger",

"size": 844,

"metadataType": "ApexTrigger",

"fullName": "JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger",

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update) {\\n\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) {\\n jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}"

},

It intentionally does not claim\\n \* parity with unregistered RuleEngine target types.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator {\\n public class RuleException extends Exception {}\\n public class Evaluation {\\n public Boolean matched;\\n public String error;\\n }\\n private class Dependency {\\n String targetObject;\\n String targetField;\\n String result.matched = false;\\n result.error = Label.Document\_Reminder\_Error\_Conditional\_Rule\\n + e.getMessage().abbreviate(850);\\n }\\n return result;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* True only when an Application change can alter a registered rule. \*/\\n public static Boolean applicationChangeRequiresRefresh(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c current,\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c prior) {\\n for (Dependency dependency : dependencies().values()) {\\n if (dependency.targetObject != 'TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c') {\\n continue;\\n }\\n if (prior == null) return true; // insert, delete, or undelete changes child membership.\\n if (current.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c != prior.TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c\\n || current.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != prior.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c) return true;\\n try {\\n if // never to silently stale counts.\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* True only for registered Job source fields. \*/\\n public static Boolean jobChangeRequiresRefresh(TR1\_\_Job\_\_c current, TR1\_\_Job\_\_c prior) {\\n if (prior == null) return hasJobSourceDependency();\\n for (Dependency dependency : dependencies().values()) {\\n if (dependency.sourceObject != 'TR1\_\_Job\_\_c' || String.isBlank(dependency.sourceField)) continue;\\n try {\\n if (current.get(dependency.sourceField) != prior.get(dependency.sourceField)) return true;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n public static Boolean hasJobSourceDependency() {\\n for (Dependency dependency : dependencies().values()) {\\n if (dependency.sourceObject == 'TR1\_\_Job\_\_c') return true;\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean evaluateRoot(Map<String, Object> root,\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications, Map<String, Dependency> dependencyMap) {\\n List<Object> groups = requiredList(root, 'groups');\\n List<Boolean> values = new List<Boolean>();\\n for (Object rawGroup : groups) {\\n values.add(evaluateGroup(requiredMap(rawGroup, 'Group'), applications, dependencyMap));\\n }\\n return combine(values, requiredString(root, 'crossGroupOperator'),\\n optionalString(root, 'customCrossGroupOperator'));\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean evaluateGroup(Map<String, Object> group,\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications, Map<String, Dependency> dependencyMap) {\\n List<Object> conditions = requiredList(group, 'conditions');\\n List<Boolean> values = new List<Boolean>();\\n for (Object rawCondition : conditions) {\\n values.add(evaluateCondition(requiredMap(rawCondition, 'Condition'), applications, dependencyMap));\\n }\\n return combine(values, requiredString(group, 'crossConditionOperator'),\\n optionalString(group, 'customCrossConditionOperator'));\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean evaluateCondition(Map<String, Object> condition,\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> applications, Map<String, Dependency> dependencyMap) {\\n String targetObject = requiredString(condition, 'targetObject').trim();\\n List<Object> rawItems = requiredList(condition, 'conditionItems');\\n List<Item> items = new List<Item>();\\n Integer limit = 500;\\n for (Object rawItem : rawItems) {\\n Map<String, Object> itemMap = requiredMap(rawItem, 'Condition item');\\n Item item = new Item();\\n item.field = fieldName(requiredString(itemMap, 'targetObjectField'));\\n item.expected = requiredValue(itemMap, 'targetObjectFieldValue');\\n item.comparator = requiredString(itemMap, 'targetValueComparitor');\\n item.dependency = dependencyMap.get(dependencyKey(targetObject, item.field));\\n if (item.dependency == null) {\\n throw new RuleException('Unsupported rule dependency ' + targetObject + '.' + item.field\\n + '. "path": "triggers/DocumentReminderAssignmentTrigger.trigger",

"content": "trigger DocumentReminderAssignmentTrigger on b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c (\\n before insert, before update, after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\\n) {\\n if (Trigger.isBefore) {\\n DocumentReminderProgressService.protectDerivedFields(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap, Trigger.isInsert);\\n DocumentReminderProgressService.captureAvailability(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap, Trigger.isInsert);\\n return;\\n }\\n if (DocumentReminderProgressService.isProcessorUpdating()) return;\\n if (Trigger.isDelete) {\\n Set<Id> contacts = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : Trigger.old) if (assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != null) contacts.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestContacts(contacts);\\n return;\\n }\\n Set<Id> assignments = new Set<Id>();\\n Set<Id> contacts = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignment : Trigger.new) {\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c prior = Trigger.isUpdate ? Trigger.oldMap.get(assignment.Id) : null;\\n Boolean relevant = !Trigger.isUpdate || assignment.b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c\\n || assignment.b3o\_\_Status\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Status\_\_c || assignment.b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Due\_Date\_\_c\\n || assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c || assignment.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c\\n || assignment.Application\_\_c != prior.Application\_\_c || assignment.Verified\_Available\_At\_\_c != prior.Verified\_Available\_At\_\_c;\\n if (relevant) assignments.add(assignment.Id);\\n if (prior != null && assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c) {\\n if (assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != null) contacts.add(assignment.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n if (prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c != null) contacts.add(prior.b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestAssignments(assignments);\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestContacts(contacts);\\n}"

"path": "triggers/JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger.trigger",

"content": "trigger JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c (after update, after delete, after undelete) {\\n // Master-detail cascade deletion does not invoke child Application triggers.\\n // Capture affected candidates from ALL ROWS before leaving the Job delete context.\\n if (Trigger.isDelete) {\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestContacts(\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.contactsForDeletedJobs(new Map<Id, TR1\_\_Job\_\_c>(Trigger.old).keySet())\\n );\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Undelete can restore the condition source and child membership; after-update\\n // is narrowed to configured source fields only.\\n if (Trigger.isUndelete) {\\n if (DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.hasJobSourceDependency()) {\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestJobs(new Map<Id, TR1\_\_Job\_\_c>(Trigger.new).keySet());\\n }\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.requestJobs(\\n DocumentReminderRefreshService.locationChangedJobs(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap)\\n );\\n\\n // Existing sync behaviour remains intentionally unchanged below this point.\\n if (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.suppressTrigger) { return; }\\n if (System.isBatch() || System.isFuture() || System.isQueueable()) { return; }\\n if (!DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.syncFieldExists()) { return; }\\n\\n String syncField = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.SYNC\_FIELD;\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (SObject job : Trigger.new) {\\n SObject priorVersion = Trigger.oldMap.get((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n Boolean nowOn = job.get(syncField) == true;\\n Boolean wasOn = priorVersion != null && priorVersion.get(syncField) == true;\\n if (nowOn && !wasOn) jobIds.add((Id) job.get('Id'));\\n }\\n if (jobIds.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n Database.executeBatch(new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobIds), 200);\\n}"

},

#39656tool.call15 Sept 2026, 21:02

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "apex\_builder\_mu2yqwd16-DIe4Jhul-\_",

"label": "Write note: Backend progress/rule/refresh completion 2026-09-15",

▾"input": {

"title": "Backend progress/rule/refresh completion 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"document-packs",

"reminders",

"backend",

"progress",

"rules",

"refresh"

\],

"content": "## Owned implementation staged (no org deployment, no data writes, no whole-workspace validation)\\n\\n### Rule evaluation\\n- Replaced guessed-key evaluator with the exact supplied 3B JSON hierarchy: \`crossGroupOperator\`/\`customCrossGroupOperator\` → \`groups\` → \`crossConditionOperator\`/\`customCrossConditionOperator\` → \`conditions\` → \`targetObject\`, \`matchMode\`, \`matchCount\`, \`crossConditionItemOperator\`/\`customCrossConditionItemOperator\` → \`conditionItems.targetObjectField\`, \`.targetObjectFieldValue\`, \`.targetValueComparitor\`.\\n- Supports \`AND\`, \`OR\`, \`CUSTOM\`/\`ANDORcustom\` positional expressions (1-based operands, AND/OR/parentheses); deliberately rejects logical NOT. Child modes supported: default any, all, none, first, last, at-least. Boolean null coerces false. The inspector queries \`TR1\_\_Application1\_\_r\` oldest first and limits 500 children per Contact.\\n- The only implemented target is the registered production dependency \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\*TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c.E\_W\_Location\_\_c\`, with source \`TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.BH\_Location\_\_c\`; missing, malformed, unregistered or differently registered target shapes evaluate as structured errors. This is deliberately not claimed as generic RuleEngine parity. Product docs were searched first and had no matching conditional-rule JSON documentation; repository scan tooling was not exposed in this session.\\n\\n### Progress and availability\\n- \`DocumentReminderProgressService.inspect(Set<Id>)\` is public and no-DML. Its \`ProgressSnapshot\` exposes required assignment/contact/pack ids, pack name, status/error, outstanding document names and counts, active flag and effective availability timestamp. \`recalculate\` persists exactly these snapshots rather than using a second algorithm.\\n- Completion is assignment+document+contact scoped: only the latest matching submission is considered; Pending Review/Approved is complete only when Valid Until is blank or on/after explicit Europe/London date. Latest Rejected/Request Update/expired evidence remains outstanding. Each visible Document counts once; all conditionally hidden docs are a valid zero. Empty packs, malformed/unsupported rules and mismatched assignment/contact or assignment/pack submission joins are Error and suppress reminders. No source-route/evidence-pointer requirement was added beyond the native submission joins.\\n- Availability is captured in the Assignment before trigger only for a newly inserted assignment that is available with processing enabled, or an unanchored actual unavailable/hidden → available transition. Historical first recalculation never creates it; it is never reset. \`Verified\_Available\_At\_\_c\` is allowed only for \`Run\_Document\_Reminders\` custom-permission users or Modify All Data users and cannot be future-dated. UK date source difference vs native \`TODAY()\` formula is documented in code.\\n\\n### Refresh\\n- Refresh API is a strict no-op (no queue/DML) when \`Processor\_Enabled\_\_c=false\`.\\n- Added durable request \`Generation\_\_c\`, \`Processing\_Generation\_\_c\`, \`Processing\_Started\_At\_\_c\`, and \`Next\_Attempt\_At\_\_c\`. Scope rows are locked and generation-incremented; one worker is queued per transaction only after checking remaining Queueable capacity. Worker caps actual processed Assignment ids at 200, persists cursors, deduplicates Job-generated Contact scopes, detects partial DML failures, and reports errors in durable request state rather than debug logs. Stale Processing rows and queue-capacity failures are recoverable through public \`DocumentReminderRefreshService.runWatchdog()\` (five controlled attempts).\\n- Extended \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` to after-update/delete/undelete while retaining the former guarded legacy after-update block. Delete queries \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c ALL ROWS\` to request Contacts because Job master-detail cascade does not run child triggers. Application trigger remains independently extended and now only requests refresh for registered source/target changes; Assignment/Submission/Document triggers cover lifecycle/reparent/pack changes.\\n\\n### Tests staged\\n- Reworked \`DocumentReminderProgressServiceTest\` for exact JSON, all child modes, all three custom operator levels, null Boolean, >500 cap, malformed/unknown/NOT error paths, inversion, expired/latest/rejected scoped evidence, repeated assignments, empty/hidden packs, availability history/transition, and 200 Assignment DML.\\n- Added \`DocumentReminderRefreshServiceTest\` for disabled no-op, scope generation coalescing, real recalculation, submission reparent old+new scope, document pack scope, 200-record cursor continuation/cap and durable bad-scope watchdog recovery.\\n\\n### Integration still required from delivery/scheduler owner\\n- Dispatch must consume the new \`inspect\` snapshots immediately pre-SendGrid (rather than call \`recalculate\`) to satisfy its no-DML pre-callout contract and use \`outstandingDocumentNames\` in the email digest.\\n- A deployed scheduler must call \`DocumentReminderRefreshService.runWatchdog()\` periodically; it is intentionally not wired here because schedulers are owned by the delivery builder and this user instruction prohibited scheduler edits.\\n- No check-only validation was run because the lead explicitly prohibited whole-workspace validation while parallel builders are editing. Validation and deployment remain outstanding."

"fullName": "SendGridEmailService",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Core SendGrid email pipeline.\\n \*\\n \* publish() -> one SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e platform event per email (any context, incl. guest users)\\n \* enqueueFromEvents()-> called by the platform event trigger, which runs as the Automated Process user,\\n \* so EmailTemplate access and Contact visibility never depend on the calling user\\n \* SendJob -> renders the template, POSTs to SendGrid, logs a Task on the target record\\n \*\\n \* The webhook (SendGridWebhook) later updates the Task with real delivery status.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class SendGridEmailService {\\n\\n public class SendGridException extends Exception {}\\n\\n public class EmailRequest {\\n public String templateName;\\n public Id recipientId;\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n public String toAddress;\\n public String subject;\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n public String htmlBody;\\n public String fromAddress;\\n public String fromName;\\n public String reference; // correlates the Task with SendGrid webhook events\\n }\\n\\n // ponytail: 50 emails (= 50 callouts) per async transaction; raise toward the 100-callout limit if throughput matters\\n @TestVisible private static Integer CHUNK\_SIZE = 50;\\n\\n /\*\* Queue emails for async delivery. Callable from Apex for bulk sends. \*/\\n public static void publish(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events = new List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n events.add(new SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e(Payload\_\_c = JSON.serialize(em)));\\n }\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Events to process:' + events.size());\\n\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : EventBus.publish(events)) {\\n if (!sr.isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n throw new SendGridException('Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n }else{\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Published Event Successfully');\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Platform event SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = System.now()\\n );\\n try {\\n if (String.isBlank(toAddr)) {\\n throw new SendGridException('No recipient email address.');\\n }\\n if secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || req.params.get('token') != secret) {\\n res.statusCode = 401;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n List<Object> events;\\n try {\\n events = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(req.requestBody.toString());\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n res.statusCode = 400;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Keep only the newest event per sf\_ref in this batch.\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> latestByRef = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object o : events) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = (Map<String, Object>) o;\\n String ref = (String) ev.get('sf\_ref');\\n if (String.isBlank(ref)) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> current = latestByRef.get(ref);\\n if (current == null || epoch(ev) >= epoch(current)) {\\n latestByRef.put(ref, ev);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!latestByRef.isEmpty()) {\\n List<Task> updates = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task t : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = latestByRef.get(t.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n String reason = (String) ev.get('reason');\\n t.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = ((String) ev.get('event'))?.abbreviate(40);\\n t.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = reason?.abbreviate(255);\\n t.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(ev) \* 1000);\\n updates.add(t);\\n }\\n Database.update(updates, false);\\n }\\n res.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> ev) {\\n Object ts = ev.get('timestamp');\\n return ts == null ? ▾"input": {

"title": "Delivery backend implementation contract 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"document-reminders",

"delivery",

"sendgrid",

"handoff"

\],

"content": "Delivery owner verified staged DispatchService is incomplete: it only renders pack counts, creates duplicate sparse outbox updates, writes stable SendGrid reference after leasing rather than before callout, resets attempt count, consumes cadence at claim, does not resume today retries hourly, and relies on configured Security\_Verified rather than runtime custom permission. Settings currently treats TimeZone as candidate-date zone, accepts invalid IDs silently through TimeZone.getTimeZone, has a mandatory finite allowlist, 20x20s reminder callout risk, and duration allows 365 days. \\n\\nImplementation contract adopted: (1) \`DocumentReminderProgressService.inspect(Set<Id>)\` is the sole no-DML fresh calculation source. Final pre-callout inspection re-evaluates every current in-window assignment for each candidate; in-window errors suppress that candidate, while completed/hidden/expired assignments are omitted without suppressing other due packs. (2) A Contact/Europe-London-date outbox record has opaque unique Reference\_\_c generated and durably inserted before any direct callout. \`Contact\_Day\_Key\_\_c\` remains atomic duplicate guard. (3) preparer writes current association rows and rendered request details only in queueable memory; SendJob fresh-checks its assignment/doc-name signature before callout and re-prepares rather than send stale scope. No rendered body is stored in Salesforce records or Tasks. (4) no DML precedes a callout in SendJob; post-callout changes are consolidated by send Id. (5) only explicit SendGrid 429 is retryable, with Retry-After honoured and capped total attempts; 5xx/network/timeout are Uncertain and never auto-resent. Expired leases become Uncertain. (6) all contender/retry rows are canonical Europe/London today; prior-day nonterminal rows terminalize and cannot block today. (7) direct reminders bounded 10 calls x 10 sec = <=100 sec theoretical callout timeout per SendJob; no 60k/day throughput certification. (8) runtime \`FeatureManagement.checkPermission('Run\_Document\_Reminders')\` is required alongside operational gates; UI owner must deploy the Custom Permission and runner assignment. (9) add configurable \`Allowlist\_Enabled\_\_c\` default true and \`Max\_Retry\_Attempts\_\_c\` default 3; canonical candidate date/window remain Europe/London even schedule time-zone changes.\\n\\nSendGrid webhook will retain existing token authentication (no signed-webhook implementation claimed) and needs event timestamp/monotonic state protection using a new outbox provider-event timestamp field. Existing SendGrid settings in org were retrieved: \`Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c=false\`; no test or send executed."

},

"fullName": "DocumentReminderSettings",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Centralised reminder configuration. Settings fail closed: a missing, invalid\\n \* or disabled value never permits delivery. Schedule time can be configured in\\n \* another zone, but candidate-day keys and reminder windows are always Europe/London.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class DocumentReminderSettings {\\n public class ConfigurationException extends Exception {}\\n\\n public static final String CANDIDATE\_TIME\_ZONE = 'Europe/London';\\n public class Values {\\n public Boolean processorEnabled;\\n public Boolean sendingEnabled;\\n public Boolean dryRun;\\n public Boolean suppressionVerificationReady;\\n /\*\* Administrative readiness attestation; it never replaces runtime permission checks. \*/\\n public Boolean securityVerified;\\n public Boolean allowlistEnabled;\\n public Integer startHour;\\n /\*\* Scheduler time zone only. Candidate dates and windows are always Europe/London. \*/\\n public String timeZoneId;\\n public Integer frequencyDays;\\n public Integer durationDays;\\n public String portalEntryUrl;\\n public String defaultTemplateDeveloperName;\\n public Set<String> recipientAllowlist;\\n public Integer refreshBatchSize;\\n public Integer sendBatchSize;\\n public Integer leaseMinutes;\\n public Integer retryBackoffMinutes;\\n public Integer maxRetryAttempts;\\n public Integer retentionDays;\\n }\\n\\n @TestVisible static Values overrideValues;\\n\\n public static Values get() {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && overrideValues != null) return overrideValues;\\n Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt row = Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (row == null) throw new ConfigurationException('Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n Values v = new Values();\\n v.processorEnabled = row.Processor\_Enabled\_\_c == true;\\n v.sendingEnabled = row.Sending\_Enabled\_\_c == true;\\n v.dryRun = row.Dry\_Run\_\_c == true;\\n v.suppressionVerificationReady = row.Suppression\_Verification\_Ready\_\_c == true;\\n v.securityVerified = row.Security\_Verified\_\_c == true;\\n v.allowlistEnabled = row.Allowlist\_Enabled\_\_c == true;\\n v.startHour = bounded(row.Start\_Hour\_\_c, 9, 0, 23, 'Start Hour');\\n v.timeZoneId = validateTimeZone(String.isBlank(row.Time\_Zone\_\_c) ? CANDIDATE\_TIME\_ZONE : row.Time\_Zone\_\_c.trim());\\n v.frequencyDays = bounded(row.Frequency\_Days\_\_c, 1, 1, 365, 'Frequency Days');\\n // The approved maximum is a strict ten Europe/London calendar-day window.\\n v.durationDays = bounded(row.Duration\_Days\_\_c, 10, 1, 10, 'Duration Days');\\n v.portalEntryUrl = row.Portal\_Entry\_Url\_\_c;\\n v.defaultTemplateDeveloperName = row.Default\_Template\_Developer\_Name\_\_c;\\n v.refreshBatchSize = bounded(row.Refresh\_Batch\_Size\_\_c, 100, 1, 200, 'Refresh Batch Size');\\n // 10 calls x 10 seconds in the direct transport remains inside the 120 second cumulative budget.\\n v.sendBatchSize = bounded(row.Send\_Batch\_Size\_\_c, 10, 1, 10, 'Send Batch Size');\\n v.leaseMinutes = bounded(row.Lease\_Minutes\_\_c, 15, 1, 120, 'Lease Minutes');\\n v.retryBackoffMinutes = bounded(row.Retry\_Backoff\_Minutes\_\_c, 30, 1, 1440, 'Retry Backoff Minutes');\\n v.maxRetryAttempts = bounded(row.Max\_Retry\_Attempts\_\_c, 3, 1, 10, 'Maximum Retry Attempts');\\n v.retentionDays = bounded(row.Retention\_Days\_\_c, 180, 30, 3650, 'Retention Days');\\n v.recipientAllowlist = parseAllowlist(row.Recipient\_Allowlist\_\_c);\\n return v;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Canonical candidate date. Reminder rows use the opaque sf\_ref that was\\n \* persisted before the outbound callout.\\n \*/\\n@RestResource(urlMapping='/sendgrid/events')\\nglobal without sharing class SendGridWebhook {\\n @TestVisible static String secretOverride;\\n\\n @HttpPost\\n global static void handleEvents() {\\n RestRequest requestValue = RestContext.request;\\n RestResponse responseValue = RestContext.response;\\n String secret = secretOverride != null ? secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || requestValue.params.get('token') != secret) { responseValue.statusCode = 401; return; }\\n List<Object> rawEvents;\\n try { rawEvents = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(requestValue.requestBody.toString()); }\\n catch (Exception exceptionValue) { responseValue.statusCode = 400; return; }\\n\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> newestByReference = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object rawEvent : rawEvents) {\\n if (!(rawEvent instanceof Map<String, Object>)) continue;\\n Map<String, Object> eventValue = (Map<String, Object>) rawEvent;\\n String reference = String.valueOf(eventValue.get('sf\_ref'));\\n if (String.isBlank(reference) || reference == 'null') continue;\\n Map<String, Object> existing = newestByReference.get(reference);\\n if (existing == null || epoch(eventValue) >= epoch(existing)) newestByReference.put(reference, eventValue);\\n }\\n if (newestByReference.isEmpty()) { responseValue.statusCode = 200; return; }\\n updateExistingTasks(newestByReference);\\n updateReminderSends(newestByReference);\\n responseValue.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n\\n private static void updateExistingTasks(Map<String, Map<String, Object>> newestByReference) {\\n List<Task> changes = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task taskValue : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c, SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :newestByReference.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> eventValue = newestByReference.get(taskValue.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n Datetime eventAt = at(epoch(eventValue));\\n // Existing Task correlation remains, but late events cannot overwrite a newer state.\\n if (taskValue.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c != null && eventAt < taskValue.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c) continue;\\n Task changeValue = new Task(Id = taskValue.Id);\\n changeValue.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = String.valueOf(eventValue.get('event')).abbreviate(40);\\n changeValue.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = String.valueOf(eventValue.get('reason')).abbreviate(255);\\n changeValue.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = eventAt;\\n changes.add(changeValue);\\n }\\n if (!changes.isEmpty()) Database.update(changes, false);\\n }\\n\\n private static void updateReminderSends(Map<String, Map<String, Object>> newestByReference) {\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c> changes = new List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c>();\\n for (Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c sendValue : \[\\n SELECT Id, Reference\_\_c, Status\_\_c, Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c\\n FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c WHERE Reference\_\_c IN :newestByReference.keySet()\\n \]) {\\n Map<String, Object> eventValue = newestByReference.get(sendValue.Reference\_\_c);\\n Datetime eventAt = at(epoch(eventValue));\\n if (sendValue.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c != null && eventAt < sendValue.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c) continue;\\n String eventName = String.valueOf(eventValue.get('event')).toLowerCase();\\n Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c changeValue;\\n if (isFailure(eventName)) {\\n // A terminal suppression/bounce may supersede acceptance or delivery, but no later open can reverse it.\\n if (sendValue.Status\_\_c == 'Failed' && sendValue.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c != null && eventAt == sendValue.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c) continue;\\n changeValue = new Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c(Id = sendValue.Id, Status\_\_c = 'Failed',\\n Error\_\_c = ('SendGrid ' + eventName + ': ' + String.valueOf(eventValue.get('reason'))).abbreviate(1000));\\n } else if (eventName == 'delivered') {\\n if (!canBecomeDelivered(sendValue.Status\_\_c)) continue;\\n changeValue = new Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c(Id = sendValue.Id, Status\_\_c = 'Delivered', Delivered\_At\_\_c = eventAt, Error\_\_c = null);\\n } else continue; // open, click and processed provide no stronger reminder outcome.\\n changeValue.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c = eventAt;\\n changes.add(changeValue);\\n }\\n if (!changes.isEmpty()) Database.update(changes, false);\\n }\\n private static Boolean canBecomeDelivered(String statusValue) {\\n return statusValue == 'Sending' || statusValue == 'Accepted' || statusValue == 'Uncertain' || statusValue == 'Delivered';\\n }\\n private static Boolean isFailure(String eventName) {\\n return eventName == 'bounce' || eventName == 'dropped' || eventName == 'spamreport' || eventName == 'unsubscribe';\\n }\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> eventValue) {\\n try {\\n Object rawValue = eventValue.get('timestamp');\\n return rawValue == null ? 0 : Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(rawValue));\\n } catch (Exception exceptionValue) { return 0; }\\n }\\n private static Datetime at(Long seconds) { return Datetime.newInstance(seconds \* 1000); }\\n}"

"path": "classes/DocumentReminderRetentionBatch.cls",

"metadataType": "ApexClass",

"fullName": "DocumentReminderRetentionBatch",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Optional retention cleanup. It never deletes active, accepted-without-delivery,\\n \* retry, leased, prepared, sending or uncertain outbox rows; those remain audit\\n \* evidence until an administrator explicitly resolves their delivery ambiguity.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class DocumentReminderRetentionBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject> {\\n public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext context) {\\n Integer days = DocumentReminderSettings.get().retentionDays;\\n return Database.getQueryLocator(\[\\n SELECT Id FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c\\n WHERE CreatedDate < :Date.today().addDays(-days)\\n AND Status\_\_c IN ('Delivered', 'Rejected', 'Failed', 'Suppressed')\\n \]);\\n }\\n public void execute(Database.BatchableContext context, List<SObject> scope) {\\n Set<Id> candidateSendIds = new Map<Id, SObject>(scope).keySet();\\n Map<Id, Boolean> canDeleteSend = new Map<Id, Boolean>();\\n for (Id sendId : candidateSendIds) canDeleteSend.put(sendId, true);\\n List<Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c> links = \[SELECT Id, Send\_\_c FROM Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c WHERE Send\_\_c IN :candidateSendIds\];\\n if (!links.isEmpty()) {\\n Database.DeleteResult\[\] linkResults = Database.delete(links, false);\\n for (Integer indexValue = 0; indexValue < linkResults.size(); indexValue++) if (!linkResults\[indexValue\].isSuccess()) canDeleteSend.put(links\[indexValue\].Send\_\_c, false);\\n }\\n List<SObject> safeParents = new List<SObject>();\\n for (SObject sendValue : scope) if (canDeleteSend.get((Id) sendValue.get('Id'))) safeParents.add(sendValue);\\n if (!safeParents.isEmpty()) Database.delete(safeParents, false);\\n }\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext context) { }\\n}"

},

value.retryBackoffMinutes = 30; value.maxRetryAttempts = 3; value.retentionDays = 30; return value;\\n }\\n private static Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c send(Id contactId, String statusValue, String suffix) {\\n Date ukDate = DocumentReminderSettings.ukDate(System.now());\\n Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c value = new Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c(Contact\_\_c = contactId, UK\_Date\_\_c = ukDate,\\n Contact\_Day\_Key\_\_c = String.valueOf(contactId) + '-' + suffix, Reference\_\_c = 'retention-' + suffix, Status\_\_c = statusValue, Attempt\_Count\_\_c = 1);\\n insert value; Test.setCreatedDate(value.Id, System.now().addDays(-31)); return value;\\n }\\n @IsTest static void retentionDeletesOnlyOldTerminalRowsAndTheirAssociations() {\\n DocumentReminderSettings.overrideValues = settings();\\n Contact person = new Contact(LastName = 'Retention Candidate'); insert person;\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c documentPack = new b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c(Name = 'Retention Pack'); insert documentPack;\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c assignmentValue = new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = person.Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = documentPack.Id, b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = 'New'); "title": "Delivery UI and release handoff 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"document-reminders",

"ui-handoff",

"settings",

"sendgrid"

\],

"content": "UI/release handoff from delivery builder:\\n\\n\* Create \`Run\_Document\_Reminders\` Custom Permission and grant it only to the named scheduler/dispatch runner (and authorised admins). The dispatcher checks \`FeatureManagement.checkPermission('Run\_Document\_Reminders')\` at scheduler, batch/queue and pre-callout stages; \`Security\_Verified\_\_c\` remains an additional administrative readiness attestation, never an authority substitute.\\n\* Email templates must be \*\*active Classic EmailTemplate\*\* records in folder name exactly \`Document\_Reminders\` with DeveloperNames \`Document\_Reminder\_Default\` and \`Document\_Reminder\_Offer\`. Stable supported tokens: \`{{DocumentReminder.CandidateFirstName}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.DuePacksText}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.DuePacksHtml}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.PortalUrl}}\`. Plain bodies must contain DuePacksText+PortalUrl; HTML bodies must contain DuePacksHtml+PortalUrl. The dispatcher HTML-escapes candidate/pack/document/URL tokens and uses no attachments or session-bearing URL fabrication.\\n\* \`Document\_Reminder\_Settings.Default\` defaults remain \`Processor\_Enabled=false\`, \`Sending\_Enabled=false\`, \`Dry\_Run=true\`, \`Suppression\_Verification\_Ready=false\`, \`Security\_Verified=false\`, daily start 09:00 \`Europe/London\`, frequency 1, duration 10. New delivery settings: \`Allowlist\_Enabled=true\` and \`Max\_Retry\_Attempts=3\`; Send Batch Size is 10 (not 20) due to 10-second direct callout timeout and 120-second cumulative budget. Production high-volume operation requires an explicitly authorised \`Allowlist\_Enabled=false\`; blank allowlist with enabled gate sends to nobody.\\n\* CMT pack mapping uses org-specific Pack Id entered by admins after deployment (never Apex hard-coded IDs). Enabled mapping has Template Developer Name and Priority; highest priority due pack selects the digest wording, ties template-name then pack-id. Unmapped due packs remain in the default-template digest.\\n\* External launch prerequisites: assign named runner both Custom Permission and SendGrid External Credential/Named Credential access; confirm runner record visibility; configure SendGrid global unsubscribe/bounce suppression plus authenticated webhook token; only then set Suppression Verification Ready. Existing webhooks use shared query token; signed webhook verification is not part of this approved code. 202 means accepted, not delivered. \`Uncertain\`, \`Accepted\` without webhook, and active/retry rows are retained rather than automatically deleted/resend.\\n\* New admin-visible outbox fields: \`Callout\_Job\_Id\_\_c\` and \`Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c\`; new statuses \`Prepared\` and \`Sending\`; new settings fields \`Allowlist\_Enabled\_\_c\`, \`Max\_Retry\_Attempts\_\_c\`.\\n\\nShared CustomLabels concern: delivery error/audit strings are currently internal outbox statuses and not added to \`labels/DocumentReminder.labels-meta.xml\` because Progress builder owns that single metadata component. If release review classifies these admin-visible errors as user-facing labels, lead/UI owner must merge appropriately named labels into the existing shared file before validation."

},

"title": "Delivery backend final findings 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"document-reminders",

"delivery",

"sendgrid",

"testing",

"handoff"

\],

"content": "Delivery/settings/SendGrid workspace work completed; no org data, schedules, callouts, anonymous Apex, validation or deployment were run (lead prohibited whole-workspace validation while parallel builders remain active).\\n\\nStaged delivery contract:\\n- \`DocumentReminderDispatchService\` is now \`with sharing\`, so all scheduler-owned Contact/Assignment/outbox reads run under the named runner’s sharing. It checks \`Run\_Document\_Reminders\` runtime Custom Permission before its scheduler, batch, queue and retention query paths; a missing runner grant is a true no-op. The named runner must therefore receive record sharing/object/FLS and SendGrid External Credential access before launch; \`Security\_Verified\_\_c\` only captures an admin’s completed verification.\\n- 09:00 configurable schedule-zone reconciliation refreshes non-hidden assignments and starts a ClaimBatch; every hourly invocation resumes only current Europe/London claimed / due explicit-429 Retry rows, terminalises previous-day active outbox rows and turns expired Leased/Prepared/Sending rows into Uncertain. Candidate day/window/cutoff always Europe/London, independent of schedule zone. Windows require 24 elapsed hours and end at duration local calendar-day timestamp; duration is bounded 1–10.\\n- Candidate/day claim is atomic \`Contact\_Day\_Key\_\_c\`, durable, and stores a 64-char opaque unique SendGrid reference at INSERT. Claim no longer creates links or consumes assignment cadence. Preparer uses only new ProgressService no-DML \`inspect\` in 200-Assignment chunks, checks every candidate’s current in-window assignment, suppresses in-window calculation errors but skips completed/hidden/expired assignments, selects a priority template, and writes exact associations before any transport. Digest lists individual outstanding document names under pack headings, not counts.\\n- Direct callout path is lease -> prepare (DML/render only) -> persisted Callout AsyncApexJob id -> SendJob. SendJob performs another no-DML inspection plus assignment-link/signature/recipient recheck. If anything changed, it does DML only and re-prepares all unsent rows in a later transaction; it never mixes those DML changes with a callout. Callout batch is capped at 10 requests at 10 seconds each. Direct reminders never create Tasks or reuse legacy platform-event fanout.\\n- SendGrid statuses: 202 \`Accepted\`, webhook \`Delivered\`; only actual HTTP 429 is Retry, uses max(configured backoff, numeric Retry-After), and stops after Max Retry Attempts (default 3). Network/timeouts/5xx -> Uncertain, no automatic retry. Each persisted result increments attempts; sparse changes are consolidated per Send Id. Failed outcome persistence leaves Sending to expire as Uncertain and does not consume assignment cadence. This is an at-most-one accepted/day guard, not an external exactly-once guarantee.\\n- Webhook keeps existing shared query-token authentication and existing Task correlation; no secret/body logging and no signature-verification bypass. New \`Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c\` blocks stale event reversal; late open/click is ignored, late delivery cannot undo a newer bounce/failure. SendGrid global unsubscribe/bounce suppression is required external configuration, while Contact opt-out/bounce and webhook terminal records provide local evidence.\\n- Retention rechecks at execute time and deletes only old \`Delivered\`, \`Rejected\`, \`Failed\`, \`Suppressed\` rows after successful association delete; it retains \`Accepted\` without delivery, \`Uncertain\`, and all active/retry/leased/prepared/sending rows.\\n\\nTests added/expanded (not executed): \`DocumentReminderDispatchServiceTest\` (atomic claim, no claim cadence, 200 candidate bulk, dry-run no transport, windows/DST/cadence, document-name escaping, mapping priority ties, gate suppression, 429 bounded retry/timeout uncertainty, duplicate callout handoff, stale/expired rows); \`DocumentReminderSettingsTest\`; \`DocumentReminderDailySchedulerTest\`; \`DocumentReminderRetentionBatchTest\`; \`SendGridWebhookTest\`; expanded \`SendGridEmailServiceTest\` (202, 429/Retry-After, 5xx uncertain, bounded group, classic stored-template renderer DML counter, legacy Task audit). Potential validation risks for lead: Salesforce test visibility of private \`@TestVisible\` nested Dispatch helper classes and test EmailTemplate creation/rendering must be confirmed on first check-only. No test result or coverage is claimed.\\n\\nMetadata additions: Settings fields \`Allowlist\_Enabled\_\_c\` default true / \`Max\_Retry\_Attempts\_\_c\` default 3; Send fields \`Callout\_Job\_Id\_\_c\` / \`Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c\`, statuses Prepared/Sending; Default send batch lowered 20->10. UI owner handoff has required exact template tokens, Custom Permission and field-permission additions."

},

#52853tool.call15 Sept 2026, 21:32

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "metadata\_builder\_mu3031fbIWTvJb0YvEpz",

"role": "metadata\_builder",

"toolCallId": "call\_FoO2WhWG4Z5sxsPts7rAahdZ",

"tool": "scratchpad\_write",

"label": "Write note: Document reminder UI, templates and permissions 2026-09-15",

▾"input": {

"title": "Document reminder UI, templates and permissions 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"document-packs",

"reminders",

"ui",

"email-templates",

"permissions",

"release-handoff"

\],

"content": "## Scope completed (staged only; no org changes)\\nCreated/modified only UI, Classic EmailTemplate and permission metadata. No Apex, Custom Fields, Custom Metadata, outbox metadata, flows, layouts, activation, scheduling, data update, validation or deployment was performed.\\n\\n### Files staged\\n- \`customPermissions/Run\_Document\_Reminders.customPermission-meta.xml\` — new runtime Custom Permission (\`Run\_Document\_Reminders\`).\\n- \`permissionsets/Angard.permissionset-meta.xml\` — partial update adding read-only FLS for all 12 new \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\` progress, availability and reminder fields. Existing Angard settings are preserved; no source-field FLS, outbox permissions or sharing was added.\\n- \`permissionsets/Document\_Reminder\_Operator.permissionset-meta.xml\` — new dedicated runner persona.\\n- \`flexipages/Document\_Assignment\_Reminder\_Record\_Page.flexipage-meta.xml\` — new unmanaged record page, not activated.\\n- \`email/Document\_Reminders.emailFolder-meta.xml\` — new public Classic Email Template folder with \`name\` \`Document\_Reminders\`.\\n- \`email/Document\_Reminders/Document\_Reminder\_Default.email\[-meta.xml\]\` — new default HTML + plain-text Classic template.\\n- \`email/Document\_Reminders/Document\_Reminder\_Offer.email\[-meta.xml\]\` — new offer-stage HTML + plain-text Classic template.\\n\\n### UI findings and design\\n- The managed source page \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_Record\_Page\` was read first. The new unmanaged page copies its \`force:highlightsPanel\`, \`force:detailPanel\`, and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submissions\_\_r\` sidebar (ADVGRID, 10 rows, action bar) without changing the managed page.\\n- The org contains deployed Dynamic Forms \`flexipage:fieldSection\` patterns on custom-object record pages. The new page adds a standard Dynamic Forms \`Document Progress\` section directly below the preserved details component—no LWC. It has unique Facet and component identifiers, all fields use \`Record.<field>\` and \`uiBehavior=readonly\`.\\n- Section fields: Completion Percentage, Applicable Document Count, Completed Document Count, Outstanding Document Count, Calculation Status, Last Calculated At and Calculation Error. Completion Percentage is in column 1 beside Calculation Status/Last Calculated At in column 2, so a Pending/Error state and the preserved successful calculation time are visible with the percentage. Formula help also blanks Completion Percentage unless status is Current; this prevents old counts being treated as current.\\n- The page has no assignment/activation or action override. Admins must manually activate/assign it after the release.\\n\\n### Template findings and contract\\n- \`Document\_Reminders\` did not exist in the current EmailTemplate folder list. Existing Folder data shows \`Name\`/DeveloperName differ for spaces; this new folder deliberately sets \`name\` and source full name to the exact backend-required \`Document\_Reminders\`.\\n- The retrieved existing HTML Classic template \`b3d\_\_X3B\_Docs\_Templates/b3d\_\_X3B\_Docs\_Bug\_Report\` demonstrates the supported \`.email\` HTML body plus \`<textOnly>\` companion in metadata. The two new templates use that Classic-template capability with \`<type>custom</type>\` and \`<available>true</available>\` so renderer validation can see them.\\n- Both templates preserve exact renderer tokens: plaintext includes \`{{DocumentReminder.CandidateFirstName}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.DuePacksText}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.PortalUrl}}\`; HTML includes \`{{DocumentReminder.CandidateFirstName}}\`, \`{{DocumentReminder.DuePacksHtml}}\`, and \`{{DocumentReminder.PortalUrl}}\` in both the descriptive button and visible fallback URL. HTML has semantic headings, readable dark text, a high-contrast blue \`Open your document portal\` link, and no real URL/recipient/org identifier.\\n- Default subject exactly: \`Reminder: please complete your outstanding documents\`. Offer subject: \`Action required: complete your outstanding offer-stage documents\`. Offer copy includes the approved unambiguous sentence: \`You cannot start work or be paid until the required offer-stage documents are completed.\` Neither template says Pending Review, awaiting review or resubmission.\\n- \`DocumentReminderDispatchService.render()\` was read. It uses \`Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate\`, obtains both plain and HTML bodies, requires DuePacksText/PortalUrl in nonblank plain bodies and DuePacksHtml/PortalUrl in nonblank HTML bodies, then replaces the same tokens. Its \`validTemplate()\` requires \`IsActive\` and \`FolderName == 'Document\_Reminders'\`. Templates are available for this renderer, but the staged Default setting remains \`Processor\_Enabled=false\`, \`Sending\_Enabled=false\`, \`Dry\_Run=true\`, and no schedule was created.\\n\\n### Permission design\\n- \`SendGrid\_Integration\` was read but deliberately not extended: it is a guest/webhook platform-event permission set, not a dedicated reminder runner persona.\\n- \`Document\_Reminder\_Operator\` grants \`Run\_Document\_Reminders\`; Contact Email/HasOptedOutOfEmail/IsEmailBounced read access; read-only FLS for \`TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.E\_W\_Location\_\_c\`; read-only FLS for all derived Assignment fields except editable \`Verified\_Available\_At\_\_c\` (the sole evidenced historical-admin override); safe read-only operational FLS for new outbox, association and refresh fields; and CRUD on the three internal outbox/refresh objects.\\n- It deliberately omits FLS for \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c.Execution\_Token\_\_c\`, \`Reference\_\_c\`, \`Contact\_Day\_Key\_\_c\`, and \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c.Send\_Assignment\_Key\_\_c\`. It grants no class access, user system permissions, guest access, Modify All Data or Modify All Records. Scheduler/dispatch classes have no UI, Flow or API entry point needing Apex Class Access.\\n- It grants \`View All\` only on Contact and \`b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\`, the records queried by the \`with sharing\` dispatch path. This is a deliberate runner blast radius: the named scheduling user can read all candidate Contacts and Document Assignments. Other source objects (Pack, Document, Submission, Application, Job) receive Read only; new outbox/refresh objects have no View All. Assignment Edit supports controlled derived/availability update capability while field edit is confined to Verified Available At.\\n\\n### Field documentation review (do not edit: backend ownership)\\n- All 12 Assignment fields and the \`E\_W\_Location\_\_c\` formula have descriptions and inline help text.\\n- All new Custom Metadata and internal object fields have descriptions, but inline help is incomplete. Only \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c.Callout\_Job\_Id\_\_c\`, \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c.Last\_Provider\_Event\_At\_\_c\`, all four Pack CMDT fields, and Settings \`Allowlist\_Enabled\_\_c\`/\`Max\_Retry\_Attempts\_\_c\` currently have inline help. The remaining 13 Send fields, all 4 Send Association fields, all 11 Refresh Request fields, 17 Settings fields and all 6 Rule Dependency fields lack it. This is reported only; no owned backend fields were changed.\\n\\n### Required manual release/launch actions\\n1. After a clean lead-run check-only validation and approved deployment, a Salesforce admin must activate/assign \`Document\_Assignment\_Reminder\_Record\_Page\` for the intended Document Assignment app/profile/record type.
