"content": "/\*\*\\n \* Core SendGrid email pipeline.\\n \*\\n \* publish() -> one SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e platform event per email (any context, incl. guest users)\\n \* enqueueFromEvents()-> called by the platform event trigger, which runs as the Automated Process user,\\n \* so EmailTemplate access and Contact visibility never depend on the calling user\\n \* SendJob -> renders the template, POSTs to SendGrid, logs a Task on the target record\\n \*\\n \* The webhook (SendGridWebhook) later updates the Task with real delivery status.\\n \*/\\npublic without sharing class SendGridEmailService {\\n\\n public class SendGridException extends Exception {}\\n\\n public class EmailRequest {\\n public String templateName;\\n public Id recipientId;\\n public Id relatedRecordId;\\n public String toAddress;\\n public String subject;\\n public String plainTextBody;\\n public String htmlBody;\\n public String fromAddress;\\n public String fromName;\\n public String reference; // correlates the Task with SendGrid webhook events\\n }\\n\\n // ponytail: 50 emails (= 50 callouts) per async transaction; raise toward the 100-callout limit if throughput matters\\n @TestVisible private static Integer CHUNK\_SIZE = 50;\\n\\n /\*\* Queue emails for async delivery. Callable from Apex for bulk sends. \*/\\n public static void publish(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events = new List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n events.add(new SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e(Payload\_\_c = JSON.serialize(em)));\\n }\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Events to process:' + events.size());\\n\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : EventBus.publish(events)) {\\n if (!sr.isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n throw new SendGridException('Could not queue email for SendGrid: ' + sr.getErrors());\\n }else{\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Published Event Successfully');\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Platform event trigger handler: fan events out into queueable send jobs. \*/\\n public static void enqueueFromEvents(List<SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e> events) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, 'Queue from platform events');\\n List<EmailRequest> chunk = new List<EmailRequest>();\\n for (SendGrid\_Email\_Request\_\_e ev : events) {\\n chunk.add((EmailRequest) JSON.deserialize(ev.Payload\_\_c, EmailRequest.class));\\n if (chunk.size() == CHUNK\_SIZE) {\\n System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk));\\n chunk = new List<EmailRequest>();\\n }\\n }\\n if (!chunk.isEmpty()) {\\n System.enqueueJob(new SendJob(chunk));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public class SendJob implements Queueable, Database.AllowsCallouts {\\n private List<EmailRequest> emails;\\n public SendJob(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n this.emails = emails;\\n }\\n public void execute(QueueableContext ctx) {\\n doSend(emails);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public static void doSend(List<EmailRequest> emails) {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = settings();\\n\\n Set<String> templateNames = new Set<String>();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) {\\n templateNames.add(em.templateName);\\n }\\n if (em.recipientId != null) {\\n contactIds.add(em.recipientId);\\n }\\n }\\n Map<String, Id> templateIdByName = new Map<String, Id>();\\n for (EmailTemplate t : \[SELECT Id, DeveloperName FROM EmailTemplate WHERE DeveloperName IN :templateNames\]) {\\n templateIdByName.put(t.DeveloperName, t.Id);\\n }\\n Map<Id, Contact> contacts = new Map<Id, Contact>(\[SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Id IN :contactIds\]);\\n\\n // All callouts happen before any DML (Task inserts) — required ordering.\\n List<Task> logs = new List<Task>();\\n for (EmailRequest em : emails) {\\n em.reference = EncodingUtil.convertToHex(Crypto.generateAesKey(128));\\n Contact who = contacts.get(em.recipientId);\\n String toAddr = String.isNotBlank(em.toAddress) ? em.toAddress : who?.Email;\\n String subject = em.subject;\\n String plainBody = em.plainTextBody;\\n String htmlBody = em.htmlBody;\\n\\n Task log = new Task(\\n Status = 'Completed',\\n TaskSubtype = 'Email',\\n ActivityDate = Date.today(),\\n WhoId = em.recipientId,\\n WhatId = em.relatedRecordId,\\n SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c = em.reference,\\n SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = System.now()\\n );\\n try {\\n if (String.isBlank(toAddr)) {\\n throw new SendGridException('No recipient email address.');\\n }\\n if (String.isNotBlank(em.templateName)) {\\n Id templateId = templateIdByName.get(em.templateName);\\n if (templateId == null) {\\n throw new SendGridException('Email template not found: ' + em.templateName);\\n }\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage rendered =\\n Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(templateId, em.recipientId, em.relatedRecordId);\\n subject = rendered.getSubject();\\n plainBody = rendered.getPlainTextBody();\\n htmlBody = rendered.getHtmlBody();\\n }\\n HttpResponse res = new Http().send(buildRequest(cfg, em, toAddr, who?.Name, subject, plainBody, htmlBody));\\n if (res.getStatusCode() >= 300) {\\n throw new SendGridException('SendGrid returned ' + res.getStatusCode() + ': '\\n + (res.getBody() == null ? '' : res.getBody().abbreviate(200)));\\n }\\n log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Sent';\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n log.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = 'Failed';\\n log.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = e.getMessage().abbreviate(255);\\n }\\n log.Subject = 'Email: ' + (String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject.abbreviate(240));\\n log.Description = String.isNotBlank(plainBody) ? plainBody.abbreviate(31000)\\n : (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody) ? htmlBody.stripHtmlTags().abbreviate(31000) : null);\\n logs.add(log);\\n }\\n\\n // Partial insert; if a WhatId isn't activity-enabled retry that log without it so the audit row survives.\\n List<Task> retries = new List<Task>();\\n Database.SaveResult\[\] results = Database.insert(logs, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (!results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n Task t = logs\[i\].clone(false, true);\\n t.WhatId = null;\\n retries.add(t);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!retries.isEmpty()) {\\n Database.insert(retries, false);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n private static HttpRequest buildRequest(SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg, EmailRequest em,\\n String toAddr, String toName, String subject, String plainBody, String htmlBody) {\\n List<Object> content = new List<Object>();\\n if (String.isNotBlank(plainBody)) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => plainBody });\\n }\\n if (String.isNotBlank(htmlBody)) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/html', 'value' => htmlBody });\\n }\\n if (content.isEmpty()) {\\n content.add(new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'text/plain', 'value' => ' ' });\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> body = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'personalizations' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'to' => new List<Object>{ new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'email' => toAddr,\\n 'name' => String.isBlank(toName) ? toAddr : toName } },\\n 'custom\_args' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'sf\_ref' => em.reference } } },\\n 'from' => new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'email' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromAddress) ? em.fromAddress : cfg.Default\_From\_Address\_\_c,\\n 'name' => String.isNotBlank(em.fromName) ? em.fromName : cfg.Default\_From\_Name\_\_c },\\n 'subject' => String.isBlank(subject) ? '(no subject)' : subject,\\n 'content' => content\\n };\\n if (cfg.Sandbox\_Mode\_\_c) {\\n body.put('mail\_settings', new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'sandbox\_mode' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'enable' => true } });\\n }\\n HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest();\\n req.setEndpoint('callout:SendGrid/v3/mail/send');\\n req.setMethod('POST');\\n req.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');\\n req.setHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer {!$Credential.Password}');\\n req.setTimeout(20000);\\n req.setBody(JSON.serialize(body));\\n return req;\\n }\\n\\n public static SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt settings() {\\n SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt cfg = SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt.getInstance('Default');\\n if (cfg == null) {\\n throw new SendGridException('SendGrid\_Settings\_\_mdt record \\"Default\\" is missing.');\\n }\\n return cfg;\\n }\\n}"

"metadataType": "ApexClass",

"fullName": "SendGridWebhook",

"content": "/\*\*\\n \* SendGrid Event Webhook receiver.\\n \* Expose via a public Site; configure SendGrid to POST to:\\n \* https://<site-domain>/services/apexrest/sendgrid/events?token=<Webhook\_Secret\_\_c>\\n \* Events carry our custom arg sf\_ref, which matches Task.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c\\n \* on the activity logged at send time.\\n \*/\\n@RestResource(urlMapping='/sendgrid/events')\\nglobal without sharing class SendGridWebhook {\\n\\n @TestVisible private static String secretOverride;\\n\\n @HttpPost\\n global static void handleEvents() {\\n RestRequest req = RestContext.request;\\n RestResponse res = RestContext.response;\\n\\n // ponytail: shared-secret query param instead of ECDSA signature verification (unsupported by Apex Crypto)\\n String secret = secretOverride != null ? secretOverride : SendGridEmailService.settings().Webhook\_Secret\_\_c;\\n if (String.isBlank(secret) || req.params.get('token') != secret) {\\n res.statusCode = 401;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n List<Object> events;\\n try {\\n events = (List<Object>) JSON.deserializeUntyped(req.requestBody.toString());\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n res.statusCode = 400;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Keep only the newest event per sf\_ref in this batch.\\n Map<String, Map<String, Object>> latestByRef = new Map<String, Map<String, Object>>();\\n for (Object o : events) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = (Map<String, Object>) o;\\n String ref = (String) ev.get('sf\_ref');\\n if (String.isBlank(ref)) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n Map<String, Object> current = latestByRef.get(ref);\\n if (current == null || epoch(ev) >= epoch(current)) {\\n latestByRef.put(ref, ev);\\n }\\n }\\n if (!latestByRef.isEmpty()) {\\n List<Task> updates = new List<Task>();\\n for (Task t : \[SELECT Id, SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c FROM Task WHERE SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c IN :latestByRef.keySet()\]) {\\n Map<String, Object> ev = latestByRef.get(t.SendGrid\_Reference\_\_c);\\n String reason = (String) ev.get('reason');\\n t.SendGrid\_Status\_\_c = ((String) ev.get('event'))?.abbreviate(40);\\n t.SendGrid\_Failure\_Reason\_\_c = reason?.abbreviate(255);\\n t.SendGrid\_Last\_Event\_At\_\_c = Datetime.newInstance(epoch(ev) \* 1000);\\n updates.add(t);\\n }\\n Database.update(updates, false);\\n }\\n res.statusCode = 200;\\n }\\n\\n private static Long epoch(Map<String, Object> ev) {\\n Object ts = ev.get('timestamp');\\n return ts == null ? 0 : Long.valueOf(String.valueOf(ts));\\n }\\n}"

},

"fullName": "ApplicationJobRollupTrigger",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Maintains Job.Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Job.Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* Deliberately thin. All decision logic lives in JobFillRollupHandler\\n \* so it can be unit tested directly — Applications cannot be updated\\n \* via DML in this org (field-level security blocks it, and\\n \* TR1\_\_Job\_\_c is not writeable after insert), so the update path is\\n \* unreachable from a test that relies on real DML.\\n \*/\\ntrigger ApplicationJobRollupTrigger on TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c (\\n after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete\\n) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = JobFillRollupHandler.collectAffectedJobIds(\\n Trigger.isDelete ? Trigger.old : Trigger.new,\\n Trigger.isUpdate ? Trigger.oldMap : null\\n );\\n\\n JobFillRollupHandler.recalculate(jobIds);\\n}"

},

}\\n\\n scanned += scope.size();\\n\\n Set<Id> appIds = (new Map<Id, SObject>(scope)).keySet();\\n Set<Id> contactIds = new Set<Id>();\\n for (SObject app : scope) {\\n contactIds.add((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> alreadyLinked = new Set<Id>();\\n for (b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c existing : \[\\n SELECT Application\_\_c FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c\\n WHERE Application\_\_c IN :appIds \]) {\\n alreadyLinked.add(existing.Application\_\_c);\\n }\\n\\n // \\"Get Old Application\\"\\n Datetime cutoff = System.now().addDays(-RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS);\\n List<String> priorFields = new List<String>{ 'Id', 'TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c' };\\n if (appHasBusProc) { priorFields.add(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC); }\\n\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact = new Map<Id, List<SObject>>();\\n for (SObject prior : Database.query(\\n 'SELECT ' + String.join(priorFields, ', ')\\n + ' FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c'\\n + ' WHERE TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c IN :contactIds AND CreatedDate >= :cutoff')) {\\n\\n Id contactId = (Id) prior.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c');\\n if (!priorByContact.containsKey(contactId)) {\\n priorByContact.put(contactId, new List<SObject>());\\n }\\n priorByContact.get(contactId).add(prior);\\n }\\n\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> toInsert = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n\\n for (SObject app : scope) {\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n if (alreadyLinked.contains(appId)) { skippedLinked++; continue; }\\n\\n SObject job = jobsById.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c'));\\n if (job == null) { skippedNoBranch++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Account Decision -------------------------------------------\\n String accountRoute = routeByAccount(job);\\n if (accountRoute == null) { skippedAccount++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Which branch ------------------------------------------------\\n if (accountRoute == 'FOS') { skippedFos++; continue; }\\n\\n String branch = routeByBusinessProcess(job);\\n\\n if (branch == null) { skippedNoBranch++; continue; }\\n\\n // ---- Standard 5 step sub-flow ------------------------------------\\n\\n // 1. New Application Assignment, unconditional\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, basePackId));\\n\\n // 2. Location filter\\n String location = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c'));\\n List<Id> packIds = packIdsByRule.get(ruleKey(branch, location));\\n if (packIds == null || packIds.isEmpty()) {\\n skippedNoPack++;\\n errorLog.add('No pack configured for \\"' + branch + '\\" / \\"' + location\\n + '\\" (Application ' + appId + ')');\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // 3. Previously Applied with us?\\n if (hasPriorApplication(app, job, priorByContact)) { skippedRecent++; continue; }\\n\\n // 4 + 5. Onboarding pack, then the hidden application form pack\\n for (Id packId : packIds) {\\n toInsert.add(buildAssignment(app, packId));\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (toInsert.isEmpty()) { return; }\\n\\n List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(toInsert, false);\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n assignmentsMade++;\\n } else {\\n failedRows++;\\n if (errorLog.size() < 100) {\\n errorLog.add('Application ' + toInsert\[i\].Application\_\_c + ': '\\n + results\[i\].getErrors()\[0\].getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // ROUTING\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Test-only hook. TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c is a formula reading through to the\\n \* Account, and Reed's Account validation rules make creating one in a test\\n \* impractical, so tests force the outcome here instead. 'NONE' means the\\n \* Default Outcome. Guarded by Test.isRunningTest() so it can never affect\\n \* live behaviour.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible private static String accountRouteOverride;\\n\\n /\*\* Account Decision. 'ANGARD', 'FOS', or null meaning do nothing. \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByAccount(SObject job) {\\n\\n if (Test.isRunningTest() && accountRouteOverride != null) {\\n return accountRouteOverride == 'NONE' ? null : accountRouteOverride;\\n }\\n\\n String account = (String) job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c');\\n if (String.isBlank(account)) { return null; }\\n if (account.containsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_ANGARD\_CONTAINS)) { return 'ANGARD'; }\\n if (account.equalsIgnoreCase(ACCOUNT\_FOS\_EQUALS)) { return 'FOS'; }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Business Process decision, in the flow's outcome order.\\n \* Business process and Business Area both live on the JOB.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String routeByBusinessProcess(SObject job) {\\n\\n String bp = String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'));\\n String area = String.valueOf(job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c'));\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(bp) || bp == 'null') { return null; }\\n\\n // BAU uses \\"Any Condition Is Met (OR)\\" across three values.\\n if (bp == 'BAU' || bp == 'Aviation' || bp == 'Onsite') { return 'BAU'; }\\n\\n if (bp == 'Delivery') { return 'Delivery'; }\\n if (bp == 'RMSS') { return 'RMSS'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW C&D') { return 'PFW C&D'; }\\n if (bp == 'PFW WH HUB') { return 'PFW WH HUB'; }\\n\\n // Fleet, CACIB, Customer Experience, Friends & Family, Returners and\\n // Onsite with CV Upload are out of scope for this sync.\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* \\"Previously Applied with us?\\" - another application for the same applicant,\\n \* created inside the window. Production also requires the same business\\n \* process; where that field does not exist the date match alone is used.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private Boolean hasPriorApplication(SObject app, SObject job,\\n Map<Id, List<SObject>> priorByContact) {\\n\\n List<SObject> priors = priorByContact.get((Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'));\\n if (priors == null) { return false; }\\n\\n Id appId = (Id) app.get('Id');\\n\\n for (SObject prior : priors) {\\n if ((Id) prior.get('Id') == appId) { continue; }\\n if (!appHasBusProc) { return true; }\\n Object priorBp = prior.get(F\_APP\_BUS\_PROC);\\n if (String.valueOf(priorBp) == String.valueOf(job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c'))) {\\n return true;\\n }\\n }\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // CONFIGURATION\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private static String ruleKey(String branch, String location) {\\n return branch + '|' + (String.isBlank(location) || location == 'null' ? '' : location);\\n }\\n\\n private static Boolean hasField(String objectApi, String fieldApi) {\\n Schema.SObjectType t = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get(objectApi.toLowerCase());\\n return t != null && t.getDescribe().fields.getMap().containsKey(fieldApi.toLowerCase());\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Resolves every configured setting field to a live pack Id in THIS org.\\n \* Returns a reason to abort, or null when the configuration is usable.\\n \*/\\n @TestVisible\\n private String loadAndValidateConfiguration() {\\n\\n if (packIdsByRule != null) { return null; } // injected by a test\\n\\n packIdsByRule = new Map<String, List<Id>>();\\n hiddenPackIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n SObject setting = X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.getOrgDefaults();\\n if (setting == null) {\\n return 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c has no organisation defaults '\\n + 'in this org. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> settingFields =\\n Schema.SObjectType.X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.fields.getMap();\\n\\n List<String> problems = new List<String>();\\n Set<Id> configured = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n basePackId = readPack(setting, settingFields, SETTING\_FIELD\_BASE\_PACK, problems);\\n if (basePackId != null) { configured.add(basePackId); }\\n\\n for (String key : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.keySet()) {\\n List<Id> ids = new List<Id>();\\n for (String fieldName : PACK\_FIELDS\_BY\_RULE.get(key)) {\\n Id packId = readPack(setting, settingFields, fieldName, problems);\\n if (packId == null) { continue; }\\n ids.add(packId);\\n if (HIDDEN\_PACK\_FIELDS.contains(fieldName)) { hiddenPackIds.add(packId); }\\n configured.add(packId);\\n }\\n if (!ids.isEmpty()) { packIdsByRule.put(key, ids); }\\n }\\n\\n if (!problems.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'Document pack configuration is not usable in this org. Nothing was '\\n + 'created.\\\\n - ' + String.join(problems, '\\\\n - ');\\n }\\n\\n Set<Id> live = new Map<Id, b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c>(\[\\n SELECT Id FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c WHERE Id IN :configured \]).keySet();\\n\\n Set<Id> missing = new Set<Id>(configured);\\n missing.removeAll(live);\\n\\n if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\\n return 'These Document Pack Ids are configured on '\\n + 'X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c but do not exist in this org: '\\n + String.join(new List<Id>(missing), ', ') + '. Nothing was created.';\\n }\\n return null;\\n }\\n\\n private Id readPack(SObject setting, Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> fields,\\n String fieldName, List<String> problems) {\\n\\n if (String.isBlank(fieldName)) { return null; }\\n\\n if (!fields.containsKey(fieldName.toLowerCase())) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName\\n + ' does not exist on X3B\_DocumentsUpload\_Variables\_\_c.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n Object raw = setting.get(fieldName);\\n String val = (raw == null) ? '' : String.valueOf(raw);\\n if (String.isBlank(val)) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' is empty in this org.');\\n return null;\\n }\\n try {\\n return (Id) val;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n problems.add('Field ' + fieldName + ' does not hold a valid Id: ' + val);\\n return null;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // FINISH\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) {\\n\\n if (syncFieldExists() && !jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n Schema.SObjectType jobType = Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get('tr1\_\_job\_\_c');\\n List<SObject> toReset = new List<SObject>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject j = jobType.newSObject(jobId);\\n j.put(SYNC\_FIELD, false);\\n toReset.add(j);\\n }\\n suppressTrigger = true;\\n try {\\n update toReset;\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n errorLog.add('Could not reset Sync checkbox: ' + e.getMessage());\\n } finally {\\n suppressTrigger = false;\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (abortReason != null) {\\n String failure = 'Sync Document Assignments - NOT RUN\\\\n\\\\n' + abortReason + '\\\\n';\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, failure);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - configuration error', failure);\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n String body =\\n 'Sync Document Assignments\\\\n\\\\n'\\n + 'Jobs ..................................... ' + jobIds.size() + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Applications scanned ..................... ' + scanned + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Document Assignments created ............. ' + assignmentsMade + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - already had an assignment ...... ' + skippedLinked + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - Account not Angard or FOS ...... ' + skippedAccount + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no matching branch ............. ' + skippedNoBranch + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - FOS account (out of scope) ..... ' + skippedFos + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - no pack configured ............. ' + skippedNoPack + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Skipped - applied in last '\\n + RECENT\_APPLICATION\_DAYS + ' days ......... ' + skippedRecent + '\\\\n'\\n + 'Failed rows .............................. ' + failedRows + '\\\\n';\\n\\n if (!errorLog.isEmpty()) {\\n body += '\\\\nDetail\\\\n------\\\\n';\\n for (String line : errorLog) { body += line + '\\\\n'; }\\n }\\n\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n SObject job = jobsById.get(jobId);\\n if (job != null) {\\n body += '\\\\nJob: ' + job.get('Name')\\n + '\\\\n Account .......... ' + job.get('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business process . ' + job.get('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Business Area .... ' + job.get('Business\_Area\_\_c')\\n + '\\\\n Location ......... ' + job.get('BH\_Location\_\_c');\\n if (jobHasRoleType) {\\n body += '\\\\n FOS Role Type .... ' + job.get(F\_JOB\_ROLE\_TYPE);\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.INFO, body);\\n sendSummary('Sync Document Assignments - '\\n + assignmentsMade + ' created, ' + failedRows + ' failed', body);\\n }\\n\\n // =========================================================================\\n // HELPERS\\n // =========================================================================\\n\\n private b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c buildAssignment(SObject app, Id packId) {\\n return new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = (Id) app.get('Id'),\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = (Id) app.get('TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c'),\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = hiddenPackIds != null && hiddenPackIds.contains(packId)\\n );\\n }\\n\\n private void sendSummary(String subject, String body) {\\n if (Test.isRunningTest()) { return; }\\n try {\\n Messaging.SingleEmailMessage mail = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage();\\n mail.setToAddresses(new List<String>{ UserInfo.getUserEmail() });\\n mail.setSubject(subject);\\n mail.setPlainTextBody(body);\\n mail.setSaveAsActivity(false);\\n Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{ mail });\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR, 'Summary email failed: ' + e.getMessage());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

▾{

"path": "classes/JobFillRollupHandler.cls",

"size": 6138,

"metadataType": "ApexClass",

"fullName": "JobFillRollupHandler",

"content": "/\*\\n \* Recalculates Angard\_Filled\_\_c and Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c on TR1\_\_Job\_\_c —\\n \* count of related TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c records at the filled stage,\\n \* split by Agency\_\_c.\\n \*\\n \* FAILURE ISOLATION: this runs from an Application trigger, so an\\n \* unhandled error here would roll back the Application insert or update\\n \* that caused it. Recruiters would be unable to create applications\\n \* because of a problem updating a Job. Two safeguards prevent that:\\n \*\\n \* 1. Database.update(..., false) — a Job that cannot be saved is\\n \* skipped and logged rather than throwing.\\n \* 2. A surrounding try/catch — any unexpected failure is swallowed\\n \* and logged.\\n \*\\n \* Fill counts are reporting figures, not transactional data. A stale\\n \* count is a far smaller problem than a blocked application, and the\\n \* next relevant change to that Job's applications will correct it.\\n \*\\n \* Known related risk: the org's \\"Job: After Create - Create Job Unique\\n \* URL Slug\\" flow calls PQ\_PrepareJobUrlName, which is not bulk safe —\\n \* it processes only the first record of any batch. If that flow is ever\\n \* configured to run on update as well as create, the bulk Job update\\n \* below would trigger it. The partial-success DML means that would\\n \* degrade fill counts rather than break application creation.\\n \*/\\npublic with sharing class JobFillRollupHandler {\\n\\n private static final String FILLED\_STAGE = 'New Hire';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_ANGARD = 'Angard';\\n private static final String AGENCY\_PERTEMPS = 'Pertemps';\\n\\n /\*\\n \* Works out which Jobs need their counts recalculated.\\n \*\\n \* Pass oldMap only for updates. When it is null the operation is an\\n \* insert, delete or undelete and every referenced Job is affected.\\n \* When it is populated, only Applications where Stage, Agency or the\\n \* Job lookup actually changed are relevant — recalculating on every\\n \* Application update would put needless DML on the Job object, and at\\n \* Peak volumes that is both wasted work and extra opportunity for\\n \* unrelated Job automation to fail.\\n \*\\n \* Separated from the trigger so it can be unit tested with in-memory\\n \* records rather than DML.\\n \*/\\n public static Set<Id> collectAffectedJobIds(\\n List<TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> records,\\n Map<Id, TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c> oldMap\\n ) {\\n Set<Id> jobIds = new Set<Id>();\\n\\n if (records == null) {\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n for (TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c app : records) {\\n if (oldMap == null) {\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c priorVersion = oldMap.get(app.Id);\\n if (priorVersion == null) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n Boolean stageChanged = app.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c;\\n Boolean agencyChanged = app.Agency\_\_c != priorVersion.Agency\_\_c;\\n Boolean jobChanged = app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c;\\n\\n if (!stageChanged && !agencyChanged && !jobChanged) {\\n continue;\\n }\\n\\n // Reparenting affects the counts on both Jobs.\\n if (app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(app.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n if (priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c != null) {\\n jobIds.add(priorVersion.TR1\_\_Job\_\_c);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n return jobIds;\\n }\\n\\n public static void recalculate(Set<Id> jobIds) {\\n if (jobIds == null || jobIds.isEmpty()) {\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n try {\\n Map<Id, Integer> angardCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n Map<Id, Integer> pertempsCounts = new Map<Id, Integer>();\\n\\n // Default every job to zero first, so jobs that no longer\\n // have matching Applications get reset rather than left stale.\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n angardCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n pertempsCounts.put(jobId, 0);\\n }\\n\\n for (AggregateResult ar : \[\\n SELECT TR1\_\_Job\_\_c jobId, Agency\_\_c agency, COUNT(Id) cnt\\n FROM TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c\\n WHERE TR1\_\_Job\_\_c IN :jobIds\\n AND TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c = :FILLED\_STAGE\\n GROUP BY TR1\_\_Job\_\_c, Agency\_\_c\\n \]) {\\n Id jobId = (Id) ar.get('jobId');\\n String agency = (String) ar.get('agency');\\n Integer cnt = (Integer) ar.get('cnt');\\n\\n if (agency == AGENCY\_ANGARD) {\\n angardCounts.put(jobId, cnt);\\n } else if (agency == AGENCY\_PERTEMPS) {\\n pertempsCounts.put(jobId, cnt);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c> jobsToUpdate = new List<TR1\_\_Job\_\_c>();\\n for (Id jobId : jobIds) {\\n jobsToUpdate.add(new TR1\_\_Job\_\_c(\\n Id = jobId,\\n Angard\_Filled\_\_c = angardCounts.get(jobId),\\n Pertemps\_Filled\_\_c = pertempsCounts.get(jobId)\\n ));\\n }\\n\\n // Partial success: one unsaveable Job must not roll back the\\n // Application DML that triggered this.\\n Database.SaveResult\[\] results = Database.update(jobsToUpdate, false);\\n\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {\\n if (!results\[i\].isSuccess()) {\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR,\\n 'JobFillRollupHandler: could not update fill counts on Job '\\n + jobsToUpdate\[i\].Id + ' — ' + results\[i\].getErrors());\\n }\\n }\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n // Never propagate. A failure to update reporting figures must\\n // not prevent an application being created or progressed.\\n System.debug(LoggingLevel.ERROR,\\n 'JobFillRollupHandler: recalculation failed for Jobs ' + jobIds\\n + ' — ' + e.getMessage() + '\\\\n' + e.getStackTraceString());\\n }\\n }\\n}"

},

"content": "/\*\\n \* Test coverage for JobFillRollupHandler / ApplicationJobRollupTrigger.\\n \*\\n \* TEMPORARY BYPASS — TR1\_\_Contact\_\_c on Job has a lookup filter requiring\\n \* TR1\_\_Is\_Contact\_\_c = true. We couldn't get a synthetic test Contact to\\n \* satisfy that filter (strong signal TR1\_\_Is\_Contact\_\_c is formula-derived\\n \* rather than a plain settable checkbox — unconfirmed). Rather than keep\\n \* guessing, this queries an EXISTING Contact in the org that already\\n \* satisfies the filter, via @isTest(SeeAllData=true).\\n \*\\n \* This is a deliberate tradeoff, not a long-term fix: SeeAllData=true\\n \* means these tests depend on a specific real record existing in\\n \* whichever org they run in. If that Contact is ever deleted, or this\\n \* deploys to an org where no such Contact exists, every test here fails\\n \* for a reason that has nothing to do with the trigger being tested.\\n \* Replace getHiringManagerContact() with real synthetic Contact creation\\n \* once the TR1\_\_Is\_Contact\_\_c formula/dependency is confirmed.\\n \*\\n \* ALL PLACEHOLDER VALUES CONFIRMED:\\n \* - JOB\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME / APPLICATION\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME: 'BH\_Angard'\\n \* - FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE: 'New Hire'\\n \* - NOT\_FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE: 'Application'\\n \*/\\n@isTest(SeeAllData=true)\\nprivate class JobFillRollupHandlerTest {\\n\\n private static final String JOB\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME = 'BH\_Angard';\\n private static final String APPLICATION\_RECORD\_TYPE\_DEV\_NAME = 'BH\_Angard';\\n\\n // Must match JobFillRollupHandler.FILLED\_STAGE exactly — confirmed value.\\n private static final String FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE = 'New Hire';\\n\\n // Confirmed valid TR1\_\_Stage\_\_c value for this record type, distinct\\n // from FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE — used for \\"not yet filled\\" test scenarios.\\n private static final String NOT\_FILLED\_STAGE\_VALUE = 'Application';\\n\\n public class TestSetupException extends Exception {}\\n\\n private static Id getRecordTypeId(String objectApiName, String developerName) {\\n return Schema.getGlobalDescribe().get(objectApiName).getDescribe()\\n .getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName().get(developerName).getRecordTypeId();\\n }\\n\\n private static Account createTestAccount() {\\n // This org's default Account record type is RPO\_Account, which\\n // has a validation rule requiring BH\_RPO\_\_c to be populated.\\n // 'Angard' is a confirmed valid active picklist value.\\n Account acc = new Account(\\n Name = 'Test Account - Every value the routing decisions read, and what they decide.\\n TR1\_\_Job\_\_c real = \[\\n SELECT Id, Name, TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c, BH\_Business\_process\_\_c,\\n BH\_Location\_\_c, Business\_Area\_\_c\\n FROM TR1\_\_Job\_\_c WHERE Id = :jobId\];\\n\\n r += 'Job.TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c : ' + real.TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'Job.BH\_Business\_process\_\_c : ' + real.BH\_Business\_process\_\_c + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'Job.BH\_Location\_\_c : ' + real.BH\_Location\_\_c + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'Job.Business\_Area\_\_c : ' + real.Business\_Area\_\_c + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'accountRouteOverride : ' + DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.accountRouteOverride + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'routeByAccount() : ' + probe.routeByAccount(real) + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'routeByBusinessProcess() : ' + probe.routeByBusinessProcess(real) + '\\\\n';\\n\\n // 4. Is the injected configuration still there when execute() runs?\\n r += 'basePackId injected : ' + DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.basePackId + '\\\\n';\\n r += 'packIdsByRule keys : '\\n + (DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.packIdsByRule == null\\n ? 'NULL - the injection was lost'\\n : String.valueOf(DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.packIdsByRule.keySet())) + '\\\\n';\\n\\n // 5. Did something already link these applications, making them skip?\\n r += 'assignments already on apps : '\\n + \[SELECT COUNT() FROM b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c WHERE Application\_\_c IN :apps\] + '\\\\n';\\n\\n // 6. Does the FULL shape the batch inserts survive, not just one row?\\n List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c> rows = new List<b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < apps.size(); i++) {\\n for (Id packId : new List<Id>{ basePackId, branchPackId, formPackId }) {\\n rows.add(new b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c(\\n Application\_\_c = apps\[i\].Id,\\n b3o\_\_Contact\_\_c = candidates\[i\].Id,\\n b3o\_\_Document\_Pack\_\_c = packId,\\n b3o\_\_Status\_\_c = DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch.ASSIGNMENT\_STATUS\_NEW,\\n b3o\_\_Hide\_from\_Candidate\_\_c = (packId == formPackId)));\\n }\\n }\\n Integer ok = 0;\\n String firstError = 'none';\\n try {\\n for (Database.SaveResult sr : Database.insert(rows, false)) {\\n if (sr.isSuccess()) {\\n ok++;\\n } else if (firstError == 'none') {\\n firstError = sr.getErrors()\[0\].getStatusCode() + ' - '\\n + sr.getErrors()\[0\].getMessage() + ' '\\n + sr.getErrors()\[0\].getFields();\\n }\\n }\\n } catch (Exception e) {\\n firstError = e.getTypeName() + ': ' + e.getMessage();\\n }\\n r += 'bulk probe ' + rows.size() + ' rows : ' + ok\\n + ' succeeded, first error: ' + firstError + '\\\\n';\\n\\n System.assert(false, r);\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Runs the batch synchronously, inside this transaction.\\n \*\\n \* WHY NOT Database.executeBatch. That schedules start() and execute() as\\n \* SEPARATE transactions, and Apex resets STATIC state between transactions.\\n \* The pack configuration this test injects - packIdsByRule, basePackId,\\n \* hiddenPackIds, accountRouteOverride - is all static, so by the time the\\n \* batch actually ran it was gone. loadAndValidateConfiguration() then fell\\n \* through to the hierarchy custom setting, whose DATA is invisible in a test\\n \* context, found nothing usable, and the class did exactly the right thing:\\n \* it aborted and created nothing. Correct in Production, useless in a test.\\n \*\\n \* Driving start/execute/finish directly keeps one transaction, so the\\n \* injected configuration survives and the real routing logic runs against\\n \* real records. The batch framework itself is Salesforce's to test, not ours.\\n \*/\\n private static void runSync(Id jobId) {\\n DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch batch = new DocumentAssignmentSyncBatch(jobId);\\n Database.QueryLocatorIterator it = batch.start(null).iterator();\\n List<SObject> scope = new List<SObject>();\\n while (it.hasNext()) { scope.add(it.next()); }\\n if (!scope.isEmpty()) { batch.execute(null, scope); }\\n batch.finish(null);\\n }\\n\\n private static void addLocation(TR1\_\_Job\_\_c job, String location) {\\n Schema.SObjectField f = TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.SObjectType.getDescribe()\\n .fields.getMap().get('bh\_location\_\_c');\\n if (f == null || !f.getDescribe().isUpdateable()) { return; }\\n job.put('BH\_Location\_\_c', location);\\n update job;\\n }\\n\\n private static Integer counter = 0;\\n private static String uniqueSuffix() {\\n counter++;\\n return String.valueOf(Datetime.now().getTime()) + '-' + counter\\n + '-' + Math.abs(Crypto.getRandomInteger());\\n }\\n\\n // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n // ACCOUNT\\n // Job ISNULL(TR1\_\_Account\_\_c)\\n // || NOT(TR1\_\_Account\_\_r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'RPO\_Account')\\n // Account IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'RPO\_Account'\\n // && ISBLANK(TEXT(BH\_RPO\_\_c)), true, false)\\n // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n private static Id cachedRpoAccountId;\\n\\n private static Id rpoAccount() {\\n if (cachedRpoAccountId == null) {\\n Account acct = new Account(Name = TEST\_ACCOUNT\_NAME);\\n\\n Schema.RecordTypeInfo rt = Schema.SObjectType.Account\\n .getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName().get('RPO\_Account');\\n if (rt != null && rt.isAvailable()) {\\n acct.RecordTypeId = rt.getRecordTypeId();\\n }\\n setFirstPicklistValue(acct, 'BH\_RPO\_\_c');\\n\\n insert acct;\\n cachedRpoAccountId = acct.Id;\\n }\\n return cachedRpoAccountId;\\n }\\n\\n /\*\*\\n \* Contact carries \\"Please select an Active RPO before creating a Candidate.\\"\\n \* Every createable field mentioning RPO is populated by type, so this works\\n \* in either org without knowing the field's name.\\n \*/\\n private static List<Contact> buildContacts(Integer howMany) {\\n List<Contact> contacts = new List<Contact>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < howMany; i++) {\\n Contact c = new Contact(\\n FirstName = 'ZZ Apex',\\n LastName = 'Candidate ' + uniqueSuffix()\\n );\\n populateRpoFields(c);\\n contacts.add(c);\\n }\\n return contacts;\\n }\\n\\n private static void populateRpoFields(SObject record) {\\n\\n Map<String, Schema.SObjectField> fields =\\n record.getSObjectType().getDescribe().fields.getMap();\\n\\n for (String key : fields.keySet()) {\\n\\n Schema.DescribeFieldResult fd = fields.get(key).getDescribe();\\n if (!fd.isCreateable() || !fd.getName().containsIgnoreCase('RPO')) { continue; }\\n\\n Schema.DisplayType t = fd.getType();\\n\\n if (t == Schema.DisplayType.REFERENCE) {\\n for (Schema.SObjectType ref : fd.getReferenceTo()) {\\n if (ref == Account.SObjectType) {\\n record.put(fd.getName(), rpoAccount());\\n break;\\n }\\n }\\n } else if (t == Schema.DisplayType.PICKLIST) {\\n setFirstPicklistValue(record, fd.getName());\\n } else if (t == Schema.DisplayType.BOOLEAN) {\\n record.put(fd.getName(), true);\\n } else if (t == Schema.DisplayType.STRING) {\\n record.put(fd.getName(), 'Test RPO');\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n private static void setFirstPicklistValue(SObject record, String fieldName) {\\n Schema.SObjectField f =\\n record.getSObjectType().getDescribe().fields.getMap().get(fieldName.toLowerCase());\\n if (f == null) { return; }\\n\\n Schema.DescribeFieldResult fd = f.getDescribe();\\n if (!fd.isCreateable()) { return; }\\n\\n for (Schema.PicklistEntry entry : fd.getPicklistValues()) {\\n if (entry.isActive()) {\\n record.put(fieldName, entry.getValue());\\n return;\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n /\*\* Sets a field only when this org allows it to be written on create. \*/\\n private static void setIfWriteable(SObject record, String fieldName, Object value) {\\n Schema.SObjectField f =\\n record.getSObjectType().getDescribe().fields.getMap().get(fieldName.toLowerCase());\\n if (f != null && f.getDescribe().isCreateable()) {\\n record.put(fieldName, value);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n // IN-MEMORY RECORDS\\n // TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c is a formula and CreatedDate is system-managed, so\\n // they are populated by deserialising. These records are never inserted.\\n // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n private static TR1\_\_Job\_\_c jobRecord(String accountName, String businessProcess,\\n String location) {\\n Map<String, Object> payload = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'attributes' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'TR1\_\_Job\_\_c' }\\n };\\n if (accountName != null) { payload.put('TR1\_\_Account\_Name\_\_c', accountName); }\\n if (businessProcess != null) { payload.put('BH\_Business\_process\_\_c', businessProcess); }\\n if (location != null) { payload.put('BH\_Location\_\_c', location); }\\n return (TR1\_\_Job\_\_c) JSON.deserialize(JSON.serialize(payload), TR1\_\_Job\_\_c.class);\\n }\\n\\n private static List<SObject> inMemoryApplications(Id jobId, Integer howMany) {\\n List<SObject> apps = new List<SObject>();\\n for (Integer i = 0; i < howMany; i++) {\\n Map<String, Object> payload = new Map<String, Object>{\\n 'attributes' => new Map<String, Object>{ 'type' => 'TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c' },\\n 'Id' => fakeId(TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.SObjectType, i + 1),\\n 'TR1\_\_Applicant\_\_c' => fakeId(Contact.SObjectType, i + 1)\\n };\\n if (jobId != null) { payload.put('TR1\_\_Job\_\_c', jobId); }\\n apps.add((TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c) JSON.deserialize(\\n JSON.serialize(payload), TR1\_\_Application\_V2\_\_c.class));\\n }\\n return apps;\\n }\\n\\n private static String fakeId(Schema.SObjectType t, Integer index) {\\n String suffix = String.valueOf(index);\\n String padding = '';\\n while (padding.length() + suffix.length() < 12) { padding += '0'; }\\n return t.getDescribe().getKeyPrefix() + padding + suffix;\\n }\\n}"

▾{

"type": "tool.call",

"agentId": "reviewer\_mu30g8yfpZ2Xm\_1Ms4o7",

▾"input": {

"title": "Independent quality review — staged document reminders 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"review",

"document-reminders",

"validation",

"blockers",

"reed-train"

\],

"content": "## Scope reviewed\\nIndependently read the current full staged workspace: new/modified DocumentReminder Apex, all tests and XML, SendGrid changes, triggers, fields/custom objects/metadata, email templates, FlexiPage and permission sets. Compared modified components with current org versions and described legacy objects. Installed packages verified: Onboarding b3o 8.0.0.1, TR1 9.74.0.1. No org data/schedules/email/deploy changed.\\n\\n## Check-only evidence\\nRan \`validate\_deployment\` with RunSpecifiedTests: \`DocumentReminderDailySchedulerTest\`, \`DocumentReminderDispatchServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderProgressServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderRefreshServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderRetentionBatchTest\`, \`DocumentReminderSettingsTest\`, \`SendGridEmailServiceTest\`, \`SendGridWebhookTest\`, plus existing regression \`SendGridTest\`, \`JobFillRollupHandlerTest\`, \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatchTest\`.\\n\\nResult: \*\*VALIDATION FAILED (attempt 5); no deploy id returned; 53 component failures, 0 test failures.\*\* Tests therefore did not execute and coverage is unavailable.\\n\\n### Compile blockers reported\\n1. \`classes/DocumentReminderDispatchService.cls\`: line 508 \`Illegal integer\` (the \`-2147483648\` literal); line 79 and 98 nested \`PreparationBatch\` / \`ClaimBatch\` cannot implement \`Database.Batchable<SObject>\`; line 155 \`ORDER BY\` cannot be combined with \`FOR UPDATE\`.\\n2. \`classes/DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.cls\`: lines 118 onward parser errors because \`limit\` is a reserved identifier, and \`group\` is reserved at line 102. This prevents dependency/rule service compilation.\\n3. \`classes/DocumentReminderRefreshService.cls\`: lines 25, 154, 176 \`ORDER BY\` with \`FOR UPDATE\`; lines 232/256 \`static can only be used on methods of a top level type\` for methods inside \`RefreshJob\`.\\n4. \`classes/SendGridEmailServiceTest.cls\`: line 6 \`HttpRequest.getTimeout()\` does not exist.\\n5. \`permissionsets/Angard.permissionset-meta.xml\`: required \`<label>\` missing; org query confirms \`PermissionSet.Name/Label = Angard\`, so add \`<label>Angard</label>\`.\\n6. \`permissionsets/Document\_Reminder\_Operator.permissionset-meta.xml\`: Description is 276 characters vs maximum 255.\\nDependent trigger/class failures are a consequence of those invalid classes.\\n\\n## Functional/security design blockers found from source (independent of compilation)\\n1. \*\*Missing evidence links are not fail-closed.\*\* \`DocumentReminderProgressService.documentsByPack()\` at lines 191–202 selects only Id/Name/pack/rule/show-on-success. It never selects/evaluates \`b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Form\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Question\_Set\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Template\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_\_c\` or \`b3o\_\_Session\_\_c\`. Org describe confirms those are the document's evidence routes, with \`b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\` nullable. A visible document with all routes blank becomes applicable/outstanding and can trigger a reminder, contrary to approved explicit exception/suppression behavior. Tests always populate an external link and do not test the absent-route case.\\n2. \*\*No actual suppression eligibility check.\*\* \`DocumentReminderDispatchService.deliveryGateError()\` lines 495–500 only evaluates the boolean attestation \`settings.suppressionVerificationReady\`, Contact opt-out, Contact bounce and allowlist. There is no adapter/query/call to a SendGrid suppression source; settings describe calls it an \\"approved suppression/unsubscribe verification adapter\\" but no such component is staged. A true custom-metadata checkbox can therefore allow a newly suppressed address to be sent to. The required fresh suppression recheck cannot be satisfied by the static launch attestation.\\n3. \*\*The dispatch chain is serial and cannot meet the stated bounded 60k/day design at its own timeout.\*\* \`ClaimBatch.finish()\` line 93 enqueues one \`LeaseJob\`; each LeaseJob locks at most \`sendBatchSize\` (max 10) then one PreSend/one Dispatch/one Send job; \`SendJob\` line 340 enqueues only the next LeaseJob. Direct calls are sequential at up to 10 seconds each. At the intentionally permitted 10-second response bound this has one 10-email/100-second worker chain: 60,000 candidate digests requires 6,000 groups (~167 hours of callout time), before queue latency. No configurable bounded worker lanes or throughput/capacity test exists. The test only asserts a 200-contact claim and mock outcomes; it cannot prove capacity.\\n\\n## Other observations\\n- The source does implement the explicit Europe/London duration end calculation, start gate, one per Contact/date key, stable reference before callout, a no-DML callout branch, and separate Accepted/Delivered statuses; none is counted as validated while compilation fails.\\n- \`Last\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c\` is documented as the most recent durable send but has no write path anywhere in staged Apex (only protected from user edits). If it is retained on the new page/FLS, populate it atomically when association membership is persisted or remove the field.\\n- New internal CMDT/operational fields have descriptions but many lack inline help (all Rule Dependency fields, most Settings/Refresh/Send/association fields). This is a quality warning after blockers.\\n- Component-dependency API calls for the three modified unmanaged components failed with Salesforce \`RefMetadataComponentName is unknown\`; this is an API limitation, not evidence of no dependencies. Org trigger inventory confirms managed b3o triggers already coexist on the three managed objects, so the added unmanaged triggers must remain thin as staged."

},

"title": "Independent quality review — staged document reminders 2026-09-15",

▾"tags": \[

"review",

\],

"content": "## Scope reviewed\\nIndependently read the complete current staged workspace: all new/modified DocumentReminder Apex, tests and XML, SendGrid changes, triggers, fields/custom objects/metadata, email templates, FlexiPage and permission sets. Compared modified components with current org versions and described legacy objects. Installed packages verified: Onboarding b3o 8.0.0.1, TR1 9.74.0.1. No org data/schedules/email/deploy changed.\\n\\n## Check-only evidence\\nRan \`validate\_deployment\` with RunSpecifiedTests: \`DocumentReminderDailySchedulerTest\`, \`DocumentReminderDispatchServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderProgressServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderRefreshServiceTest\`, \`DocumentReminderRetentionBatchTest\`, \`DocumentReminderSettingsTest\`, \`SendGridEmailServiceTest\`, \`SendGridWebhookTest\`, plus existing regression \`SendGridTest\`, \`JobFillRollupHandlerTest\`, \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatchTest\`.\\n\\nResult: \*\*VALIDATION FAILED (attempt 5); no deploy id returned; 53 component failures, 0 test failures.\*\* Tests therefore did not execute and coverage is unavailable.\\n\\n### Compile blockers reported\\n1. \`classes/DocumentReminderDispatchService.cls\`: line 508 \`Illegal integer\` (the \`-2147483648\` literal); line 79 and 98 nested \`PreparationBatch\` / \`ClaimBatch\` cannot implement \`Database.Batchable<SObject>\`; line 155 \`ORDER BY\` cannot be combined with \`FOR UPDATE\`.\\n2. \`classes/DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.cls\`: lines 118 onward parser errors because \`limit\` is a reserved identifier, and \`group\` is reserved at line 102. This prevents dependency/rule service compilation.\\n3. \`classes/DocumentReminderRefreshService.cls\`: lines 25, 154, 176 \`ORDER BY\` with \`FOR UPDATE\`; lines 232/256 \`static can only be used on methods of a top level type\` for methods inside \`RefreshJob\`.\\n4. \`classes/SendGridEmailServiceTest.cls\`: line 6 \`HttpRequest.getTimeout()\` does not exist.\\n5. \`permissionsets/Angard.permissionset-meta.xml\`: required \`<label>\` missing; org query confirms \`PermissionSet.Name/Label = Angard\`, so add \`<label>Angard</label>\`.\\n6. \`permissionsets/Document\_Reminder\_Operator.permissionset-meta.xml\`: Description is 276 characters vs maximum 255.\\nDependent trigger/class failures are a consequence of those invalid classes.\\n\\n## Functional/security design blockers found from source (independent of compilation)\\n1. \*\*Missing/unreliable evidence links are not validated.\*\* \`DocumentReminderProgressService.latestSubmissions()\` (lines 226–251) selects only the assignment/document/contact/status/valid-until links. It does not select or evaluate any native submission evidence pointer (\`b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c\`) against the configured document target. As a result a latest Pending Review/Approved submission with a broken/missing evidence pointer is counted complete. The approved requirement treats missing/unreliable evidence links as an exception that suppresses reminder; tests cover a mismatched Contact/Document association only, not a missing evidence pointer/route. (The document's \`b3o\_\_External\_Link\_\_c\` is a configured document target, not itself the submission evidence link, and is not asserted here.)\\n2. \*\*No actual suppression eligibility check.\*\* \`DocumentReminderDispatchService.deliveryGateError()\` lines 495–500 only evaluates the boolean attestation \`settings.suppressionVerificationReady\`, Contact opt-out, Contact bounce and allowlist. There is no adapter/query/call to a SendGrid suppression source; settings metadata describes this as an \\"approved suppression/unsubscribe verification adapter\\" but no such component is staged. A true custom-metadata checkbox can therefore allow a newly suppressed address to be sent to. The required fresh suppression recheck cannot be satisfied by a static launch attestation.\\n3. \*\*The dispatch chain is serial and cannot meet the stated bounded 60k/day design at its own timeout.\*\* \`ClaimBatch.finish()\` line 93 enqueues one \`LeaseJob\`; each LeaseJob locks at most \`sendBatchSize\` (max 10) then one PreSend/one Dispatch/one Send job; \`SendJob\` line 340 enqueues only the next LeaseJob. Direct calls are sequential at up to 10 seconds each. At the intentionally permitted 10-second response bound this has one 10-email/100-second worker chain: 60,000 candidate digests requires 6,000 groups (~167 hours of callout time), before queue latency. No configurable bounded worker lanes or throughput/capacity test exists. The test only asserts a 200-contact claim and mock outcomes; it cannot prove capacity.\\n\\n## Other observations\\n- The source does implement the explicit Europe/London duration end calculation, start gate, one per Contact/date key, stable reference before callout, a no-DML callout branch, and separate Accepted/Delivered statuses; none is counted as validated while compilation fails.\\n- \`Last\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c\` is documented as the most recent durable send but has no write path anywhere in staged Apex (only protected from user edits). If it is retained, populate it atomically when association membership is persisted or remove it.\\n- New internal CMDT/operational fields have descriptions but many lack inline help (all Rule Dependency fields, most Settings/Refresh/Send/association fields). This is a quality warning after blockers.\\n- Component-dependency API calls for the three modified unmanaged components failed with Salesforce \`RefMetadataComponentName is unknown\`; this is an API limitation, not evidence of no dependencies. Org trigger inventory confirms managed b3o triggers already coexist on the three managed objects, so the added unmanaged triggers must remain thin as staged."

},

"text": "BLOCKERS\\n\\n1. \*\*Workspace does not compile; tests and coverage did not run.\*\* \\n \`validate\_deployment\` failed with 53 component failures, so the required ≥75% Apex coverage cannot be verified.\\n - \`classes/DocumentReminderDispatchService.cls\`\\n - line 508: \`Illegal integer\` from \`Integer selectedPriority = -2147483648;\`. Replace the sentinel with nullable-priority first-selection logic.\\n - lines 79 and 98: inner \`PreparationBatch\` and \`ClaimBatch\` cannot implement \`Database.Batchable<SObject>\`. Extract them to top-level \`DocumentReminder…Batch\` classes and update callers/tests.\\n - line 155: \`ORDER BY CreatedDate ... FOR UPDATE\` is prohibited. Remove the explicit order or redesign the atomic lease selection without combining it with \`FOR UPDATE\`.\\n - \`classes/DocumentReminderRuleEvaluator.cls\`\\n - line 118 onwards: \`limit\` is a reserved identifier; rename it (for example, \`childRecordLimit\`).\\n - line 102: \`group\` is reserved; rename the parameter/local variable (for example, \`ruleGroup\`).\\n - \`classes/DocumentReminderRefreshService.cls\`\\n - lines 25, 154 and 176: \`ORDER BY ... FOR UPDATE\` is prohibited. Remove the order from the locking queries.\\n - lines 232 and 256: methods inside nested \`RefreshJob\` cannot be \`static\`. Make them instance methods or move them to the outer/top-level class.\\n - \`classes/SendGridEmailServiceTest.cls:6\`: \`HttpRequest.getTimeout()\` does not exist. Remove that assertion or expose a testable timeout value through the service without relying on an unavailable platform method.\\n - \`permissionsets/Angard.permissionset-meta.xml\`: missing required \`<label>\`. The org confirms this permission set’s label is \`Angard\`; add \`<label>Angard</label>\`.\\n - \`permissionsets/Document\_Reminder\_Operator.permissionset-meta.xml\`: Description is 276 characters; maximum is 255. Shorten it.\\n\\n2. \*\*Missing/unreliable submission evidence is not treated as an exception.\*\* \\n \`classes/DocumentReminderProgressService.cls:226-251\` (\`latestSubmissions\`) selects only Assignment, Document, Contact, Status and Valid Until. It does not read or validate the evidence pointers on \`b3o\_\_Document\_Submission\_\_c\`—for example \`b3o\_\_Form\_Response\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Document\_Trace\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Submitter\_\_c\`, \`b3o\_\_Candidate\_Scorecard\_\_c\`, and \`b3o\_\_Session\_Invitation\_\_c\`—against the configured Document target. A latest Pending Review/Approved submission with a missing or mismatched source-evidence pointer is therefore counted complete.\\n\\n This conflicts with the approved requirement that missing/unreliable evidence links produce an explicit calculation exception and suppress reminders. The org’s document model supports Form, Question Set, Document Template, Document, Session and External Link target routes. \\n \*\*Fix:\*\* load the relevant Document target fields and submission evidence pointers; validate the pointer appropriate to each target before counting the latest submission as complete. For unsupported/unverifiable evidence routes, set \`Calculation\_Status\_\_c = Error\`, clear current counts, and suppress the Contact digest. Add positive and negative tests for valid/missing/mismatched pointers.\\n\\n3. \*\*Suppression eligibility is only an admin attestation, not a fresh pre-send check.\*\* \\n \`classes/DocumentReminderDispatchService.cls:495-500\` checks \`Suppression\_Verification\_Ready\_\_c\`, \`HasOptedOutOfEmail\`, \`IsEmailBounced\`, and the allowlist. There is no SendGrid suppression lookup/adapter or other current suppression source. Once an admin changes the metadata flag to true, an address newly globally unsubscribed/suppressed at SendGrid can still be sent a reminder.\\n\\n \*\*Fix:\*\* implement an authenticated, no-DML-before-callout suppression eligibility service against the approved SendGrid/source-of-truth suppression interface, and invoke it in the final \`SendJob\` recheck before the mail POST. Retain \`Suppression\_Verification\_Ready\_\_c\` only as a launch gate, not as proof that each recipient remains eligible. Add tests for fresh suppression after preparation and before dispatch.\\n\\n4. \*\*The direct-send topology is serial and cannot satisfy the 60,000/day capacity design within its own bounded timeout.\*\* \\n \`classes/DocumentReminderDispatchService.cls:93\` starts one \`LeaseJob\` after \`ClaimBatch\`; each \`LeaseJob\` leases at most 10 rows, then starts one preparer, one hand-off, and one \`SendJob\`. \`SendJob\` at line 340 starts only the next single \`LeaseJob\`. Direct HTTP calls are sequential and each permits 10 seconds.\\n\\n At the stated bound, one 10-email group can consume 100 seconds. Sending 60,000 Contact digests requires 6,000 groups—approximately 167 hours of callout time before queue latency. The existing 200-Contact claim test and mocked HTTP responses do not test throughput or worker concurrency. \\n \*\*Fix:\*\* introduce a configurable, globally bounded number of independently leased worker lanes, with atomic Contact/day claims retained. Each lane must stay within callout, async, CPU, and queue limits, and the resulting design must be load-tested in UAT against the actual SendGrid and Salesforce capacity allocation. Do not represent mock-test results as throughput evidence.\\n\\n5. \*\*No clean test/coverage gate exists for this solution.\*\* \\n Because compilation failed, the stated positive, negative, security, lifecycle, 200-record bulk, expiry, DST, retry, uncertainty, and restart tests were not executed. Coverage was not produced. \\n \*\*Fix:\*\* correct every compile failure, then rerun a clean check-only validation with all new tests plus \`SendGridTest\`, \`JobFillRollupHandlerTest\`, and \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatchTest\`; inspect per-class coverage and test results before any deployment request.\\n\\nWARNINGS\\n\\n1. \*\*\`Last\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c\` is never populated.\*\* \\n \`objects/b3o\_\_Document\_Assignment\_\_c/fields/Last\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c.field-meta.xml\` describes the field as the “Most recent durable reminder send log containing this assignment,” but the only staged references are user-edit protection in \`classes/DocumentReminderProgressService.cls:262,274\`. No dispatcher path writes it.\\n\\n \*\*Fix:\*\* update this lookup when all \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c\` membership rows have been durably saved, using the existing system-managed assignment update mechanism; otherwise remove the unused field, FLS entries, and related documentation.\\n\\n2. \*\*Most admin-configured and operational fields lack Inline Help Text.\*\* \\n Examples include all six fields in \`objects/Document\_Reminder\_Rule\_Dependency\_\_mdt/fields/\`, and most fields in \`Document\_Reminder\_Settings\_\_mdt\`, \`Document\_Reminder\_Refresh\_Request\_\_c\`, \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_\_c\`, and \`Document\_Reminder\_Send\_Assignment\_\_c\`. Only 21 staged field files contain \`<inlineHelpText>\`.\\n\\n \*\*Fix:\*\* add concise Setup-facing help for the fields administrators or operators must configure/investigate, especially timing, enablement, duration, retry, suppression, dependency, state, error, and retention fields.\\n\\n3. \*\*Component dependency lookup could not be completed through the org API.\*\* \\n \`component\_dependencies\` failed for \`SendGridEmailService\`, \`ApplicationJobRollupTrigger\`, and \`JobDocumentAssignmentSyncTrigger\` with \`RefMetadataComponentName is unknown\`. This is an API limitation, not evidence that no dependencies exist. The org trigger inventory confirms managed \`b3o\_\_DocumentAssignment\` and related managed triggers coexist on the affected objects.\\n\\n \*\*Fix:\*\* preserve the thin trigger pattern and perform regression testing in the target release sandbox against candidate submission, staff review, assignment visibility, Application updates, Job location updates, and existing SendGrid flows.\\n\\nSUGGESTIONS\\n\\n1. Add explicit comments to \`classes/DocumentReminderProgressService.cls\` and \`classes/DocumentReminderRefreshService.cls\` explaining why their \`without sharing\` execution is the narrowly scoped background exception, what records they update, and why no user-facing entry point exists.\\n\\n2. Add a security release test/manual checklist proving that the named scheduler user—not a guest or ordinary Angard user—has:\\n - \`Document\_Reminder\_Operator\` and \`Run\_Document\_Reminders\`,\\n - Contact/Assignment visibility,\\n - the required SendGrid Named Credential/External Credential principal,\\n - permission to schedule the approved scheduler,\\n - access to the public \`Document\_Reminders\` email folder. \\n The metadata flag \`Security\_Verified\_\_c\` should only be changed after this evidence exists.\\n\\n3. The existing, non-staged \`JobFillRollupHandlerTest\` uses \`@IsTest(SeeAllData=true)\`. It was included only as a trigger regression test. It is pre-existing and not a staged change, but it remains environment-dependent and should be refactored separately to use synthetic data.\\n\\nVALIDATION RAN\\n\\n- Check-only method: \`validate\_deployment\`, \`RunSpecifiedTests\`\\n- Tests requested:\\n - \`DocumentReminderDailySchedulerTest\`\\n - \`DocumentReminderDispatchServiceTest\`\\n - \`DocumentReminderProgressServiceTest\`\\n - \`DocumentReminderRefreshServiceTest\`\\n - \`DocumentReminderRetentionBatchTest\`\\n - \`DocumentReminderSettingsTest\`\\n - \`SendGridEmailServiceTest\`\\n - \`SendGridWebhookTest\`\\n - \`SendGridTest\`\\n - \`JobFillRollupHandlerTest\`\\n - \`DocumentAssignmentSyncBatchTest\`\\n- Result: \`VALIDATION FAILED (attempt 5)\` — 53 component failures, 0 test failures.\\n- Check-only deployment ID: none returned by the harness because compilation failed.\\n- Test execution/coverage: unavailable; “0 test failures” is not a passing test result because components did not compile.\\n- Review findings recorded in scratchpad: \`Independent quality review — staged document reminders 2026-09-15\`.\\n\\nVERDICT:",
